Job Title - Salesforce B2B Commerce Lead - Specialist - ACS Song
Management Level:Level 9 - Specialist
Location:Kochi
Must have skills:Salesforce Generic

Good to have skills:Salesforce B2B Commerce
Experience:5-8 years of experience in Salesforce B2B Commerce and related technologies

Educational Qualification:Graduation (accurate educational details should be captured)
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced and motivated Salesforce B2B Commerce Lead - Specialist with 5-8 years of experience in designing, developing, and delivering scalable eCommerce solutions on Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud. The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce platform capabilities, with proven experience in both backend and frontend development. You will lead technical delivery, mentor team members, and ensure adherence to best practices while collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive successful multi-market rollouts.


Roles and Responsibilities
Own the technical direction and ensure delivery of high-quality, scalable, and maintainable Salesforce B2B Commerce solutions.
Lead and mentor developers, providing guidance through code reviews, technical planning, and solution design.
Design, develop, debug, unit test, and document complex Salesforce applications and integrations.
Develop and customize Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Communities for B2B Commerce Cloud.
Implement Apex Classes, Triggers (before/after insert, update, delete), and Scheduler Classes for automation.
Create and manage Flows (Schedule-triggered, AutoLaunched, Record-triggered) and modify standard checkout flows.
Make architectural and design decisions ensuring scalability, maintainability, and compliance with Salesforce standards.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical implementation with business requirements.
Proactively identify technical risks and propose improvements across the codebase and processes.
Ensure proper validation checks, error handling, and user experience enhancements (e.g., Toast Notifications).
Act as a key troubleshooter in complex/escalated incidents and provide innovative solutions.
Manage multi-market rollouts including multi-currency and multi-language implementations.
Ensure adherence to CI/CD pipelines, code quality standards, and Salesforce best practices.

Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
Strong expertise in Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud (LWR template, checkout flows, staged rollouts).
Hands-on experience in Apex programming (Classes, Triggers, Scheduler, Batch jobs).
Proficiency in Lightning Web Components (LWC) including lifecycle hooks (connectedCallback, renderedCallback), directives (for:each, iterator, if:true), and decorators (@track, @wire, @api).
Experience with frontend customization:styling LWC with custom CSS, applying validation checks, and building reusable components.
Knowledge of Salesforce Communities and integration with external APIs.
Strong understanding of SOQL, data loading activities (Data Loader, Workbench), and permission set assignments.
Experience with GitHub, Bitbucket, and code management tools.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and code quality tools (SonarQube).
Exposure to multi-threaded integrations, caching mechanisms, and API-driven commerce flows.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and logical skills with attention to detail.
Ability to work under pressure and deliver within deadlines.

At Quest Global, its not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. Key Responsibilities
As a member of the team in the Healthcare domain, your primary job will be able to design and implementing testing automation framework.
 The job also involves following
•        Design and implement test automation framework.
•        Identify and fix the integration issues of automation scripts.
•        Closely work with the customer.
•        Timely delivery of design and development work.
•        Identify and report issue of application from daily automation results
We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.
We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.
Work Experience
    Experience in Verification and Validation of engineering applications preferably in healthcare domain. 
    Experience in tools such as DOORs, Clear Quest.
    Python 3.10+ with strong typing (type hints, data classes, enums, generics)
    Test automation frameworks — pytest (fixtures, markers, parametrize, plugins)

    Version control — Git (branching, commits, hooks)
    Visual Studio Code — extensions, workspace configuration, tasks, launch configs
    AI-assisted development — GitHub Copilot, prompt engineering, reviewing and validating AI-generated code
    Experience in designing and developing test plans, test cases and generating test reports, defect reports and documentation
    Experience in error guessing techniques, Smoke, Functional, Integration, Regression, Beta, Database, Exploratory Testing etc.
    Experience in preparing effective bug reports using defect tracking system and tracking them to closure.
    Experience in Linux platform
    Ability to work productively and efficiently in an agile environment. 
    Ability to learn new technologies, software, and concepts quickly is essential.
    Good communication and presentation skills. 
Good to have:
    Experience creating, configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining Jenkins pipelines for automated test execution, reporting, and continuous integration.
    Experience in testing of Medical modality software, Medical Imaging platform in XR platforms.
    Knowledge in Health Care Standards & regulations like DICOM, IHE, HIPPA
    Familiar with tools like WinScp, Putty, Rally, Perforce, etc.Role & responsibilities

Description:
EY- Assurance Assistant Manager
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.

The opportunity
We’re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills. GDS Assistant Manager’s, would have Associate level or Senior level personnel to work with at GDS and get the tasks executed from them along with performing a review as an Assistant Manager  , which is defined by the Global client serving assurance teams.

Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures, and ensure these are embedded in to the engagement team’s work.
Proactively discuss work flow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one’s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one’s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one’s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training.
Ability to Lead by example.

Skills and attributes for success
Expert Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Ability to confidently lead conversations and discussions with key stakeholders
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Robust logical and reasoning skills.
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have
Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) / ACCA / CPA
1-5 years post-qualification experience with either
a) Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews
b) MNC or larger domestic Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service
     Environment.
Ideally, you’ll also have
Proficiency in MS – MS office and Outlook.
Interest in business and commerciality.

What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Positive attitude and ability to excel under tight timelines.

Advance knowledge of MS – Excel Ms - Office. Interest in business and commerciality.

Description:
EY Assurance Manager (Real Estate Practice)
As part of our EY Assurance Real Estate practice, you will serve as the primary point of contact from GDS for engagements assigned for the Americas regions. You will be responsible for managing end-to-end engagement delivery, including quality, timeliness, stakeholder management, operational oversight, resource planning and team leadership. The role requires working closely with engagement teams and client-serving professionals to deliver high-quality assurance services while driving continuous improvement, digital adoption, risk management and process standardization across a portfolio of Real Estate clients.

The Opportunity
EY's Real Estate Assurance practice serves a broad range of clients across the real estate ecosystem, including real estate investment trusts (REITs), real estate private equity funds, property owners, developers, asset managers and other real estate-related entities. The practice provides exposure to complex accounting, reporting and assurance matters unique to the real estate industry, including property acquisitions and disposals, fair value measurements (level III), leasing, joint ventures, investment funds and capital markets transactions. We're looking for qualified accountants with strong leadership, stakeholder management and project management skills. The incumbent will have an excellent opportunity to work directly with engagement teams across the Americas, develop deep industry knowledge, gain exposure to leading global Real Estate clients and contribute to the growth and transformation of the EY Assurance Real Estate practice.

Your key responsibilities
- Support a portfolio of engagements by leading teams of Associate Managers, Assistant Managers and staffs, ensuring timely, high-quality delivery in line with EY methodology, engagement expectations and quality standards.
- Demonstrate strong technical and methodological expertise through service delivery, pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, hot reviews and other quality initiatives, while proactively identifying and mitigating engagement risks.
- Develop and maintain productive relationships with Assurance executives, Partners and key engagement stakeholders across Americas, acting as a trusted advisor and proactively managing stakeholder expectations.
- Develop a strong understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure compliance requirements are embedded across all engagement activities and team deliverables.
- Work closely with engagement teams to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance, expand GDS scope and identify opportunities for increased participation across audit phases.
- Proactively manage engagement workflow, resource allocation, staffing mix, utilization, budgets, capacity planning and engagement economics, while monitoring performance against established operational goals and KPIs.
- Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clear communication when working with both GDS and engagement teams, ensuring timely escalation and resolution of issues where necessary.
- Establish and continuously reinforce expectations regarding value delivery, service quality, efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction for aligned engagements.
- Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work, increase GDS adoption and support portfolio growth through new wins, centralization and standardization initiatives.
- Drive process improvement, automation, digital adoption and the sharing of leading practices to enhance audit quality, efficiency and consistency across engagements.
- Lead by example, build high-performing teams and create an inclusive culture through effective coaching, delegation, mentorship and career development.
- Conduct timely performance reviews, provide regular feedback, support counselor responsibilities and actively contribute to talent development, retention and succession planning.
- Leverage technology, analytics and EY tools to enhance service delivery, monitor engagement performance and support productivity improvement initiatives.
- Contribute to technical, digital and soft-skills training programs to continuously develop team capabilities and strengthen the overall talent pipeline.

Skills and attributes for success
- Knowledge of US GAAP and International Standards on Auditing (ISA).
- Understanding of Real Estate industry accounting, reporting and assurance requirements.
- Experience with REITs, Real Estate Funds, Property Owners, Developers and Asset Management entities.
- Knowledge of fair value measurements, lease accounting, acquisitions/dispositions and joint venture structures.
- Ability to identify and assess industry-specific risks, controls and financial reporting considerations.
- Strong stakeholder management, project management and team leadership skills.
- Experience leveraging audit technologies, data analytics and digital tools to drive quality and efficiency.

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience.
- Qualified ACCA / CPA with 7-8 years of post-qualification relevant experience.

- Articleship with a Big 4, top-tier or mid-tier accounting firm.
- Experience in external audit and assurance engagements, preferably with exposure to Real Estate, REITs, Private Equity Real Estate Funds, Asset Management or Hospitality clients.
- Experience working on US-based Real Estate engagements and applying US GAAP reporting requirements is preferred.
- Experience managing engagement teams, stakeholder relationships and multiple concurrent audit engagements.
- Experience with audit technology, data analytics and digital audit tools is preferred.
- Experience in either:
a) A Big 4, top-tier or mid-tier accounting firm focused on external audit and assurance engagements.
b) An MNC or large Indian organization, preferably within a Shared Services environment.
c) Big 4 firms serving both Indian and global assurance practices.

Ideally, you'll also have
- Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office and audit technology tools.
- Interest in business, commerciality and industry trends.
- Exposure to Real Estate clients, including REITs, Real Estate Funds, Developers and Property Management entities.
- Understanding of key Real Estate accounting areas such as lease accounting, fair value measurements and investment properties.
- Strong analytical, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to drive process improvements, digital adoption and continuous learning initiatives.

What we look for
- A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
- An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
- Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Work independently to complete multiple tasks within a fast-paced environment.

Excellent US English written and verbal communication skills, with an understanding of how messages may be received globally.

A basic understanding of HTML.

Working knowledge of Zendesk, Adobe Analytics, Conductor, Microsoft PowerPoint and SharePoint.
What we look for
Bachelor’s or master’s degree.
A professional, confident and enthusiastic candidate who can adapt to flexible work timings and demonstrate an exceptional work ethic and customer focus.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in website coordination, digital marketing, web operations or a related field.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
Value (GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high.
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner.
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Pathologist-Full Time
Patna
Lab Operations
Role summary
Managerial Responsibilities:
Overall Management of the laboratory
Consumption management
Quality management

Technical Responsibilities:
Up gradation of advanced technologies Quality of the results.
What the role entails - Key accountabilities/ responsibilities
1. Provide advice to those requesting information about the choice of tests, the use of the laboratory service and the interpretation of laboratory data.
2. Serve as an active member of the medical staff in main lab, collection center,
3. Relate and function effectively with NABL other accrediting agencies, Appropriate administrative officials, healthcare community, the patient / clients.
4. Define, implement, and monitor standards of performance and quality improvement of the medical laboratory service orservices.
5. Monitor all processes in the laboratory to determine that reliable data is being generated.
6. Ensure availability of sufficiently qualified personnel with adequate training and experience to meet the needs of the laboratory.
7. Plan, set goals, develop, and allocate resources appropriate to the medical environment.
8. Provide effective and efficient administration of the medical laboratory service, including budget planning and control with responsible financial management, in accordance with institutional assignment of such responsibilities.
9. Provide educational programs for the medical and laboratory staff and participate in educational programs of the institution.
10. Implement a safe laboratory environment in compliance with good practice and applicable regulations.
11. Address any complaint, request, or suggestion from users of laboratory services. Ensure good staff morale.
12. Report authorization of Hematology, Biochemistry, Immunoassay, Clinical Pathology, and serology
13. Routine review of QC for all departments with review of reports including CBC, MP, PS, Reticulocyte count, Fluid routine, ICT/DCT, Blood group before approving
14. Formulate review and recheck policies for all tests and ensure compliance with the help of Lab supervisor and technicians.
15. Verification of critical, unusual, and abnormal test results before release
16. Interpret, Correlate, and generate medically significant laboratory data.
17. Attending all sorts of client queries related to test enquiries and interpretation of test results.
18. Approval of SOPs for use and ensure compliance with respect to accreditation requirements.
19. Ensure review of monthly MIS
20. Ensure results are reported within turnaround time with the help of section head.
21. Review and improvement of reports formats.
22. To identify new equipment, tests, technology, products and standardization of assays.
23. Identify needs for resources (human / equipment / infrastructure) and submit to senior management for approval.
24. Attending conferences/workshops to ensure updated knowledge about recent trends.
25. To spend time reviewing daily pendency status on reports not released as well as sample received cases to avoid patient dissatisfaction.
26. To keep a watchful eye on instrument maintenance and hygiene of lab and practice 0 tolerance in this area. Any instrument failure due to user s should be avoided totally as it affects our patient and business.
27. To ensure sample processing is not stopped due to KIT non availability.
28. To ensure that every PR is approved on time and any gaps are highlighted.
29. COL/ Lab Head should work with BU Heads in forecasting CAMP s and other seasonal activities and order KITs sufficiently.
30. To keep a close watch on technical complaints. Ensure analytical complaints get logged, DE flagging is minimized. For recorded complaints and initiate proper CAPA and must also discuss in weekly calls with the team on learning and preventive actionsand timely escalation of analytical complaints/ Legal threats
31. To spend quality time on understanding patient and customer VOC especially on cases we are not resolving on time. COL/Lab Head should guide the team to resolve issues on time andsupport them wherever technical input is required.
32. To participate in weekly meetings along with BU/SBU Heads to resolve issues as well as seek support wherever needs from nontechnical team.
33. To take responsibility to train the non-technical team for better business and customer engagement.
34. COL/Lab Head must contribute at least 8 hours in a month in training and sharing knowledge to the team through a formal mechanism.
35. To promote MHL test to larger communities of clinician through KOL Connects. They must use our report as a tool to promote test by recommending new test based on diagnosis in the report.
36. To make time at least once a month to meet B2B clients, collection centers, customers to understand the pulse of the market.
37. To follow guidelines objectively as per MHL Policy and ensure a culture of data-based decision making and discussions; hence every month compliance is very important. It is at most importance for to have self-Compliance from every lab and noncompliance is given utmost importance for closure.
38. To give sufficient time to check and review the Lab managers /Technical team on quality, material consumption and technical performance.
39. Ensure that processes needed for the quality management system are established, implemented, and maintained.
40. Reporting to laboratory management, at the level at which decisions are made on laboratory policy, objectives, and resources, on the performance of the quality management system and any need for improvement.
41. Ensuring the promotion of awareness of users needs and requirements throughout the laboratory organization.
What we are looking for in you
Excellent communication and analytical skill.
Working With
Lab Operations Team
Role demands (Travel)
Yes
Stakeholder interfaces
Yes
What we promise to you
A strong growth prospective.

Title - Draftsman
Reporting Time- 9.30 am to 6.30 pm.
Coordination With- Project team/ Architect Team/District Teams
Location--Patna -Raipur-Lucknow-Bhubneshwar-Bhopal
Will Be In charge/Responsible for-

All activities related to Architecture / Land Acquisition & Development
Professional Skills-

Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, and GIS tools (e.g., Google Earth Pro).
Understanding of architectural design processes and land documentation.
Strong organizational and analytical skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
Attention to detail, with strong documentation and file management skills.
Effective communication and coordination abilities
Specific Roles and Responsibilities-

1. Drafting & Design Support
Develop detailed 2D architectural drawings, site layouts, and maps using CAD tools such as AutoCAD and Revit.
Create conceptual, schematic, and detailed design documents following industry standards and project guidelines.
Apply standard annotation techniques, symbols, hatching, and layering for consistency across drawings.
Develop innovative solutions for complex drafting challenges, optimizing spatial layouts and land use.
2. GIS & Mapping Integration
Utilize Google Earth Pro and similar GIS software to generate KML/KMZ files and overlay geographic survey data.
Integrate coordinates, elevations, and boundaries from field surveys into architectural and land use plans.
Interpret satellite imagery and geospatial information to support site planning and decision-making.
3. Survey Data & Technical Documentation
Interpret and incorporate field survey data (e.g., benchmarks, topography, property boundaries) into technical drawings.
Maintain project survey lists and prepare detailed case files based on client requirements.
Review and revise drawings to ensure alignment with survey data and project changes.
4. Land Documentation & Records Management
Collect, verify, and organize key land-related documents (e.g., 7/12 extracts, title deeds, mutation records, consent letters).
Maintain a central repository of all physical and digital land documents, ensuring proper classification and retrieval.
Update records to reflect changes in land ownership, boundaries, or usage.
5. Project Monitoring & MIS Reporting
Prepare and maintain Project Data Sheets and Dashboards to track progress in land acquisition and development.
Generate and manage MIS reports for ongoing land development and infrastructure projects.
Compile structured project documentation for easy retrieval and reference.
6. Coordination & Collaboration
Collaborate closely with surveyors, engineers, architects, and project managers to ensure that all drawings meet technical and regulatory standards.
Incorporate feedback from project teams and update drawings/documents accordingly.
Participate in design and documentation review meetings, ensuring deliverables align with project goals.

Description:
Job Site Location : Korba (C.G) and Pirpanti (Bihar)


Role & responsibilities

Should have proven experience in execution of Water supply/ Water treatment/ETP/STP/ water pumping
station/ lift irrigation project/ Power projects/ Hydel projects from concept to commissioning.
Should have knowledge about Pumps, Motors, Transformers, HT/LT Panels/ Valves/ piping/ turbine/
generator/ gear box/ EOT Cranes/ PLC & SCADA and other electrical, mechanical equipment and Instruments.
Perform insulation resistance (IR), winding resistance, and continuity tests on pump motors and associated power
Test High Voltage (HV) / Low Voltage (LV) switchgear, motor protection relays, and circuit breakers associated with the pump system
Verify hardwired and software-based interlocks between the pump, field instruments, Distributed Control System (DCS), and SCADA
Execute no-load rotation checks and full-load operational runs
Should have good problem-solving skills.
Coordinate projects from conception to completion
Develop project schedules, timelines, and budgets
Communicate with customer, contractors and other stakeholders to ensure project success.
Should be able to handle multiple projects and different locations.
Coordinate all site acitvities and should handle project Individually.
Should be capable of handling sub-contractors.
Monitor project progress & ensure timely completion of project
Prepare and submit project status reports to management for review.
Ensure project safety and compliance with environmental regulations, Statutory compliance, labour
compliance etc.
Manage project documentation, including contracts, change orders, correspondences with internal and external stake holders.
Maintain all documents as per ISO requirements and project compliance standards.
Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports to management.
Manage sub-contractors for effective resource utilization and timely completion

Preferred candidate profile

Valid Experience in site execution of EPC Projects in Water/Power/Irrigation

Description:
We are looking for Centre Operations Manager for Bhagalpur, Aurangabad & Hisar Location.

Role & responsibilities :-

Conduct regular reviews with Centre Heads to analyze B2B and B2C footfalls, conversion rates, and business performance. Develop and implement action plans to improve these metrics.
Collaborate closely with Centre Heads to drive initiatives focused on increasing the centre's revenue, profitability, and overall business growth.
Work in coordination with pharmacists and doctors to improve the prescription-to-sale ratio of pharmacy products and enhance pharmacy revenue.
Strengthen treatment, financial, and psychological counselling programs by supporting and guiding patient counsellors to improve patient engagement and treatment outcomes.
Monitor the performance of Centre Telecallers and establish structured communication plans for new patients, lost-to-follow-up patients, ANC patients, and other campaigns as directed by management.
Identify opportunities to enhance patient experience and partner with the Corporate Patient Experience team to develop and deliver training programs for receptionists and floor managers.
Drive overall centre performance, employee productivity, engagement, and a positive work culture while ensuring adherence to organizational values and standards.
Coordinate with stakeholders across Head Office functions, including Operations, IT, Embryology, Biomedical, and other support teams, to resolve operational challenges and ensure seamless centre operations.
Ensure adequate manpower availability at all times in line with the approved centre staffing structure and business requirements.
Oversee the induction and training of all new recruits to ensure smooth onboarding and alignment with organizational processes and standards.
Work closely with the B2B Sales team to ensure adherence to business models and SOPs, facilitate timely back-referrals to referring doctors, gather service feedback, and organize retail camps in collaboration with the Retail Engagement Team.
Track competitor activities, market trends, and best practices, and recommend initiatives to strengthen B2C marketing efforts in partnership with the Corporate Marketing team.
Enhance the centre's digital presence by improving social media engagement, increasing patient awareness, and driving higher Net Promoter Score (NPS) reviews and online reputation management.
Ensure effective implementation of management directives, operational policies, and strategic initiatives to achieve business, operational, and patient satisfaction goals.

AboutLenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
AbouttheRole
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks, dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
Responsibilities AreaActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartOptometrist
Customerfocus: DrivingNet
PromoterScore Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer hasFollowing the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Eyecheck-up& dispensing Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer Product recommendation Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the
reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment
Storeupkeep& maintenance regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma/ Bachelors in Optometry
Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions.
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation.
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Job Score Card Slimming Therapist
Section

Details
Mission Statement

Provide a wide range of exceptional slimming services to clients, enhancing their appearance and well-being while adhering to VLCC’s standards and creating superior customer satisfaction.
Outcomes and Accountabilities

1. High Quality of Service, delivering specialized services in slimming category as well as operation of slimming appliances as per the SOP
2. Client Consultation advice in simple words about the basic principle of therapies and appliances
3. Ensure that the trolley and bed setting in the therapy and appliance rooms is done as per the SOP and cleanliness of room and appliances is maintained.
4. Client Referrals by identifying skin/hair issues and referring clients to appropriate experts.
5. Disinfect appliance pads with a germicidal like savlon and Dettol before every session and clean them periodically (every fortnight cleaning in water boiled for 20 minutes so that they are sterilized) as per SOP.
6. Hygiene and Equipment Maintenance by ensuring tools & equipment are sterilized and well-maintained after each execution.
Competencies

1. Technical Expertise in hands-on execution of services with proficiency in slimming treatments.
2. Take and record the measurements of the client at the Enquiry Stage (waist circumference or any other problematic area) / At the time of Zero session and thereafter at the end rolling period for full body and every alternate session for spot reduction therapies as per SOP.
3. Measurements (whole body / problematic area) to be entered in the CPR accurately and signatures taken from the client and that of self.
4. Adhere to the Medical Contraindications with respect to Therapies & Appliances as guided by the Doctor, Physiotherapist and Dietician prior to giving of the respective session.
5. Sales Acumen to soft sell packages and products.
6. Attention to Detail, to maintain high standards of hygiene & personal appearance.
7. Organizational Skills allowing efficient management of appointments & records.
Cultural Fit

Alignment with VLCC’s commitment to customer satisfaction, quality service, business growth, and continuous improvement.
Job Responsibilities

Perform Slimming/ Weight Loss services
1. Execute appliance / therapy session as per SOP always ensuring comfort to the client.
2. Deliver expected Weight loss & CM loss for scientific service delivery and customer delight and maintain record duly undersigned by the client and self.
Client Consultation and Sales
1. Provide weight/inch loss or maintenance advice and soft sell slimming packages and products.
Hygiene and Maintenance
1. Sterilize and maintain equipment, organize raw ingredients, and handle slimming tools responsibly. Maintain proper slimming product stock and timely update the slimming head on stock requirement.
Client Referrals
1. Recognize and refer clients with skin/hair issues to the appropriate experts.
Administrative Tasks
1. Schedule appointments, maintain slimming service records, and generate required reports.
Continuous Improvement
1. Attend staff and training meetings, upgrade skills, and multitask as needed.
Reporting Structure

Reports to Slimming Head
Positions Supervised

Nil.
Compensation and Benefits

Competitive salary with performance-based incentives, health benefits, and other perks as per company policy.
Experience and Education

Passed class 10, Hands-on-experience, Apprenticeship Training. At least 2-3 experience in a similar industry. Willing to work in shifts, accept additional responsibilities, and be comfortable with transfers.

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Reportingto Store Manager
SkipLevel Areas Operations Manager

About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks, dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Responsibilities Area
Customerfocus: DrivingNet
PromoterScore Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer hasFollowing the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Eyecheck-up& dispensing Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer Product recommendation Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the
reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment
Storeupkeep & maintenance regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma/ Bachelors in Optometry
Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions.
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation.
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
SUMMARY
Title: Business Development Executive Field sales apprentice role
Location: Patiala / Patran / Jagraun / Ajnala / Batala / Moga / Bathinda
Job Type: Full-Time apprentice role for 12 months
Industry: Beauty & Cosmetics / Retail / FMCG

Summary:
We are seeking a motivated Business Development Executive to drive growth for a leading online cosmetic and beauty products retailer across Uttar Pradesh. This role is centred on expanding our retail footprint by building strong relationships with distributors, retailers, and vendors within the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will be proactive in lead generation, product promotion, and sales execution, ensuring consistent visibility and performance of our offerings in key retail locations. The position is retail store-based with regular field visits, offering a dynamic opportunity to contribute directly to business expansion in a fast-paced FMCG environment.

Responsibilities:
Identify and develop new leads through systematic market visits, provided data, and personal referrals
Engage with distributors, retailers, and vendors to present product portfolios and drive sales
Conduct in-store product sampling and promotional activities to enhance customer engagement
Execute targeted product launch initiatives and ensure timely deal closures
Support retail partners with business development strategies and on-ground execution
Monitor, analyse, and report monthly sales performance, campaign outcomes, and key market insights

Requirements
Graduate in any discipline (from 2021 to 2025 pass-out)
Freshers are encouraged to apply
Up to 11 months of sales or field experience is acceptable
Must be a local resident of the assigned location (within 10 km of the retail store)
Personal two-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
Prior knowledge or experience in the beauty/cosmetics or FMCG sector is preferred
Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
Work Schedule: 6 days a week
Weekly Off: Sunday
Work Type: Retail store-based with regular local market visits


Benefits
Fixed salary:  11,500 from Nykaa + 4500 from Govt (16000 inhand)
Daily TA/DA: 200
Attractive performance-based incentives

Job Title:Shift Incharge Electrical
Department: Electrical Maintenance
Location: Rajpura
Reporting To: Section Head Electrical
Grade: Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager
JobPurpose
To ensureuninterrupted operation of downstream steel manufacturing lines by effectivelymanaging electrical maintenance activities during the shift, minimizingequipment downtime, ensuring safety compliance, and leading the shiftelectrical team to achieve production and maintenance objectives.
KeyResponsibilities
1.Shift Operations
Ensure smooth operation of all electrical systems during the assigned shift.
Attend electrical breakdowns promptly and restore equipment within targeted downtime.
Coordinate with Production, Mechanical, Instrumentation, and Utility teams for seamless plant operations.
Ensure proper shift handover and maintain detailed shift logs.
2.Preventive Predictive Maintenance
Execute preventive and predictive maintenance schedules for all electrical equipment.
Monitor the health of motors, drives, transformers, switchgear, MCCs, PCCs, UPS, DG sets, and electrical panels.
Ensure timely inspection, testing, and maintenance of critical electrical assets.
3.Breakdown Maintenance
Analyze root causes of electrical failures and implement corrective actions.
Troubleshoot PLC, VFD, servo drives, sensors, HMI, and field electrical equipment.
Minimize downtime through effective troubleshooting and resource management.
4.Safety Compliance
Ensure compliance with electrical safety standards, statutory regulations, and company safety procedures.

Job Description -
Job Title - Area Sales Head-Standard ECD (Water Heater & Fan)
Level- Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager
Location- Amritsar Br.
Reporting To Product head
Supervising- Individual Contributor
Job responsibilities

1. Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve company targets within the Standard ECD (Water Heater & Fan) division.
2. Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, distributors, and their teams.
3. Identify new business opportunities and market trends to expand the company's market share.
4. Lead and motivate distributors and their teams to drive performance and meet sales objectives.
5. Analyze sales data and market insights to formulate effective sales strategies.
6. Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as marketing, product development, and customer service to ensure alignment and customer satisfaction.
7. Monitor and report on sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to senior management.
8. Provide regular training and coaching to distributor teams to enhance their skills and performance.
9. Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and conferences to promote brand awareness and generate leads.
10. Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and ethical standards in all sales activities.
Candidates profile -
Education

Preferred MBA B.tech /B.E or any post Graduate with 60 %
Experience

5-8 Years
Salary

Best In industry
Personal Attributes

Excellent communication and people skills
Learning agility
Customer centricity
Strong influencing and stake holder management skills
Aptitude in problem-solving
Desire to work as a team with a result driven approach
Age

Maximum 32 Years
Brief Overview:
Havells India Limited, a Great Place to Work-Certified Organization with an overall FY 2022-23 net revenue of INR 17,500 Crore is a Fast Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG) company headquartered in Noida in existence since 1958.
The company has products ranging from home and kitchen appliances which includes water heaters, air coolers, water purifiers, fans, personal grooming, lighting for domestic, commercial and industrial applications, modular switches and wiring accessories, industries and domestic circuit protection switchgear, industrial and domestic cables and wires, induction motors and capacitors and consumer durable products like AC, washing machine, LED TV and Refrigerators. We own brands like Havells, Lloyd, Crabtree, Standard and Promptec.
We have philosophy of Make in India, extensive distribution network and world class quality. We have 40 branches/representative offices with over 6,000 professionals and 12 manufacturing plants located at Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana and Ghiloth.
AboutCompany:
Havells India Limited (Havells), one of Indias largest FMEG (Fast-Moving Electrical Goods) Company & power distribution equipment manufacturer.
Havells is among the few organizations being recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified TM Organization for the fourth consecutive year. We have also been recognized among Indias Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All Top 50.
Havells owns some of the most prestigious brands like Havells, Crabtree, Lloyd, Standard, & Reo offering a wide spectrum of products, including Industrial & Domestic Circuit Protection Devices, Cables & Wires, Motors, Fans, Modular Switches, Home Appliances, Water Heaters & Air Cooler, Grooming Products, Luminaires for Domestic, Commercial and Industrial Applications. With the acquisition of Lloyd in 2017, Havells has made a foray into high-potential consumer durables segments with offerings of Air-conditioners, Televisions, Refrigerators and Washing Machines.
Our global network consists of 7000+ professionals across 35 branches and 15 plants. The company boasts of a strong manufacturing prowess with 15 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in India located in Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana, Ghiloth, Tumkur, and Sricity. Currently over 95% of the product offering is energy efficient and manufactured in-house which makes Havells a name synonymous with excellence and expertise in the electrical industry.
Havells, over the years, has embarked on the journey of social change through inclusive growth. Serving Mid-Day Meal to over 70,000 students across 700 schools daily in the Alwar district, building over 4000 eco-friendly bio-toilets in 400 government schools, distributing over 1,90,000 reusable sanitary napkins to girls, and planting over 17 Lakh tree saplings so far, are among few of our CSR initiatives.

Description:
Senior Executive Industrial Sales and Procurement
Anand Enterprises | Brand Anand Bharat Mart
Full time on site | Mohali | 2 to 5 years of relevant experience | Openings 2
Fixed annual gross salary INR 4.00 to 6.00 lakh, based on relevant experience, skills and interview assessment. Performance incentives are additional, under a written company policy.
Work location: Plot 1542, Sector 82 JLPL, Mohali, Punjab 140306. Reporting to Divyansh Aggarwal. Approved official travel is reimbursed under company policy; statutory benefits apply as eligible.
About Anand Bharat Mart
Anand Bharat Mart, a brand of Anand Enterprises, is built on 25+ years of trust in industrial supplies and B2B procurement. We are a channel partner of KARAM and offer products from other reputed industrial brands across safety and PPE, welding supplies, tools, MRO consumables and electrical items. We help factories and businesses meet their procurement needs through reliable sourcing, competitive pricing, specification compliance and timely delivery.
The role
Own an assigned client portfolio from requirement understanding and vendor sourcing through quotation, order execution and collection follow-up. Develop new industrial accounts through planned outreach and plant visits. Success means profitable repeat business, reliable service and complete commercial records.
Responsibilities
Understand RFQs, technical specifications, brands, models, quantities, units, delivery deadlines and client purchase procedures; obtain clarification before quoting.
Find suitable OEMs and verified suppliers, compare equivalent offers and negotiate purchase prices, freight, lead times, warranty and payment terms.
Prepare accurate cost comparisons and client quotations; distinguish markup from margin and obtain approval for pricing, credit or specification exceptions.
Follow up on quotations and customer POs, confirm approved purchase orders and coordinate stock, QC, dispatch, delivery, GRN or POD and invoice documentation.
Maintain professional client and vendor relationships and coordinate receivable follow-up with the billing team. Record commitments and escalate overdue or disputed cases promptly.


Responsibilities continued
Identify new manufacturing accounts, arrange procurement or maintenance meetings, support vendor registration and develop repeat opportunities in the assigned territory.
Update the company CRM daily with requirement lines, quote versions, approved commercials, documents, owners, next actions and due dates.
Use approved company communication channels; protect pricing and commercial information, disclose conflicts of interest and maintain an auditable transaction trail.
What you should bring
2 to 5 years in industrial B2B sales, MRO distribution, technical sales or procurement with substantial customer interaction. Strong candidates with directly relevant experience will be considered.
Practical sourcing and sales exposure to industrial consumables, safety products, welding, tools, electrical or mechanical items; ability to learn unfamiliar specifications.
Evidence of quotations handled, vendor negotiation, repeat accounts developed and sales or purchase portfolios managed. Use anonymised examples rather than another employer's confidential records.
Working knowledge of GST quotation basics, purchase and sales orders, delivery terms and credit discipline; comfort with Excel or Sheets, email and a CRM.
Clear written English and confident client communication in Hindi; Punjabi is helpful. Willingness to visit clients in the Tricity, Dera Bassi, Baddi and nearby industrial areas.
A diploma or degree in engineering, commerce or business is preferred. Relevant practical experience is more important than a particular qualification.
How performance will be measured
Agreed billing and contribution targets after a defined ramp-up; new and repeat customer development; quotation turnaround; collection follow-up; order accuracy; and CRM completeness. Incentives are linked to eligible collected contribution and recorded growth, under a written policy.
Selection and growth
The selection process includes a discussion of relevant experience, a short simulated RFQ and quotation exercise, and reference checks with your consent. The role offers the opportunity to develop into an account lead as portfolio performance and responsibility grow.
Apply
Apply through the job posting with your CV, current location, notice period, expected fixed salary, product categories handled and an anonymised example of your sales or procurement responsibilities. Do not submit confidential client lists or vendor rate sheets.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

AboutLenskart With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

AbouttheRole The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks, dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

ResponsibilitiesAreaActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartOptometristCustomerfocus:
DrivingNetPromoterScore Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer hasFollowing the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Eyecheck-up&dispensing Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer Productrecommendation Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
AchievingsalesVs.Plan&SOPadherence Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment
Storeupkeep&maintenance regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies Minimum qualification: Diploma/ Bachelors in Optometry Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions. Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
