Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Key Responsibilities:
Greet customers warmly as they enter the store, engaging them in conversation and understanding their eyewear needs.
Assist customers in selecting eyeglasses, sunglasses, and contact lenses, providing product information, recommendations, and demonstrations as needed.
Use product knowledge and sales techniques to upsell and cross-sell products, maximizing sales opportunities.
Process customer transactions accurately and efficiently, including cash handling, credit card transactions, and billing inquiries.
Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store environment, ensuring that merchandise is properly displayed and priced.
Perform regular inventory checks, restock shelves, and assist with merchandise deliveries as needed.
Address customer concerns and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner, escalating to management as necessary.
Stay updated on product offerings, promotions, and company policies to provide accurate information to customers.
Collaborate with team members to achieve sales targets, meet customer service goals, and ensure the overall success of the store.

Qualifications:
High school diploma or equivalent.
Previous retail or customer service experience is preferred but not required.
Friendly and outgoing personality with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Customer-focused mindset with a willingness to go above and beyond to meet customer needs.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and multitask with attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle challenging situations with professionalism and tact.
Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

Description:
About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks, dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
Responsibilities
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Following the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions

He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Description:
About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation

Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence

He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to be per formed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net Promoter Score Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs. Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership plan Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company development training modules
(Attrition Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to Control) execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Cash & Inventory Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stock takes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions management are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues
Supervision are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality
standards
Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
SOP adherence & implementation Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other
Store upkeep & maintenance equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Graduate
Ability to act as a link between strategy and execution
Ability to develop and inspire people to achieve their best
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand stated and unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to a changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
Job Description - Agency Frontline Sales Role
Band- 1
CTC- Up to 3.5 lakh rupees
JOB SUMMARY: To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency to achieve sales productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners. Recruit, Coach, Mentor, Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to onboarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re-activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through company's sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors' offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE:
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills
Competency- Result Orientation Definition- Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)
Skillset required- Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation Definition- Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets
Skillset required- Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services
Skillset required- Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values
Skillset required- Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior
Competency - People and Team Leadership
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required- Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support
Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition- Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Management and Support (Specialized in Laboratory, Physiology, and Rehabilitation Equipment)
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 6 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Medical Electronic or Electronic or Biomedical Engineering.
-Certifications or training in laboratory or rehabilitation equipment preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum 15 years of professional experience in managing laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation-related equipment, with at least 5 completed projects.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 3 projects.
-Hands-on experience in the installation, calibration, and basic maintenance of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
Role Responsibilities:
Equipment Installation Calibration:
-Lead the installation, setup, and calibration of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment at MSSSCRC.
-Ensure that equipment is installed according to specifications and regulatory standards, meeting safety and performance requirements.
-Conduct initial testing to verify the functionality of newly installed equipment, making adjustments as necessary to optimize performance.
Compliance and Quality Assurance:
-Perform routine checks and inspections to ensure that equipment continues to meet operational standards and regulatory requirements.
-Monitor equipment performance, ensuring it adheres to safety and operational regulations in line with national and international standards.
-Assist in compliance audits and support the creation of reports to document adherence to health regulations.
Troubleshooting Technical Support:
-Provide technical troubleshooting support for any malfunctioning laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation equipment.
-Offer quick resolutions for minor issues and escalate complex technical problems to senior specialists or vendors for further investigation and resolution.
-Diagnose equipment faults and recommend corrective actions to maintain optimal functionality.
Training MSSSCRC Staff on Equipment Use Maintenance:
-Develop and deliver training programs for MSSSCRC staff (clinical, technical, and administrative) on the correct use, handling, and safety protocols for laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Conduct hands-on training sessions to ensure staff are proficient in operating the equipment, including detailed instructions on how to maintain and troubleshoot the equipment.
-Create training materials and user manuals tailored to the equipment, ensuring that staff have clear, accessible guides for reference.
-Assess staff competency in operating the equipment and provide additional guidance or refresher courses as necessary to ensure staff confidence and safety in equipment handling.
-Provide specialized training in equipment calibration, regular maintenance tasks, and how to perform troubleshooting for common issues.
Record Maintenance Reporting:
-Maintain accurate and detailed records of equipment installation, servicing, and performance, ensuring that all equipment data is properly documented and accessible.
-Track service histories, calibration schedules, and any repairs or modifications made to the equipment.
-Assist in preparing periodic reports on equipment status, including any issues identified, actions taken, and overall performance evaluation.
-Coordination with Senior Specialists Vendors:
-Collaborate with senior specialists and vendors to manage upgrades, repairs, and replacements of equipment.
-Coordinate with vendors to procure spare parts and ensure that all equipment remains functional throughout the project duration.
-Ensure timely maintenance schedules are followed to minimize equipment downtime and avoid disruptions in medical services.
Project Support Management:
-Assist in the management of project timelines, ensuring that equipment-related tasks such as installation, calibration, and maintenance are completed on schedule.
-Support project teams in planning and procuring equipment, ensuring that equipment specifications meet the project s healthcare requirements.
-Provide guidance and technical input in the planning phase for procurement of new laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
Safety Operational Efficiency:
-Conduct regular safety checks to ensure that all equipment complies with health and safety regulations and operates efficiently.
-Evaluate the operational efficiency of equipment and recommend improvements or upgrades when necessary.
-Ensure that all equipment is safely decommissioned or disposed of at the end of its useful life.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Cost Expert
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 4 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Biomedical Engineering/Medical electronics or Electronic.
-Certifications in cost analysis or financial planning preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum of 15 years of experience in cost analysis of medical equipment or related fields.
-At least 7 years of experience in the medical or healthcare sector.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 2 projects.
-Experience working on Japanese ODA Loan Projects in any sector.
-At least 1 year of experience in SAARC or ASEAN regions (preferable).
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
-Strong knowledge of procurement processes and cost optimization techniques.

Role Responsibilities:
Cost Estimation Budgeting:
-Lead the estimation of preliminary project equipment costs during the basic design phase, ensuring accurate forecasting of all associated costs.
-Develop cost models and prepare detailed cost estimates for medical equipment procurement and installation.
-Identify and quantify the costs related to equipment, components, consumables, transportation, and installation work, ensuring that the budget is comprehensive and aligned with project objectives.
Survey Data Collection:
-Conduct surveys of existing or similar healthcare facilities to gather information on operational and maintenance costs of medical equipment.
-Assess the existing equipment in operational facilities to understand their functionality, lifespan, and associated costs to make informed decisions.
-Collect data on the cost of spare parts, consumables, and other supplies necessary for the proper functioning of medical equipment.
Evaluation of Local Distributors Service Providers:
-Survey local distributors for warranty services, maintenance contract availability, and pricing.
-Evaluate the reliability and service offerings of local vendors, ensuring they meet the operational needs of the project and provide cost-effective maintenance solutions.
Cost Breakdown Analysis:
-Collect and analyze detailed data on equipment-related costs, including main components, consumables, transportation costs, turnkey work, maintenance contracts, and other related services.
-Ensure a thorough understanding of all cost components and provide a comprehensive cost breakdown for each equipment item.
-Collaborate with procurement teams to optimize cost-efficiency and select the best value options for the project.
Tender Evaluation Compliance:
-Assist the Project Management Unit (PMU) in evaluating financial documents related to equipment tenders, ensuring that the costs are in line with the project s financial goals.
-Review tender submissions for compliance with project specifications, budget constraints, and cost-effectiveness.
-Provide recommendations on cost optimization and value for money, ensuring that all financial aspects of the tender align with project needs.
Cost Reporting Documentation:
-Prepare and maintain detailed reports on cost estimations, budgets, and financial evaluations related to medical equipment.
-Ensure that all cost reports are accurately documented and available for review by the project team and stakeholders.
-Track and report any changes in cost projections, identifying areas where cost savings or adjustments can be made.
Collaboration with Project Stakeholders:
-Work closely with the project team, including procurement specialists and clinical engineers, to align equipment cost management with overall project goals.
-Provide regular updates on cost estimations, procurement strategies, and cost optimization efforts to senior management and stakeholders.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Description:
Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodical improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.
Requirements
Desirable Attributes: Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Flexibility to travel extensively within the assigned region.

Job Purpose: 
The Location - Head plays a key role in supporting the organizations goals by leading collections operations and driving recovery of overdue home loan accounts. Working within the Collections/Recovery Department, the role focuses on managing field teams, achieving targets, ensuring compliance, and coordinating with agencies and internal stakeholders. It is critical in reducing delinquency and minimizing losses.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead, manage, and supervise multiple On-Field Collection Managers across the assigned location.

Formulate and execute collection strategies at the location level in line with organizational goals.
Monitor portfolio health, identify high-risk accounts, and ensure effective action plans are implemented.
Ensure adherence to company policies, RBI guidelines, and regulatory compliance in all collection practices.
Coordinate with external collection agencies and vendors for recovery support.
Track and report performance metrics, portfolio trends, and recovery progress to Zonal/National Heads.
Provide regular training, mentoring, and motivation to on-field managers to enhance efficiency and professionalism.
Handle escalated customer issues and resolve disputes effectively to protect customer relationships and brand reputation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Operations, Legal, Risk, Sales) for resolution of complex or chronic cases and drive team performance through regular reviews and structured reporting.
Skills Required:
Strong leadership and people management skills.
Strategic thinking with ability to drive performance across multiple teams.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution abilities.
Data-driven approach with strong analytical and reporting skills.
High customer orientation with focus on compliance and ethical collection practices.
Educational Qualifications and Experience:
Minimum Qualification: Graduate
7–12 years of experience in loan collections, with at least 3–5 years in a managerial role leading teams.
Experience in home loan or secured loan collections preferred.

Job Title: SAP BTP & Cloud Administrator
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore / Indore
Total Experience: 1012 years
Notice Period: Immediate joiner
Job Summary
We are looking for a senior SAP BTP Administrator to own the administration of SAP Business Technology Platform across our customer landscapes. The primary focus is BTP: global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, identity and access, connectivity and cloud-native runtimes. The role also carries SAP Basis and database administration responsibilities for the on-premise and hybrid systems that BTP connects to. The ideal candidate combines deep BTP operations experience with a solid Basis background and can work across cloud and on-premise SAP.
Responsibilities
SAP BTP Administration (primary focus)
Set up and govern the BTP global account structure: directories, subaccounts, and naming and tagging standards across development, test and production.
Manage entitlements, quotas and cost tracking, and raise capacity requests in line with project demand.
Administer Cloud Foundry orgs and spaces and Kyma environments, including deployments, service instances and runtime health.
Manage identity and access: trust configuration with SAP Cloud Identity Services and corporate identity providers, role collections, role templates and least-privilege access reviews.
Configure and maintain connectivity: Destinations, Cloud Connector setup and high availability, and private connectivity to on-premise systems.
Administer SAP HANA Cloud instances, SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Build and Work Zone as required by the customer landscape.
Manage BTP transports and content movement through Cloud Transport Management.
Monitor services, audit logs and alerts; set up and maintain BTP audit log retention.
Maintain the BTP CLI and automation scripts for repeatable provisioning and housekeeping.
SAP Basis Administration (secondary)
Perform day-to-day Basis administration across development, test and production systems.
Handle system monitoring, performance tuning and optimization for ABAP and HANA systems.
Manage user administration, security, authorizations and transport management between systems.
Plan and execute OSS note implementation, BDLS, system copies, client copies and refreshes.
Support SAP HANA upgrades and perform post-upgrade checks.
Provide Basis expertise during project cutovers and ensure stability through critical transition periods.
Database Administration (secondary)
Administer database instances supporting SAP systems, including backup and recovery, space management and housekeeping.
Monitor database performance, identify and resolve bottlenecks, and tune configurations.
Plan and execute database patching, version upgrades and migrations with minimal downtime.
Maintain database security, access controls and disaster recovery procedures, and test them periodically.
Communication and Documentation
Maintain clear documentation of configurations, changes, runbooks and procedures.
Communicate with project teams, stakeholders and end users, and provide regular status and health reports.
Work with customers to define BTP governance, onboarding and operating models.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
10–12 years of experience in SAP technical administration, with at least 4 years in SAP BTP administration.
Hands-on experience with BTP global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, Cloud Foundry and role-based access control.
Experience with Cloud Connector, Destinations and connectivity to on-premise SAP systems (ECC, S/4HANA, BW, CRM, SCM).
Strong working knowledge of SAP NetWeaver and SAP HANA, including HANA Cloud.
Solid SAP Basis experience: monitoring, transports, user administration, OSS notes, BDLS, system copies and HANA upgrades.
Working knowledge of database administration for SAP-supported databases (backup, recovery, performance and patching).
Familiarity with cutover processes and Basis support during critical project phases.
Strong problem-solving skills and clear written and verbal communication.
Ability to work independently and lead a team.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP BTP certification (for example, SAP Certified Technology Associate, SAP BTP) or SAP Basis certification.
Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Services and SAP Integration Suite.
Experience with Kyma, Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tooling for BTP.
Scripting skills in Shell, Python or the BTP CLI.
Familiarity with ITIL service management frameworks.
Experience with hyperscaler landscapes (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud) under BTP.

At HGS our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.

Description:
Responsibilities
Responsible for overall branch operations, performance & profitability of the branch.
Drive & participate in field marketing activities with the team to improve branch visibility.
Plan, conduct & monitor the branch & field level marketing activities to ensure healthy pipeline of leads resulting in business conversion & branch growth.
Focus on customer engagement & appraisal of gold ornaments being pledged in branch with correct weight & purity assessment as per company policy and auditory compliance.
Joint custodian of the Vault with responsibility of safekeeping of pledge ornaments as per company policy.
Verify customer KYC documents, application requests and initiate loan disbursals.
Process foreclosure, part release, closure, interest payment transactions based on customer requests.
Authorize transactions for disbursal, foreclosure, release and accept customer payments.
Responsible for keeping NPAs in control through strong follow-ups from customers for interest collections.
Good planning abilities are required for smooth functioning of the branch & for developing cohesiveness within the company and co-workers.
Hiring, coaching, mentoring and training employees and providing them with timely feedback on their performance.
Maintaining quality & performance of the business, preparing various reports of the same and take necessary actions for growth of business in branch.
Increase gold loan business plus various other third-party products.
Responsible for correct valuation & maintenance of 100% process compliance at branch.
Manage error-free valuation & appraisal of gold ornaments being pledged in branch with correct weight & purity assessment as per company policy and auditory compliance.
Qualifications
7+ years of Product / Sales experience in Gold loan or other Asset products
Post Graduate Degree in MBA or Equivalent
Skills
KYC verification
Loan disbursal processing
Foreclosure & closure transactions
Customer payments authorization
Gold valuation & appraisal
Audit & compliance
Field marketing
Team mentoring and training
NPAs follow-up and collection

Process all guest check-ins, verifying guest identity, form of payment, assigning room, and activating/issuing room key.
Set up accurate accounts for each guest according to their requirements.
Enter Marriott Rewards information.
Ensure rates match market codes, document exceptions.
Secure payment prior to issuing room key, verify/adjust billing.
Compile and review daily reports/logs/contingency lists.
Complete cashier and closing reports.
Supply guests with directions and property information.
Accommodate guest requests, contacting appropriate staff if necessary.
Follow up to ensure requests have been met.

Balance and drop receipts.
Count and secure bank at beginning and end of shift.

Welcome and acknowledge guests; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation.
Speak using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette.
Ensure adherence to quality standards.
Enter and locate information using computers/POS systems.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

FB and Event Service Expert
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a banquet or event.

Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.

6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Title: Team Leader Channel

Channel Programs
1. Execution of unit specific initiatives in E&D, Grocery, and Convenience channel as per plan shared

5. Execution and portfolio management as per the plan shared
Across depots & distributors
1. Execution of local initiatives
2. Tracking of systems and evaluation process
3. Local Initiatives to scale up the national/regional program
Analysis and Reporting
1. Activation as per RED / DEEP RED to do list.

3. Tracking of competition activities
4. Ensure activation in market through analysis RSA data
Supervises: None
Direct Reports: None
Geographical Scope:

Key Customers:
Internal Customers: Sales Team at the Unit, Finance, RTM
External Customers: Vendors, Suppliers, Distributors, Key Accounts, Agencies, Customers
Job Requirements:
Qualifications: Graduation/M.B.A.
Experience: 4-8 Years
Functional Skills:
Customer Management (a)-Competent
Financial Knowledge / Application and Appreciation (a)- Working Knowledge
Market Execution (a)-Competent
Planning and Analytics (b)-Working Knowledge
Sales Management (b)-Working Knowledge
Travel: Above 75%

Submit all compliance, audit, incident, and performance reports accurately and on time

Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Architecture: Design end-to-end data ecosystems using Data Mesh or Medallion patterns.
Technical Authority: Hands on knowledge in BigQuery and Dataflow/Dataproc ETL design and automation using workflows or Airflow, Should be able to efficiently do RCA using logging and monitoring tools.

FinOps Strategy: Own the BigQuery Reservation strategy and optimize multi-million dollar cloud budgets.

Team Leadership: Mentor Senior Engineers and define the technical standard for the entire practice. Participate in design discussions, code review, production deployment planning/cutover, data discovery sessions
Modernization Lead: Drive large-scale migrations from legacy on-prem systems to GCP Native solutions. Experience with third party data ingestion to GCP BQ/GCS

Education:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field;

Experience: 12+ years in Data Engineering, with 5+ years of specialized experience in Google Cloud.

AI/ML: Familiarity with operationalizing ML models via BigQuery ML and Vertex AI Pipelines (optional).
Ecosystem: Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, and proficiency in Terraform/Cloudbuild/docker, CI/CD pipelines.
Certification: Professional Data Engineer (GCP) is mandatory.
Tools: Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines building for automated code deployments.

Description:
MIS Executive
Job Title-MIS Executive
Location-Patna -Raipur-Lucknow-Bhubaneshwar-Bhopal

Experience -3--4 Years of Work Experience Preferably in Real Estate Projects
Reporting To-Management / Finance Head / State Head
Coordination With-Finance, Accounts, Sales, Project Teams, and Vendors

MIS REPORTING • PROJECT MONITORING • FINANCIAL TRACKING • DATA ANALYSIS
1. Role Overview
The MIS Executive is responsible for collecting, consolidating, verifying and analysing operational and financial information from relevant departments and project teams and converting it into accurate MIS reports, financial trackers, project dashboards and performance summaries for management review. The role supports management decision making by monitoring project wise budgets, actual expenses, cash flows, cost variations, vendor payments, outstanding dues and receivables. It requires strong Excel and data management skills, timely coordination with Finance, Accounts, Sales and Project Teams, and disciplined follow-up to ensure reliable reporting and clear visibility of project and business performance.
2. Professional Skills
Minimum 3-4 years of MIS experience, preferably in real estate or a project based business.
Advanced MS Excel skills, including Pivot Tables and VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.
Knowledge of budgeting, project costing, and cash flow tracking.
Strong analytical, reporting, and data-management skills.
Proficiency in MS Word and PowerPoint.
Good communication, coordination, and problem solving abilities.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet reporting deadlines.
Knowledge of Power BI or ERP systems will be an advantage.
3. Roles and Responsibilities
A. MIS Reporting & Analysis
Prepare daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports, dashboards and performance summaries for management.
Collect, consolidate and analyse data from Finance, Accounts, Sales, Project Teams and other relevant departments to ensure accurate reporting.
Identify trends, discrepancies, delays and variances in reported data and highlight key findings to management.
Maintain reporting schedules and ensure reports are submitted within agreed timelines.
Prepare clear summaries and comparisons so management can quickly identify pending items and areas requiring attention.
B. Financial & Project Monitoring
Monitor project wise budgets, actual expenses, cash flows and cost variations using information supplied by the responsible teams.
Maintain trackers for vendor payments, outstanding dues, receivables and project expenditure.
Coordinate with Finance and Accounts teams to obtain timely updates on financial information and clarify discrepancies.
Compare budgeted figures with actual expenditure where data is available, flag variances and follow up with the concerned team for explanations.
Coordinate with project teams to collect updates on project progress, expenditure and pending activities for management reporting.
C. Data Management & Documentation
Maintain and update project databases, Excel sheets, MIS trackers, dashboards and standard reporting formats.
Verify data accuracy, consistency and completeness, and follow up with concerned departments to resolve discrepancies.

Lead emergency preparedness, crisis response, business continuity and reinforcement readiness to address security threats and unforeseen situations.
Give suggestions for process improvement across Security, Transport, Vigilance and Administration based on audit findings, incident learnings and user feedback.
Drive digitalisation roadmap – convert manual records and processes (gate passes, visitor and vehicle entries, guard rosters, patrol and incident logs, transport logs, canteen, colony allotment and complaints) into digital systems with dashboards and MIS.
Execution

Oversee security operations across the plant, gates, colony and ancillary areas, including manpower deployment, access control, material movement controls and asset protection.
Lead incident handling, investigation, scene preservation, root cause analysis, recordkeeping and implementation of preventive actions.
Conduct a daily security review covering previous-day incidents, gate/access exceptions, manpower deployment and pending actions; close observations on time.
Lead preventive vigilance across three areas – premises vigilance, plant vigilance and manpower vigilance (with special focus on contract workers, including verification of credentials) – to ensure smooth plant working and monitor threats, pilferage and malpractices.
Manage employee and official transport operations – route planning, vehicle fitness and documentation, driver compliance, trip scheduling and availability of vehicles.
Supervise security and administrative arrangements for plant events, VIP visits, national celebrations and other official programmes.
Oversee canteen operations – food quality, hygiene, menu planning, caterer performance and employee feedback.
Oversee housekeeping and gardening/horticulture services to maintain cleanliness, sanitation and aesthetics across the plant and colony.
Oversee township / JSW Dhar Colony and Estate Office operations including allotment, complaint resolution, infrastructure monitoring, hygiene, sanitation, asset management and upkeep.
Ensure effective functioning of the occupational health centre and support services (administrative and logistical support, ambulance/transport readiness, upkeep).
Supervise maintenance planning and upkeep of critical infrastructure and security equipment within the plant and township.
Hold periodic review meetings with Location HR Head on security, vigilance, transport and administration performance, key risks, budget utilisation and action plans.
Governance

Oversee compliance with human rights requirements, PoSH Act provisions, environmental norms, food safety (FSSAI) norms and security procedures.
Handle internal and external audits (security, administration, statutory, vendor and system audits) – ensure audit readiness, timely closure of observations and sustained compliance.
Support safety compliance in the areas under the role – PPE compliance checks at gates, vehicle and traffic safety, fire and emergency response support, and safety norms in canteen, housekeeping and township – in coordination with the Safety HOD, who owns plant safety.
Direct handling and disposal of occupational health centre, canteen and domestic waste in accordance with applicable guidelines.
Govern vendor selection and evaluation, agreements, invoice verification, budget utilisation controls and service compliance prior to approval and payment processing.
Review all POs and the vendor master data on a timely basis; initiate renewal approval at least 2 months before expiry of any PO/contract, and maintain a tracker for the same (validity, expiry date, renewal status, approval stage).
Track all vendor payments to ensure submitted invoices are processed on time by the Accounts / GBS team and payments are released as per terms; escalate any delay in a timely manner and follow up until the loop is closed.
Monitor vendor service quality periodically through performance reviews and feedback; where a vendor’s quality deteriorates or is downgraded, prepare the documentation (performance gaps, evidence, alternatives) and propose replacement to management, and discuss new vendor development with the Commercial team.
Carry out timely self-audits of own and team responsibilities to ensure no loopholes or gaps remain, and close identified gaps with corrective actions.
Oversee implementation and periodic review of security SOPs, investigation protocols, intelligence procedures and incident response guidelines.
People

Supervise manpower deployment and rotation to ensure continuity of security, transport and administration services.
Oversee workforce awareness and training for effective implementation of security and safety procedures, including participation in mock drills and safety trainings arranged by the Safety team.
Coordinate with Operations, HR, Compliance, Safety and Finance teams to support security and administrative requirements; build and develop the reporting team.
Technology

Oversee the utilisation and operational readiness of CCTV systems, access control devices, communication equipment and surveillance tools.
Supervise surveillance report analysis and monitoring to identify suspected threats and security risks.
Oversee the availability, functionality and maintenance of security equipment.
Implement and sustain digital tools and workflows for security, transport, canteen and township service management, replacing manual registers and paper-based processes.
Disclaimer: The above job duties are not exhaustive and may vary on the discretion of the reporting manager.
Qualifications and Work Experience
Educational Background

Graduate in any discipline; preferably with MBA / PG Diploma in HR, Administration, Security Management or Industrial Safety. Ex-Defence / Armed Forces graduates with relevant plant experience may also be considered.
Work Experience

8–12 years of relevant experience in a large manufacturing plant across Security, Vigilance, Transport and/or Plant Administration, including at least 3–4 years in a team-handling role.
Technical Skills and Competencies
Technical Skills
Industrial Security Management, Vigilance & Investigation, Security Audit & Surveillance Systems, Audit Handling & Compliance Closure, Digitalisation of Records & Processes, Transport & Fleet Management, Facilities, Township & Estate Management, Canteen, Housekeeping & Horticulture Management, Occupational Health Centre Support, Event Management, Vendor & Contract Management, Budgeting & Cost Control, Grievance Redressal & Discipline Management, POSH Compliance Framework, Industrial Safety Fundamentals (LOTO, LTFIR, HIRA, JSAP, DuPont, JSW Critical Safety Rules), Fire Safety & Emergency Response Systems, Utility Infrastructure Systems, Weapon & Ammunition Handling, Radio Telephony & Communication Protocols, Incident Response & Mock Drill Management, Compliance Certificate & License Management
Behavioral Competencies
Accountability & Ownership, Problem Solving & Decision Making, Teamwork & Collaboration, Innovation & Continuous Improvement, Leadership Presence, Strategic Thinking, Learning Agility
Please refer to the Technical and Behavioral Competency Dictionaries for more details
Working Relationships – Stakeholders
Internal:
Location HR Head, Plant Head, Operations & Maintenance, Safety HOD / EHS, Finance, Commercial & Procurement, IT, Legal & Compliance, Corporate HR/Admin/Security, Township residents & employees

External:
Security, transport, canteen, housekeeping and gardening vendors, Local Police, District Administration, Fire Department, Food Safety & other statutory authorities, Event/Hospitality service providers

Job Title: Video Editor YouTube
Experience Required
2-4 Years
Job Location
Work from Office - Pondicherry / Bangalore
Job Summary
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Video Editor with 24 years of experience in editing YouTube content. The ideal candidate should be proficient in creating engaging long-form and short-form videos, understand audience retention techniques, and be fluent in Tamil to effectively edit and review Tamil-language content.

Edit YouTube videos, reels, shorts, and promotional content.
Create engaging storytelling through video editing, motion graphics, transitions, and sound design.
Optimize videos for audience engagement and retention.
Collaborate with content creators, scriptwriters, and production teams.
Add subtitles, captions, graphics, and visual effects as required.
Ensure timely delivery of high-quality video content.
Maintain brand consistency across all video assets.
Manage and organize video files, raw footage, and project assets.
Required Skills
2–4 years of professional video editing experience.
Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or similar editing tools.
Strong understanding of YouTube content formats and platform trends.
Experience in editing Tamil-language content.
Ability to create thumbnails and basic motion graphics is an added advantage.
Good communication and teamwork skills.

Must be fluent in Tamil (Read, Write, and Speak).
Must be willing to work from the office.
Strong portfolio showcasing YouTube or digital content editing work.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with YouTube creators, digital media companies, or content production houses.
Knowledge of YouTube SEO, audience retention metrics, and content optimization.

Description:
Internship Trainee

Location: Chennai, Pondicherry, Erode
Role Purpose
The Customer Service Officer (Internship Trainee) will be responsible for managing customer service operations for unsecured lending products while undergoing structured rotational training across service desk, complaint management, regulatory grievance handling, and quality functions.
The role is designed to build a strong compliance-oriented, customer-centric operations leader for future managerial responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities
1. Service Desk Operations
Handle inbound customer interactions related to loan applications, disbursement, EMI servicing, foreclosure, and account queries
Ensure high First Call Resolution (FCR) and adherence to defined Turnaround Time (TAT)
Maintain accurate call documentation in CRM/system
Deliver consistent customer experience aligned with company standards
Register and track customer complaints in the system
Maintain proper documentation for audit and inspection purposes
2. Regulatory & Compliance Adherence
Strict adherence to RBI guidelines and internal policies
Ensure zero tolerance toward mis-leading information or incorrect commitments
Maintain audit-ready documentation of customer communication
Escalate sensitive cases to Nodal / Grievance Officer as per defined escalation matrix
3. Customer Experience & Process Improvement
Identify recurring service gaps and suggest corrective actions
Support implementation of process improvement initiatives
Contribute to service quality enhancement programs

Training & Rotational Exposure (1218 Months)
The InternshipTrainee will undergo structured exposure to:
Service Desk Operations
Welcome Calling
Complaint Desk & Escalation Handling
Regulatory Grievance Management
Quality & Training Function
MIS & Process Governance
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
First Call Resolution (FCR)
Average Handling Time (AHT)
Complaint TAT Compliance
Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
Audit & Compliance Score
Zero Regulatory Deviations
Qualification
Graduate (MBA in Finance / Operations / Marketing preferred)
02 years of relevant experience (Fresh MBA candidates may apply)
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Analytical and problem-solving ability
Customer-centric approach
Compliance-driven mindset
Ability to handle pressure and escalations professionally
Working knowledge of CRM systems

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has

returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently

Store upkeep & maintenance

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. Sales Leadership:

- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above

- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Strong analyticaland decision-making skills.
Knowledge ofretail lending credit policies and scorecards.
Proficiency indigital KYC, fraud control, and MIS tools.
Attention todetail and compliance orientation.
Educational Qualifications and Experience:
Graduate /Post-Graduate in Finance, Commerce, or related field.
13 years incredit appraisal/underwriting; experience in digital/fintech lending preferred.

Description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesnt stop there. Were developing breakthrough technology to power the worlds future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Put your talent to work with us.

Application specific MCU industrial (ASM-IND) product line offers a broad range of high performance, innovative and cost-effective specialized MCUs for a wide range of applications across Motor control and Digital power. We enable powering next generation AI datacenters, provide motor control solutions for Humanoids, robotics, etc., build AI solutions for predictive diagnostics, improve performance, control and optimize energy efficiency.
We are looking for an application engineer who has the passion and excitement to continuously learn, innovate, take an active role in solving real time control. It is a fast paced, results driven environment requiring Microcontroller knowledge, system level understanding, software development, Motor control algorithms and system hardware skillsets. You will collaborate with worldwide accounts to solve their system challenges, enable them to go to market faster, work with marketing and business leadership to develop strategic technical solutions to enable TI business growth and impact the next generation of products.
Key responsibilities include:
Develop sensored and sensor less motor control algorithms to enable faster response, Smoother speed, less acoustic noise
Own specific IP s write technical reference manual, resolve customer issues through E2E platform and field engagement
Participate in customer calls to understand system requirements and help select the right devices and reference designs
Support customer design-in activities by:
Adapting our system reference solutions to their custom hardware design.
Meet customer across the globe to promote our technical benefits and resolve technical issues / Debug
Schematic and layout review of customer solutions for our device
Help with software porting, optimize software to improve performance.
Resolve production stop issues for customers
Design EVM and internal evaluation boards to support evaluation activities of new products.
Train Field Applications Engineers and customers on ASM Microcontrollers and reference designs
Write application notes and training collateral that explain features, implementation of motor control on ASM Microcontrollers.
Qualifications
Minimum requirements:
Master s degree in Electrical Engineering or related degree
3 years of application/system engineering experience
Motor control algorithm development
Strong knowledge of Microcontrollers
Experience in embedded C software development
Solid hardware and software debugging skills

Preferred qualifications:
PHD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Electrical Drive Systems
Hands-on experience working in motor control algorithm development
Knowledge on Matlab, Simulink and Plexim for simulation and model-based code generation
Digital control system design
Familiarity with field bus communication
Power electronic system design
Knowledge on functional safety, security and artificial intelligence
Ability to review schematics and PCB layout using CAD tools
Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
Self-driven and ability to take initiative and drive for results
Continuous learning mindset
Ability to produce high quality technical documentation
Good communication skillset to interface with customers and Field Applications Engineers

Job description
Gold Plus Group Company Profile
Gold Plus Group is the second-largest glass manufacturing company in India, headquartered at Kings Mall, Rohini, Delhi. The Group operates Float Glass and Solar Glass manufacturing plants at Roorkee (Uttarakhand) and Kanagala, Belagavi (Karnataka), along with a processing plant at Kala Amb (Himachal Pradesh).
With a strong sales presence across India, the Group has an annual turnover of approximately INR 3,500 crore and a workforce of over 4,000 employees.

Website: goldplusgroup.com

Position Details:
Designation: Area Sales Manager (ASM)
Department: Sales & Marketing
Qualification: MBA (Regular)
Experience: Relevant experience in Sales / Channel Sales / Business Development
Location: Puducherry, Tirunelveli, Mangaluru, Trichy, Tirupati

Role & Responsibilities:
Manage and strengthen relationships with existing business associates and channel partners.
Identify, onboard, and develop new business associates within the assigned territory.
Drive business development and achieve assigned sales targets in tonnage.
Ensure timely collection of receivables and maintain healthy outstanding levels.
Coordinate with the Accounts team for reconciliation and resolution of discrepancies.
Build strong customer relationships and strengthen the company's brand presence.
Handle customer queries, complaints, and service-related issues effectively.
Guide and monitor the performance of Marketing Executives (MEs) reporting to the role.
Work closely with the RM/GM and take up additional responsibilities as required.

Requirements:
MBA (Regular) is mandatory.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Experience in channel sales, dealer/distributor management or business development preferred.
Strong customer relationship and negotiation skills.
Good understanding of the assigned market/territory.
Leadership and team-management abilities.
Target-oriented and result-driven approach.
Willingness to travel within the assigned territory.

Any other similar duties as and when specified by the manager

On time service planning with ZERO pending services every month
Monitoring SCP active devices & Usage on weekly basis
Minimum expectancy on SCP active device(100%) & usage >95%
Achieving progressive improvement in State of Service (SOS) and meet SOS targets assigned by the branch
Minimizing service backlog (meet our contractual obligations)

Be decisive
Attention to details and accuracy
Planning & organizing
Analytical skills
Customer oriented
Negotiation skills
Ability to work patiently in a dynamic service environment

Basic computer skills - for reporting/work management (Advanced computer skills would be an added advantage)
Communication - speaking on phone to external customers & internally with technicians, other Operations colleagues.
Knowledge of territory which is handled for planning
Occasional Travel required within the Division
Liaise with the Operations Manager, Operations Executive, Service Supervisors to establish service requirements and provide information, assurance and advice as required
Communicate all service issues in a timely manner to the ABM/BM, Operations Manager

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Team Management
Lead, guide, and monitor the Customer Relationship Executive (CRE) team.
Allocate daily tasks and ensure timely completion of assigned activities.
Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews.
Train and motivate team members to achieve departmental targets.
2. Customer Relationship Management
Maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
Ensure timely responses to customer queries, requests, and concerns.
Handle escalated customer complaints and ensure effective resolution.
Monitor customer satisfaction and identify opportunities to improve service quality.
3. Lead Management & Follow-up
Monitor lead generation, lead tracking, and follow-up activities.
Ensure proper scheduling of customer calls, meetings, and appointments.
Track the status of leads and ensure consistent follow-ups by team members.
Coordinate with the sales team to convert qualified leads into business opportunities.
4. Performance Monitoring
Set daily, weekly, and monthly targets for the team.
Monitor team productivity, call reports, follow-ups, and conversion rates.
Prepare and submit performance reports to management.
Identify performance gaps and implement corrective actions.
5. Coordination & Communication
Coordinate with sales, marketing, and other departments to address customer requirements.
Ensure accurate maintenance of customer information and interaction records in the CRM system.
Communicate product updates, offers, and service information to the team.
Ensure professional communication with customers through calls, emails, and other channels.
6. Process Improvement
Develop and implement effective customer relationship management processes.
Identify opportunities to improve customer retention and service efficiency.
Ensure the team follows company policies, procedures, and communication standards.
Provide feedback and recommendations to management for continuous improvement.

Preferred candidate profile
Strong leadership and team management skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Customer handling and conflict-resolution abilities.
Experience in lead management and customer follow-ups.
Knowledge of CRM tools, MS Excel, and reporting.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
