Job Title: US IT Recruiter Fresher to Senior Level
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu, Pondicherry
Experience: 0–5+ Years
Shift: Night Shift – US Staffing
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for US IT Recruiters at different experience levels — Freshers, Junior, Mid-Level, and Senior Recruiters — to join our recruitment team in Salem and Pondicherry.
The role will be assigned based on the candidate's experience, skills, and knowledge of the US IT Staffing process.
Freshers with good communication skills and a strong willingness to learn are welcome to apply. Experienced candidates should have hands-on experience in US IT Recruitment and candidate sourcing.
Key Responsibilities
Source IT professionals using Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, job boards, referrals, and other sourcing platforms.
Understand job descriptions and identify suitable candidates based on client requirements.
Search and identify candidates using Boolean search, keyword search, resume databases, and other sourcing techniques.
Review resumes and shortlist qualified candidates based on technical skills and experience.
Conduct initial candidate screening to assess skills, experience, communication, availability, location, work authorization, and interest.
Communicate job opportunities and requirements clearly to candidates.
Maintain regular communication and follow-up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
Coordinate interviews and follow up on interview feedback.
Negotiate candidate salary/rate expectations within approved guidelines.
Collect required candidate information and documentation.
Submit qualified candidates to clients/account managers within the required timelines.
Maintain accurate candidate records, submissions, interview status, and recruitment activities in the ATS.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified IT professionals.
Meet daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment targets.
Maintain quality submissions and ensure timely completion of recruitment activities.
Experience-Level Expectations
Fresher / Junior (0–2 Years):
Good communication skills and willingness to learn US IT Recruitment.
Learn and perform candidate sourcing, resume screening, candidate calling, and interview coordination.
Previous recruitment experience or internship is an advantage but not mandatory for freshers.
Mid-Level (2–5 Years):
Independently manage assigned US IT recruitment requirements.
Strong experience in sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, submissions, and interview coordination.
Ability to manage multiple requirements and consistently achieve recruitment targets.
Senior Level (5+ Years):
Handle complex, niche, and high-priority US IT requirements independently.
Strong expertise in advanced sourcing, candidate screening, rate negotiation, and candidate management.
Ability to mentor junior recruiters and contribute to team performance and recruitment strategies.
Required Skills
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and candidate engagement skills.
Good analytical and organizational skills.
Ability to work in a target-driven and fast-paced environment.
Basic understanding of IT technologies and technical terminology.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Willingness to work during US business hours / night shift.
Preferred Skills – Experienced Candidates
Hands-on experience in US IT Staffing / US IT Recruitment.
Experience with Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, or similar sourcing platforms.
Knowledge of Boolean search and candidate sourcing techniques.
Understanding of W2, C2C, and 1099 hiring models.
Knowledge of US work authorization and visa categories such as H-1B, OPT, CPT, GC, and USC.
Experience with ATS platforms.
Knowledge of different IT skill sets and technical job requirements.
Experience working with VMS or client/vendor requirements is an advantage.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
MBA HR, B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc., BCA, or other relevant qualifications are preferred.
Freshers are welcome to apply.
Candidate Profile
We are looking for candidates who are:
Interested in building or advancing their career in US IT Staffing.
Good at communication and relationship building.
Willing to work in a night-shift environment aligned with US business hours.
Target-oriented and committed to achieving recruitment goals.
Willing to learn and continuously improve recruitment skills.
Candidates will be considered for the appropriate level based on their experience, skills, and demonstrated recruitment capabilities.

Description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Overview
Service Managers (SM) or Territory Managers (TM) are the frontline owner of fleet quality, safety compliance and ground-level service execution resulting in top-notch customer experience.
Core Responsibilities
Service Quality –
1. Completing daily in-bus inspections and fill the audit form to improve service delivery
2. Own audit score and bus-quality-complaints-per-trip metric, and zero compromise on safety violations
3. Ensure cleanliness, comfort and onboard amenities meet brand standard on every trip
4. Daily coordination with operator staff to get the work done and highlighting improvement areas
5. Calling unhappy customers daily and gather captain & crew feedback to close the loop; resolve issues at the right quality, not just speed
6. Working on reducing customer complaints related to bus condition, cleanliness and safety concerns
 Team Leadership & Accountability -
1. Recruit, train and manage the team of bus captains ensuring grooming standards and timely reporting
2. Own roster planning, week-offs, attendance and attrition control
3. Drive accountability through audits and performance evaluation; log corrective actions against the SOP checklist; keep behavioral complaints under check
4. Deliver on customer engagement targets of customer ratings and in-bus bookings
 Reporting & Continuous Improvement -
1. Own the reports assigned to this role, flag trends and make corrections
2. Monitor service and captain level performance through performance dashboards
3. Bus punctuality reports to be seen daily and making timely schedule/route corrections
4. Log daily checklist of SOPs and ensure team down the line improve on deliverables
 Required Skills & Availability
 Working knowledge of bus systems, fleet maintenance basics and safety regulations
 Proven people-management and training ability for a frontline team
 Composure and firmness enforcing standards under operational pressure, including the authority to hold a bus back from dispatch
 Strong coordination and stakeholder communication — captains, crew, customers and the operator
 Comfortable working late nights and staying reachable off-hours while services are running

Description:
To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency
to achieve sales & productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners.Recruit ,Coach,Mentor,Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity & Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES :
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to on boarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals & performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re- activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through companys sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE :
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English & regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills -
Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Definition-
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Skillset required-
Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior

Competency - People and Team Leadership
Definition-
Communicates a clear vision and strategy for the team to achieve organizational objectives
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required-
Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support

Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition-
Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.
Develops and delivers a compelling value proposition that clearly articulates the career opportunity, compensation, and support structure, effectively influencing and convincing high-potential advisors and partners to join the team.
Skillfully anticipates and manages advisor objections through clear communication, factual evidence, and motivational techniques.
Effectively leverages existing networks, professional referrals, and natural market opportunities to consistently generate quality leads for distribution expansion.
Demonstrates the ability to attract established and high-performing distributors or teams from competitor organizations by highlighting the unique advantages and growth opportunities the company offers.
Ensures a good selection process is followed, and successful recruits are smoothly integrated by providing initial training and necessary resources to facilitate a fast start in the role.
Skillset required-
Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

Job Summary
Tamil language is mandatory.
We are looking for an experienced Plant HR Operations professional with relevant experience in managing end-to-end HR operations within a plant/manufacturing environment.
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in payroll, statutory compliance, employee lifecycle management, exit formalities, employee engagement, and employee relations. Tamil language proficiency is mandatory for this role.
Key Responsibilities
Manage day-to-day HR operations at the plant location.
Handle end-to-end employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, documentation, transfers and separation.
Coordinate and manage monthly payroll processing, attendance and leave inputs.
Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
Maintain and manage HR records, employee documentation and statutory registers.
Handle employee exit and full-and-final settlement formalities.
Drive employee engagement activities and initiatives at the plant.
Address employee queries, grievances and day-to-day employee relations matters.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders on manpower and HR-related requirements.
Support audits, inspections and other statutory/compliance requirements.
Prepare and maintain HR reports, MIS and relevant documentation.
Work closely with plant management to ensure smooth implementation of HR policies and processes.
Candidate Profile
Plant HR / HR Operations, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
Strong hands-on experience in Payroll, HR Operations and Statutory Compliance.
Experience in employee engagement and employee relations.
Good knowledge of exit formalities and employee separation processes.
Strong understanding of plant-level HR processes and labour compliance.
Tamil language proficiency is mandatory.
Good communication, interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to work independently and manage employee-related matters at the plant.

Description:
Roles & Responsibilities
Conduct daily CFT meetings and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Review and monitor production schedule adherence.
Review and monitor ILR status.
Monitor plant efficiency and identify areas for improvement.
Periodically review and update Control Plans, SOPs, Work Instructions (WI), and related documents.
Coordinate with supporting departments for facility-related requirements.
Coordinate and support IATF, TPS, PMI, OSHAS, VDA, and other system-related activities.
Carry out SAP BOM corrections and ensure accuracy of material-related data.
Carry out SAP Norms corrections and maintain accurate system data.
Ensure timely closure of Stop Advice Notes.
Monitor and ensure shift-wise NC closure.
Coordinate new product introduction / new product activities with the CFT.
Key Technical Responsibilities
The role also requires strong capability in PCBA manufacturing and final assembly, including single-piece flow and batch production, SOP/CP/PFMEA, quality problem-solving tools, line efficiency improvement, assembly rejection/rework control, defect analysis, FPY improvement, 5S/Kaizen, PCB Gerber data, through-hole and selective soldering, and electronic product manufacturing processes.
As a Senior Engineer in the Manufacturing department, you will play a crucial role in the development, optimization, and implementation of manufacturing processes. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance production efficiency, ensure quality compliance, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. The position requires a deep understanding of manufacturing principles, tools, and technologies, as well as strong leadership capabilities to mentor junior engineers and coordinate team efforts.

Description:
To create network of high performing Partner and promulgate initiatives within each Partner to achieve sales productivity targets through sustainable partnership. Recruit, Coach, Mentor, Support and Retain Partner and Drive them to achieve New business productivity Renewal Targets
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Identify and Recruit the prospective Partner.
Selection to on boarding of the Partner and responsible for Partner income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner and other day to day interactions
with support functions whenever required.
Engage initiatives to ensure Managing Partner - PO productivity
To achieve the assigned recruitment target of partner office; assigned through various
Recruitment activities
Actively involve the PPs in activities pertaining to Recruitment and New Agent Activation
Responsible for Advisor Activation, Creation and Retention
Ensure compliance to all internal processes and other compliance standards as set by the
Company or the Regulator.
Plan goals performance needs for Partner in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for Partner Office
Identify development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical,
product and skills training and coaching. Develop Partner in line with career development
training requirements of the Company.
Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with
Partner.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performances and arranging appropriate
team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills
of Partners.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company
information, address common problems and concerns and rally the Partner to achieve
goals.
Make necessary decisions based on Partner performance.
Ensure submitting DSR through companys sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE :
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Min 2 years of sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of Insurance industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills
Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing customers to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Definition-
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Maintenance Management
Plan and execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance activities for manufacturing equipment.
Ensure maximum machine uptime and minimize production losses.
Analyze equipment failures and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
Monitor machine performance and reliability indicators.
2. Equipment Maintenance
Maintain and improve the performance of:
Stator winding machines
Coil insertion machines
Commutator assembly machines
Rotor balancing machines
Press machines
Hydraulic and pneumatic systems
Conveyor systems
Assembly line equipment
Gear box, Index table, LM guides, Ball screws, clutches
Utility systems (air compressors, chillers, cooling towers, pumps, etc.)
Material handling equipment
3. TPM & Continuous Improvement
Drive TPM (Total Productive Maintenance) activities across production areas.
Implement Autonomous Maintenance (JH & PM Pillar) initiatives.
Conduct root cause analysis using 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, and Pareto Analysis.
Lead Kaizen and cost-reduction projects.
Support OEE improvement initiatives.
4. Planning & Scheduling
Develop annual, monthly, and weekly maintenance plans.
Coordinate maintenance schedules with production teams.
Ensure timely completion of shutdown maintenance activities.
5. Spare Parts & Inventory Control
Monitor critical spare inventory levels.
Coordinate procurement of maintenance spares.
Optimize spare consumption and maintenance costs.
Maintain proper records of equipment history and spare utilization.
6. Safety & Compliance
Ensure compliance with EHS policies and statutory requirements.
Conduct safety inspections and risk assessments.
Implement Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures during maintenance activities.
Ensure safe work practices among maintenance personnel and contractors.
7. Team Management
Lead, guide, and develop maintenance engineers, technicians, and trainees.
Conduct skill development and technical training programs.
Evaluate team performance and support succession planning.
8. Documentation & Reporting
Maintain maintenance records through CMMS/ERP systems.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly maintenance reports.
Track maintenance KPIs such as:
•MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)
•MTTR (Mean Time To Repair)
•OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)
•Maintenance Cost per Unit
•Preventive Maintenance Compliance

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Lead and manage all aspects of the store's operations, including sales performance, customer service, staff management, inventory control, and financial targets.

Sound understanding of sales and marketing principles.
Demonstrated ability to analyze data, make informed decisions, and problem-solve effectively.
Flexibility to work varied shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.

Previous experience in the specific industry or product category of the store. Familiarity with inventory management systems and procedures. Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Supervises and manages employees.
Managing all day-to-day operations.
Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Ensures employee recognition is taking place on all shifts.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees.
Monitoring and Supporting Progress Toward Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Collaborates with the Front Office Manager on ways to continually improve departmental service.
- Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Office goals to produce desired results.
- Participates in the development and implementation of corrective action plans based on review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Displays outstanding hospitality skills.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Interacts with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.
- Handles guest problems and complaints effectively.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Ensures compliance with all Front Office policies, standards and procedures.
- Monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors and co-workers by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Functions in place of the Front Office Manager in his/her absence.
- Communicates critical information from pre- and post-convention meetings to the Front Office staff.
- Participates in department meetings.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
As the original house of luxury, St.
Regis continues to redefine modern luxury through service.

Regis brand standards.

REQUIRE QUALIFICATIONS

- Sets a positive example for guest relations.

- Makes presence known to customer at all times during this process.

Description:

Home
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
About the Role
An ATM Field Service Engineer is responsible for the entire lifecycle of ATMs, from pre-installation and setup to ongoing maintenance and repair. This includes training clients on ATM usage, performing preventive maintenance to avoid problems, troubleshooting malfunctions, and completing repairs to get ATMs back up and running quickly. They also interact directly with customers to address any concerns and provide excellent customer service. The role requires a proactive approach, responding immediately to all complaints and scheduling preventive maintenance to minimize downtime. For complex issues, collaboration with the customer support team and R&D department is necessary. A valid 2-wheeler license and motorbike are essential for travel to various ATM locations.
About the Company
Vortex Engineering is a Chennai, India-based Technology company focused on building innovative products for the ATM/self-service market. The company has a family of ATM HW & SW products with around 10K installations and a portfolio of software products for the management of multivendor ATMs and other value-added applications. Our customers include leading banks in India and a growing set of new customers in growth countries in Asia, ME & Africa.
Vortex Engineering is revolutionizing self-service product space with unique firsts in the industry

Lowest carbon footprint with ultra-low power design, making it viable for solar-powered deployments
Most sustainable, and the only commercially successful ATM to run on an open-source Linux platform
Only Indian company (and one of a few globally) to have developed and patented dispenser technology
Developing next-generation secured Hardware & Software products using IoT, AI, ML & 5G

The company has a partnership with IIT-Madras for R&D on the latest cutting-edge technologies and offers exciting career opportunities for dynamic individuals with a passion to innovate, lead, take larger responsibilities and grow with the company.

Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.
Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities.
Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly.
Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner.
Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.
Administrative Tasks:

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening
Data Warehouse Testing, ETL Testing, SQL, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Migration Testing, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, JIRA, Agile.
Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Description:
We are currently hiring for Sales Specialist for our Apple Retail Stores in India.


Do you love how it feels to encourage others? As a Part-Time Specialist, you help create the energy and excitement around Apple products, providing the right solutions and getting products into customers hands. You understand that the Apple Store is dedicated to delivering a customer experience thats unlike any other. It starts with you discovering customers needs. And with the support of your store team members, you match those needs with the right products. Every day is an opportunity for you to turn another Apple Store visitor into a loyal Apple customer.


Role & responsibilities

Deliver excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting products and services, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy products.
Understand and proactively stay up to date on Apples products, services, purchase options and Product Zone sales processes.
Support your peers throughout the store as needed by sharing knowledge about Apples products, services and purchase options, and assist in offering ownership opportunities. Maintain accuracy and follow guidance.
Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to providing customer service and support in other areas of the store.
Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each others differences and having the curiosity to learn.
Demonstrate Apples values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.



Preferred candidate profile

Demonstrate knowledge of Apple products and services.
Personalise solutions based on customer needs, and effectively communicate them.
Work in a fast-paced environment, often supporting multiple customers at the same time.
Work in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.
Learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services, and third-party products, to enhance the customer experience.
Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apples core values.
You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.

This is a Part-Time opportunity, requiring you to work 4 Days in a week for 5 hours each day i.e 20 hours in a week.


Location

Bangalore , Delhi, Noida

to achieve placement outcomes.
Your primary objective will be to maximize student placements and contribute to the overall employability success of the programs.

Key Responsibilities-

1. Corporate Engagement & Partnerships

Identify, map, and connect with HR teams, recruiters, hiring managers, and industry leaders across sectors.

Understand industry hiring requirements and workforce trends.

Contribute towards achieving placement targets and program KPIs, including student joining and retention rates.

Conduct regular follow-ups with placed students and employers.
Track student retention and career progression.
Address challenges related to onboarding, workplace adaptation, and job continuity.

Maintain strong communication with internal and external stakeholders to drive placement success.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Ecommerce Developer (Magento 2) to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people.
You will be responsible in developing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing our eCommerce platform based on Magento 2 on hyper scaler cloud environment including underlying components.
You will identify new and exciting functionalities and develop new modules.
If you are the person who can design and develop web / mobile platforms securely at an unbelievable pace, we would like to meet you.
To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a self-starter, top-notch communicator and passionate hands-on programmer.
Responsibilities
Optimize existing Magento 2 installation
Provide regular and emergency support for break-fixes
Troubleshoot integration and performance issues
Design interfaces, themes, templates while following best practices and maintain world-class coding styles and standard
Anticipate the performance requirements and communicate with management on remediation plans to CTO/CIO
Develop new Magento modules and functionalities
Manage and upgrade Magento add-ons and conduct code reviews/scans
Establish DevOps pipelines, Release/Change management procedures, etc.
Develop testing scenarios including unit testing, integration testing and automate those
Work with UI/UX and graphic designers to implement front-end changes
Work with content writer to implement new contents
Implement additional components such as Elastic Search, Varnish, Redis, CDN, RabbitMQ, etc.
Manage SSL certificates, software accounts, keys, etc.
Rearchitect environment and provide vertical and horizontal scaling as demand grows
Fine-tune batch jobs (Crons) or Consumers
Migrate databases and data
Develop integrations for files, images, etc.
Manage stack components and upgrade them (Ubuntu, PHP, Percona, Nginx, Composer, Firewall, Redis, etc.)
Create plans for developing mobile experience, mobile apps or PWA front end environment
Maintain confidentiality about IP, methods, processes and data
Participate in conferences, webinars and provide presentations while socializing and partnering with startups
Install security patches and monitor web traffic
brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Strong experience with Magento 2 development and debugging
Strong experience with high-performance technologies such as Nginx, Varnish, Redis, ElasticSearch
JavaScript and AJAX experience for Front-end
Extensive HTML5, LESS and CSS knowledge
Understanding of modern UI/UX trends
Experience or knowledge of React.js, Vue.js and Node.js
Experience with AWS components such as VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, WAF Cloud Formation
Linux or Ubuntu server operations working and know-hows
Experience in working with MySQL databases like MariaDB and Percona
Basic understanding of networking and ports
Experience with Google Tag Manager, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC, Facebook Pixels. A/B Testing
Strong attention to details about design styles to improve look and feel
Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks
Ability to work in a professional capacity and team environment is must
Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
Magento 2 Certification is required
Cloud Computing Certification (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus

Additional Job Description
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an Experienced Associate in Treasury Management System Implementation within our Finance Solutions practice, you will engage directly with clients to enhance their financial operations. You will leverage your skills to contribute to the successful implementation of treasury management systems, helping clients optimize their financial processes and achieve operational efficiency. Within our Finance practice, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on delivering impactful solutions that drive business transformation.
As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagements while developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will be exposed to clients to learn how to build meaningful connections, manage and inspire others, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources. You will embrace ambiguity, ask questions, and use these challenges as opportunities for growth.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will participate in project tasks, develop basic skills and knowledge, and respond effectively to diverse perspectives and needs. You will use a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems, contributing to the broader objectives of your projects and the overall strategy.
Responsibilities
- Assisting in the implementation of treasury management systems to enhance financial operations
- Supporting client engagements by contributing to financial strategy and forecasting initiatives
- Conducting financial statement analysis to provide insights for decision-making
- Preparing and reviewing financial statements to validate accuracy and compliance
- Developing financial models to support strategic planning and financial management
- Collaborating with teams to optimize financial reporting processes and improve efficiency
- Engaging in financial transactions and accounting practices to support client needs
- Utilizing financial management skills to address complex client challenges and deliver solutions
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 1 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Demonstrating proficiency in financial statement analysis
- Utilizing financial modeling to support decision-making
- Engaging in financial forecasting for strategic planning
- Applying accounting practices in diverse financial scenarios

Description:
Role overview: Strategy Consulting - Corporate Deals Technology
The Corporate Deals Technology (CDT) team partners with global corporate clients to shape technology strategy that enables business value and deal success in complex M&A transactions. Our thought leadership and extensive expertise in various industries allow us to serve corporate clients with consulting services with a focus on technology components of the value chain to create scalable and profitable businesses.
Corporate Deals Technology (CDT), a key practice of the Strategy platform, works with corporate clients across industries supporting engagements:
Developing M&A Technology Strategies for integrations, separations, carve-outs, and divestitures by collaborating with C-suite executives
Conducting Technology Due Diligence to assess IT landscapes, identify risks, and evaluate value creation opportunities
Advising on Integration and Divestiture Planning to align technology strategy with business and operational priorities
Designing Future-State Technology Models and Architectures Core responsibilities as a Manager would entail (but not limited to)
As a Manager, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience, helping our clients solve their complex business issues from strategy to execution. Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to
Proactively assist the team across deal spectrum (IT DD, IT integration / separation)
Lead team on project delivery and manage leadership & client conversations
Lead solution design and implementation aspects of the engagement by ensuring high quality within time and budget constraints
Plan and develop integration and separation deliverables, including Day One readiness and execution, business process and systems integration and separation
Develop financial models for IT, including synergy savings, one-time costs, standalone costs and stranded costs
Recommend enterprise architecture, solutions, and systems based on industry leading practices and past experiences

Description:
Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune

Brief about the Team & Fractal
Fractal partners with Fortune 500 organizations to unlock business value through AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Transformation. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, generative AI, and cloud technologies to help clients accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and drive measurable business outcomes. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud-first strategies, AWS plays a critical role in enabling scalable, secure, and data-driven transformation journeys.

Role Summary:
The Client Partner - Head of AWS is responsible for driving AWS-led business growth, expanding strategic client relationships, owning practice P&L, and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs. This leader will serve as the executive sponsor for key client engagements, strengthen Fractals partnership with AWS, and help clients leverage AWS services to accelerate AI, Analytics, Data, and Digital modernization initiatives.
The role requires a blend of executive client engagement, cloud consulting expertise, sales leadership, alliance management, and business operations to scale the AWS practice.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.
Own the AWS Practice P&L, including revenue growth, margins, utilization, and overall business performance.
Develop offerings, accelerators, solution assets, and industry-specific cloud transformation propositions.
Collaborate with leadership teams to identify emerging market opportunities and expand AWS-led services.
Client Partnership & Business Growth
Build and manage executive relationships with C-level stakeholders across strategic accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud transformation, modernization, AI/ML, data platform, and generative AI initiatives.
Drive account mining, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across existing and new clients.
Lead strategic pursuits and large transformation deals from opportunity identification through closure.
Develop account growth plans and oversee pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue realization.

AWS Alliance & Ecosystem Management
Serve as the primary leadership interface between Fractal and AWS.
Strengthen relationships with AWS sales, solution architecture, and partner teams.
Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, AWS-funded programs, and marketplace engagements.
Ensure alignment with AWS partner competencies, specializations, and certifications.
Represent Fractal in AWS industry events, leadership forums, and customer engagements.
Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.
Establish career development frameworks and succession plans within the AWS practice.
Service Delivery Excellence
Oversee successful delivery of AWS transformation programs across clients and industries.
Ensure projects meet quality, timeline, security, compliance, and business outcome expectations.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to improve delivery methodologies, governance, and customer satisfaction.
Act as an executive escalation point for strategic accounts and critical programs.
Innovation & Thought Leadership
Stay current with AWS technologies, industry trends, and emerging cloud capabilities.
Lead development of cloud-native AI and data modernization solutions leveraging AWS services.
Contribute to thought leadership through client workshops, industry forums, conferences, and publications.
Promote innovation through reusable frameworks, automation accelerators, and solution assets.
Financial Leadership
Develop and manage annual business plans and growth targets for the AWS practice.
Drive profitable growth through effective resource planning and portfolio management.
Monitor key business metrics including revenue, margins, utilization, pipeline, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA preferred.
18+ years of experience in technology consulting, cloud services, digital transformation, or managed services.
Proven experience leading large AWS practices, cloud consulting organizations, or strategic cloud businesses.
Demonstrated track record of managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios and driving profitable growth.
Strong understanding of AWS Cloud services, Data Platforms, AI/ML, GenAI, Security, DevOps, Modernization, and Migration services.
Experience managing executive client relationships across Fortune 500 organizations.
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal shaping, negotiations, and contract management.
Proven ability to build and lead geographically distributed teams.

Description:
Position: PLM Support Engineer
Experience: 3 to 8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai / Hyderabad (or as applicable)
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. The role involves troubleshooting workflows, CAD integrations, BOM management, release processes, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support.
Key Responsibilities
Production Support & Incident Management
Provide L2/L3 production support for PLM applications including Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam across production and non-production environments.
Act as the primary point of contact for business users for PLM operational, application, and workflow-related issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests within agreed SLA timelines.
Perform impact analysis and prioritize tickets based on business criticality.
PLM Functional Support
Support Engineering Change Management (ECM/ECR/ECO) processes and workflows.
Manage and troubleshoot complex BOM (Bill of Material) structures and product data issues.
Support product release processes, document lifecycle management, and workflow execution activities.
Assist users with process adherence, workflow execution, and system functionality.
CAD & Integration Support
Provide support for CAD integrations with Siemens NX, CATIA, and related engineering applications.
Troubleshoot CAD data loading, synchronization issues, and integration failures.
Investigate dataset validation failures, translator issues, and CAD file management problems.
Workflow & System Administration Support
Troubleshoot workflow integration issues, dispatcher failures, workflow processing delays, and PDF generation errors.
Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents.
Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Generate and publish support metrics, incident reports, ticket trend analysis, and SLA compliance reports.
Provide regular status updates to management and key stakeholders.
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and global support teams for issue resolution and deployments.
Participate in release validation, patch deployment, and post-deployment support activities.
Required Technical Skills
PLM Technologies
Strong experience in at least one or more PLM applications:
Teamcenter
Aras Innovator
SmarTeam
Functional Knowledge
Engineering Change Management (ECR/ECO/ECN)
Product Structure Management
BOM Management
Workflow Management
Release Management
Document Management
CAD Integration
Siemens NX
CATIA
CAD Data Management
Technical Skills
SQL Queries and Database Fundamentals
PLM Data Model Understanding
Workflow Configuration and Troubleshooting
Dispatcher Monitoring
PDF Generation Processes
Job Server and Vault Management
Application Log Analysis
Support Tools
ServiceNow / Jira / Remedy
Incident & Change Management Tools
Monitoring and Reporting Tools
Desired Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
3 to 8 years of experience in PLM application support.
Experience in global production support environments.
Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices.
ITIL certification is preferred.
Required Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work with global and cross-functional teams.
Customer-focused approach with strong ownership mindset.
Ability to work in rotational shifts and provide production support when required.
Strong documentation and reporting skills.
Preferred Skills
Teamcenter BMIDE knowledge.
Teamcenter Active Workspace exposure.
Aras administration/support experience.
Understanding of manufacturing and engineering business processes.
Exposure to deployment and release management activities.
Experience in performance tuning and application monitoring.
