Description:
Job Description CyberArk Administrator / PAM Engineer
Your Role
As a CyberArk Administrator / PAM Engineer at Capgemini, you will be responsible for supporting and maintaining CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions, ensuring secure privileged account management, system availability, compliance, and seamless integration with enterprise infrastructure. You will work closely with PAM teams, product teams, and various infrastructure stakeholders to support onboarding activities, platform health monitoring, automation, audits, and CyberArk integrations.
Manage CyberArk operational activities including account onboarding/offboarding, privileged account lifecycle management, and compliance monitoring.
Troubleshoot and support CyberArk components such as CPM, PSM, PVWA, CCP, certificate management, services, logs, and overall platform health.
Maintain CyberArk integrations with enterprise applications, MPI platforms, Active Directory, and cloud environments while ensuring platform uptime and security.
Support CyberArk automation through PowerShell scripting, CyberArk APIs (PSPAS/API development), and automated onboarding processes.
Collaborate with PAM, AD, Network, Distributed, GAD, and Product teams to support audits, change management, maintenance activities, upgrades, patching, disaster recovery testing, and operational excellence.
Your Profile
Hands-on experience with CyberArk PAM solution including CPM, PSM, PVWA, CCP, account onboarding/offboarding, compliance monitoring, and privileged access governance.
Strong knowledge of CyberArk APIs (PSPAS), PowerShell scripting, automation workflows, certificate management, and account lifecycle management.
Experience in troubleshooting CyberArk infrastructure issues, monitoring platform health, reviewing logs, managing services, and ensuring high availability.
Good understanding of Windows, Linux, Networking, SSH Key integration, cloud platforms (AWS), and enterprise security best practices.
Experience supporting audit, compliance, change management, DR/BCP testing, documentation creation, SOP development, and stakeholder engagement across multiple teams.
Key Responsibilities
Manage onboarding, offboarding, registration, and deregistration of privileged accounts within CyberArk.
Troubleshoot CyberArk platform issues involving CPM, PSM, PVWA, CCP, integrations, certificates, and authentication mechanisms.
Perform health monitoring using monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, review logs, monitor services, and ensure platform stability.
Support change management activities including maintenance, patching, upgrades, testing, implementation, and rollback planning.
Create and maintain operational documentation, SOPs, testing evidence, audit artifacts, knowledge articles, and support resources.
Required Skills
Primary Skills: Cyber Security, CyberArk PAM
PowerShell Scripting
CyberArk API / PSPAS
AWS Fundamentals
Windows Administration
Linux Administration
Networking
SSH Key Management
Certificate Management
Dynatrace Monitoring
Change Management

Experience Range
4 to 8+ Years of relevant experience in CyberArk Administration, PAM Operations, and Privileged Access Management Support.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced and driven Manager - Talent Acquisition (Leadership Hiring) to lead end-to-end recruitment for senior and leadership-level positions across the organization. This is currently an Individual Contributor (IC) role, requiring strong stakeholder management, executive search capabilities, market intelligence, and a consultative hiring approach. Based on business needs and performance, the role may evolve into a people management position with team leadership responsibilities in the future.
Key Responsibilities
Leadership Hiring
Manage end-to-end recruitment for leadership and critical positions across business functions.
Partner with senior business leaders to understand talent requirements, organizational priorities, and succession needs.
Develop and execute targeted search strategies to identify and engage high-caliber leadership talent.
Build and maintain strong leadership talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Conduct market mapping, competitor analysis, and talent intelligence research.
Stakeholder Management
Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and business leaders.
Drive hiring discussions, calibration meetings, and offer negotiations for senior-level hires.
Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
Influence hiring decisions through data-driven insights and market trends.
Talent Acquisition Excellence
Design and implement innovative sourcing strategies, including executive search methodologies.
Track and report key recruitment metrics and leadership hiring effectiveness.
Ensure compliance with internal hiring policies and recruitment governance.
Collaborate with HR Business Partners and business leaders on workforce planning initiatives.
Employer Branding & Market Intelligence
Strengthen the organization's leadership hiring brand through networking and industry engagement.
Stay updated on industry trends, talent availability, compensation benchmarks, and competitor movements.
Build strong external networks with industry leaders, executive search firms, and professional associations.
Future Team Leadership Opportunities
Mentor and guide recruiters as needed on leadership hiring best practices.
Support capability building within the Talent Acquisition function.
Potentially lead and manage a team of recruiters based on business growth and organizational requirements.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
8+ years of Talent Acquisition experience with significant exposure to leadership and niche hiring.
Proven experience in hiring for Director, VP, AVP, General Manager, and other leadership positions.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and leadership teams.
Strong expertise in executive search, talent mapping, and passive candidate engagement.
Preferred Skills
Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Strong negotiation and offer management capabilities.
Data-driven decision-making and analytical mindset.
Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.
High level of ownership, accountability, and business acumen.
Experience in technology, product, digital, consulting, or corporate leadership hiring is preferred.
Key Competencies

Executive Presence
Strategic Thinking
Stakeholder Management
Consultative Hiring
Talent Market Intelligence
Decision Making
Communication & Influencing
Relationship Management
Problem Solving
Results Orientation
Success Measures
Leadership hiring closure rate and quality of hire.
Time-to-fill and stakeholder satisfaction.
Leadership talent pipeline strength.
Candidate experience and offer-to-join ratio.
Contribution to strategic workforce planning and talent acquisition initiatives.

Job Title: Accounts Payable Financial Associate
Location: Bangalore
Experience: 2 - 8 Years

Key Responsibilities:
Process vendor invoices accurately, validate supporting documents, and resolve discrepancies promptly.

Oversee team performance, support hiring, and contribute to capability building.
Ensure adherence to company policies, internal controls, and regulatory compliance.
Support ad hoc finance and process improvement projects.

2-8 years of relevant experience in Accounts Payable and Employee Claims processes, preferably in a shared services environment.
Strong communication skills (written and verbal) in English.
High attention to detail, accuracy, and accountability.
Strong interpersonal and vendor management skills.
Proactive, dependable, and a collaborative team player.
Ability to work independently with a positive and solution-oriented mindset.

Description:
Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune

Brief about the Team & Fractal
Fractal partners with Fortune 500 organizations to unlock business value through AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Transformation. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, generative AI, and cloud technologies to help clients accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and drive measurable business outcomes. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud-first strategies, AWS plays a critical role in enabling scalable, secure, and data-driven transformation journeys.

Role Summary:
The Client Partner - Head of AWS is responsible for driving AWS-led business growth, expanding strategic client relationships, owning practice P&L, and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs. This leader will serve as the executive sponsor for key client engagements, strengthen Fractals partnership with AWS, and help clients leverage AWS services to accelerate AI, Analytics, Data, and Digital modernization initiatives.
The role requires a blend of executive client engagement, cloud consulting expertise, sales leadership, alliance management, and business operations to scale the AWS practice.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.
Own the AWS Practice P&L, including revenue growth, margins, utilization, and overall business performance.
Develop offerings, accelerators, solution assets, and industry-specific cloud transformation propositions.
Collaborate with leadership teams to identify emerging market opportunities and expand AWS-led services.
Client Partnership & Business Growth
Build and manage executive relationships with C-level stakeholders across strategic accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud transformation, modernization, AI/ML, data platform, and generative AI initiatives.
Drive account mining, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across existing and new clients.
Lead strategic pursuits and large transformation deals from opportunity identification through closure.
Develop account growth plans and oversee pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue realization.

AWS Alliance & Ecosystem Management
Serve as the primary leadership interface between Fractal and AWS.
Strengthen relationships with AWS sales, solution architecture, and partner teams.
Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, AWS-funded programs, and marketplace engagements.
Ensure alignment with AWS partner competencies, specializations, and certifications.
Represent Fractal in AWS industry events, leadership forums, and customer engagements.
Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.
Establish career development frameworks and succession plans within the AWS practice.
Service Delivery Excellence
Oversee successful delivery of AWS transformation programs across clients and industries.
Ensure projects meet quality, timeline, security, compliance, and business outcome expectations.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to improve delivery methodologies, governance, and customer satisfaction.
Act as an executive escalation point for strategic accounts and critical programs.
Innovation & Thought Leadership
Stay current with AWS technologies, industry trends, and emerging cloud capabilities.
Lead development of cloud-native AI and data modernization solutions leveraging AWS services.
Contribute to thought leadership through client workshops, industry forums, conferences, and publications.
Promote innovation through reusable frameworks, automation accelerators, and solution assets.
Financial Leadership
Develop and manage annual business plans and growth targets for the AWS practice.
Drive profitable growth through effective resource planning and portfolio management.
Monitor key business metrics including revenue, margins, utilization, pipeline, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA preferred.
18+ years of experience in technology consulting, cloud services, digital transformation, or managed services.
Proven experience leading large AWS practices, cloud consulting organizations, or strategic cloud businesses.
Demonstrated track record of managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios and driving profitable growth.
Strong understanding of AWS Cloud services, Data Platforms, AI/ML, GenAI, Security, DevOps, Modernization, and Migration services.
Experience managing executive client relationships across Fortune 500 organizations.
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal shaping, negotiations, and contract management.
Proven ability to build and lead geographically distributed teams.

Key responsibilities are assigned based on an evaluation of the candidates professional qualification, relevant SPA and Disputes experience, analytical skills, and a demonstrated working knowledge of transaction value drivers and post-deal issues. As a Senior Associate in the SPA & Disputes team, you will work on EV to Equity bridge analysis, post-deal mechanisms and disputes matters, while collaborating with PwC UK teams on project deliverables. Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Work in a team performing analytical procedures on accounting and financial data to support transaction value assessments, and visualising insights using Excel and AI tools (training will be provided on these tools); Interpret and critically review transaction legal documentation and evaluate completion accounts and locked box mechanisms, identifying areas of value leakage or risk; Identify areas which may warrant further investigation / give rise to potential adjustments to price; Proactively work with team leaders and team members to manage a workload of multiple projects with competing priorities based on relative importance and urgency; Communicating confidently with engagement teams to understand scope and expectations, and present project deliverables once they have been completed; Supporting engagement setup from initiation through to completion, understanding workflow management tools, relevant application of AI tools, and ensuring accurate documentation of work performed; Participate in a wide range of projects and collaborate across multiple workstreams or teams; consistently demonstrating creative thinking, individual initiative and timely completion of assigned work; and Consistently demonstrate teamwork dynamics by working as a team member: understand personal and team roles; contribute to a positive working environment by building solid relationships with team members; and proactively seek guidance, clarification and feedback.
Preferred Qualifications Strong interest in mergers and acquisitions, with the ability to understand key value drivers in transactions; Good knowledge of accounting fundamentals, price adjustment mechanics (e.g. net debt, working capital), and valuation principles; Familiarity with valuation methods and transaction mechanisms such as completion accounts and locked box structures; Demonstrated ability to analyse complex financial data and legal documents with precision; Proven track record of independently managing deliverables and maintaining high quality under tight deadlines; Effective written and verbal communication skills in English; Self-motivated, with a strong commitment to personal growth and continuous learning; and Adaptable and eager to develop new skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Basic Qualifications Working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint; Strong written and verbal communication skills; Certifications requirement: CA/MBA; Good accounting and financial concepts; High level of attention to detail; 2-5 years experience in analysing financial accounting information (for example in audit or FDD); and Awareness of business valuations concepts (Enterprise Value vs. Equity Value) and transaction mechanisms (completion accounts vs. locked box).

We have an exciting opportunity at our company Tata Business Hub for a Lead IT Infra Role, and based on your experience and skill set, we believe this role could be a great fit for you.

Company Details : Tata Business Hub is a digital first B2B organization setup by TATA Group to holistically address the needs of Emerging Businesses. We value the pivotal role of emerging businesses in our Nations economic growth and prosperity, and believe in empowering them to be deeply aware, widely connected and digitally integrated. Offering a host of economical and highly relevant business capabilities, Tata Business Hub aims to be the catalyst, propelling emerging businesses into new frontiers of growth and performance.

At Tata Business Hub, our ambition is vast-
We want to become the pre-eminent company that works for MSMEs in India

Grow their business
Solve their challenges
Optimize their processes

Role Summary
Responsible for managing enterprise IT infrastructure, Microsoft 365, AWS cloud platforms, network security and IT operations, while ensuring effective IT procurement, vendor coordination and billing management.
Key Responsibilities
1. Microsoft 365 & SharePoint
Manage Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, SSO, Active Directory and Azure integrations.
Develop and maintain SharePoint customizations, SPFx/React JS applications and Power Platform solutions.
Manage Microsoft 365 security policies using Defender and Intune.
Troubleshoot Office 365, email, network, firewall and cloud service issues.
2. Infrastructure & Cloud
Manage DNS, email routing, Azure services, web applications, APIs and storage.
Deploy and manage AWS services, instances, AMIs and SaaS infrastructure.
Configure and optimize AWS, Azure and internal cloud environments.
Implement automation, patching, backup and disaster recovery solutions.
Monitor cloud usage, capacity, performance and costs.
3. Network & Security
Manage enterprise network and security infrastructure, including firewalls, IPS, proxy, web/email filtering and next-generation security solutions.
Configure firewall policies, authentication services, load balancers and SD-WAN.
Maintain knowledge of MPLS, BGP, OSPF, TACACS and related network technologies.
Identify, investigate and resolve major incidents and security vulnerabilities.
4. Identity, Endpoint & IT Support
Manage Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure AD Connect, ADFS and Hybrid Exchange.
Implement SSO, MFA, access controls and endpoint security.
Manage BYOD, ActiveSync and mobile device support.
Provide technical support, problem management and infrastructure troubleshooting.
Drive ITSM, SLA adherence and service improvement.
5. IT Procurement & Vendor Management
Coordinate IT procurement for hardware, software, cloud services, licenses and infrastructure.
Raise and track purchase requisitions, POs, quotations and delivery schedules.
Coordinate with vendors, Procurement, Finance and internal teams for timely delivery.
Maintain records of contracts, licenses, warranties, renewals and IT assets.
Support vendor evaluations, commercial negotiations and cost optimization.
6. IT Billing & Cost Control
Validate vendor invoices against POs, contracts, SOWs and agreed rates.
Verify quantities, taxes, rental charges, licenses, cloud consumption and discounts.
Track recurring IT bills, AMC, connectivity, cloud and managed services.
Resolve billing discrepancies and coordinate corrections, credit notes and adjustments.
Maintain billing trackers and support monthly cost reconciliation and budget reporting.
7. Documentation & Compliance
Maintain infrastructure documentation, configuration records and asset details.
Follow IT security, change management, audit and compliance requirements.
Ensure timely closure of vulnerabilities, audit observations and operational issues.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or related field.
8-12 years of experience in M365, cloud infrastructure, network security and IT operations.
Strong knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, Active Directory, Exchange, networking and security technologies.
Proficiency in PowerShell and infrastructure automation.
Experience in IT procurement, vendor management and invoice validation.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Role Purpose
The Software Procurement intern is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end lifecycle of global software assets, software procurement processes, and supplier contracts at Thoughtworks. This role ensures cost efficiency, streamlined workflows, timely supplier payments, regulatory compliance, and seamless cross-functional collaboration across GITS, InfoSec, Finance, Accounts Payable, and Legal departments.
Key Responsibilities
Learn and work closely with Software Procurement Lead on below mention responsibilities:
1. Procurement Operations & Purchase Management
End-to-End Workflow Optimisation: Direct and analyse the efficiency of software procurement processes, from request ingestion to inventory updating
Coupa Platform Management: Initiate supplier onboarding forms, monitor supplier statuses until active, and create/publish Purchase Orders (POs) and Virtual Contracts in Coupa
Requisition Approvals: Act as the designated Global Procurement Approver and authorise high-value requisitions (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) on behalf of the Global Software Lead.
Manage Credit Card Spend: Manage monthly or annual subscriptions that are on credit card and submit weekly expense reports in Expensify; allocating cost accurately.Manage multiple domain registrars: Register and renew domains, working closely with LegalAWS account provisioning: Work closely with CloudOps team on provisioning / deprovisioning AWS accounts including management of login credentials
2. Vendor Relationship & Renewal Management
Vendor Coordination: Manage direct communication with major global SaaS vendors (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn, Snowflake, Sisense, Pearson VUE) regarding quotes, order forms, and payment terms.
Renewal Pipeline Tracking: Partner with external procurement platforms to monitor renewal deadlines, evaluate license needs, coordinate stakeholder feedback, and schedule retirements of legacy software.
3. Financial & Budget Governance
Invoice & Payment Resolution: Partner closely with Accounts Payable (AP) to verify receipts, resolve billing discrepancies, split invoices manually, and escalate critical past-due accounts.
Budgeting & Cost Allocation: Monitor license allocations and manage pay-as-you-go or credit-based models to optimize spend and ensure unused credits do not expire.
Cost Distribution Mapping: Distribute software costs accurately among business units, regions (DEC/POH), and specific accounts or departments by aligning data from Jigsaw and other tools.
4. Software Entitlement & Compliance Management
Software Asset Management (SAM): Track active software assets and license assignments via ServiceNow (SNOW). Requires close coordination with multiple teams.
Risk & Regulatory Compliance: Collaborate with GITS, InfoSec, and regional legal leads to verify software compliance, evaluate export regulations (such as the Remote Access Security Act), and implement geographic usage restrictions.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Learn and build following skills (tools/applications and Soft skills:
Procurement Platforms: High proficiency in Coupa Software, ServiceNow, Expensify and Zendesk.
Negotiation & Financial Acumen: Strong capability in analyzing pricing models (pay-as-you-go, subscription, credit-based, or enterprise commitments) and driving cost splits across departments.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment: Exceptional cross-functional relationship-building skills, specifically with Finance, AP, Legal (contracts/compliance), GITS, and InfoSec.
Compliance Mindset: Understanding of IT software security guidelines, software usage terms, and regional compliance standards.
Must-have criteria
Education: MBA / PGDM graduate, 2026 pass-out
Specialization: Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Strategic Sourcing, or a closely related specialization

Experience: Freshers and candidates with relevant internship/project experience can be considered
Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills
Stakeholder management: Comfortable interacting with internal stakeholders and external vendors
Commercial mindset: Interest in negotiation, pricing, cost optimisation and vendor management
Analytical skills: Comfortable working with data, comparing options and drawing insights
Technology interest: Willingness to learn about software, SaaS products and technology procurement

Are you a strategic operational leader with a strong track record in managing external service providers and driving operational excellence within a shared services environment? We are seeking a highly capable Regional BPO Manager to take ownership of all contractual and performance aspects of our Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and Shared Service Centre (SSC) partners.
In this strategic management role, you will act as the vital bridge between our regional business stakeholders and our external BPO service provider across multiple outsourced process streams. While functional Tower Leads manage day-to-day process execution, you will ensure our BPO partners deliver against contractual commitments, achieve financial efficiency targets, maintain high customer satisfaction, and execute seamless process transitions.
Key Responsibilities
Contract & Commercial Management: Manage and coordinate all aspects of the BPO partner contract for the region. Oversee invoicing, timesheets, FTE approvals, volume modifications, service onboarding, and the tracking of contractual cost savings.
Relationship & Governance Ownership: Serve as the primary operational contact between internal regional business leadership and service provider management, driving alignment and acting as the escalation point for issue resolution.
Performance Management: Implement and maintain performance management frameworks using contractual KPIs and SLAs to ensure alignment with organizational benchmarks.
Regional Service Reviews: Lead regular Regional Service Reviews covering performance evaluations, issue mitigation, and future continuous improvement initiatives across all regional markets.
Transition Management: Oversee the onboarding and implementation of newly outsourced process workstreams into standard Business-As-Usual (BAU) operations.
Change Governance: Develop and execute the formal change note approval process for contractual and scope updates.
Customer Satisfaction & Insights: Implement periodic internal customer satisfaction survey processes, translating stakeholder feedback into joint action plans with service providers to address operational gaps.
Financial & Budgetary Control: Manage annual and in-year financial budgets for shared service operations, ensuring partner costs accurately reflect productivity gains, scope shifts, and volume changes.
Risk & Quality Framework: Establish risk and control processes governing vendor activities while championing standard process documentation across provider teams.
Role Deliverables
Outsourced process operations delivered consistently within contractually agreed KPIs and SLAs.
Measurable productivity and efficiency savings achieved through structured process improvements.
Transparent, budget-aligned service provider costs reflecting volume dynamics, expanded scope, and savings targets.
Successful execution of the annual Customer Satisfaction Survey process with clear action plans implemented.
Required Skills and Experience
Outsourcing Expertise: Proven experience in managing complex, large-scale outsourced process operations across multi-location environments.
Performance Management: Track record of developing, monitoring, and driving vendor performance using structured KPI and SLA frameworks.
Process Transformation: Demonstrated ability to deliver process efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives through SSC and BPO models.
Financial & Commercial Acumen: Hands-on experience developing and managing operational budgets, complex commercial contracts, and vendor change notes.
Functional Knowledge: Practical working knowledge of core Finance and HR process flows.
Stakeholder & Negotiation Skills: Excellent negotiation and bridge-building capabilities with the ability to translate complex process problems into clear, actionable, high-impact strategies for internal leadership and external partners.

The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.

Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.

Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.

Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.

Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.

An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes

Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Instructional Design - Associate

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:-0-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Description:
About the Role
At Holiday Inn, an IHG Hotel, we believe in delivering True Hospitality by making every guest feel welcome, valued, and cared for. We are looking for a friendly, enthusiastic, and service-oriented Guest Service Associate who is passionate about creating memorable guest experiences.
In this role, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional service, anticipating guest needs, and ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience throughout the guest journey while upholding the brand s service standards.
What Youll Do
Welcome guests warmly and provide courteous, professional, and personalized service throughout their stay.
Assist guests with check-in, check-out, reservations and inquiries,
Anticipate guest needs and respond promptly to requests, feedback, and concerns.
Maintain a thorough knowledge of hotel facilities, services, room categories, and local attractions to assist guests effectively.
Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure timely service delivery and seamless guest experiences.
Handle guest complaints situations professionally, escalating issues when required.
Maintain accurate records, follow operational procedures, and ensure compliance with IHG brand standards.
Promote hotel facilities and services to enhance guest satisfaction and support revenue opportunities.
Maintain guest confidentiality and adhere to hotel policies, safety procedures, and hygiene standards.
Work collaboratively with colleagues to maintain high service standards and contribute to a positive team environment.
Consistently demonstrate the values of True Hospitality by treating every guest and colleague with care, respect, and professionalism.
What Were Looking For
A diploma or degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality, or a related field is preferred.
Previous experience in a hotel or customer service environment will be an advantage; freshers with a positive attitude and a passion for hospitality are welcome to apply.
Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
A guest-focused mindset with a genuine passion for delivering exceptional service.
Strong attention to detail, a professional approach, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
Good problem-solving skills and the ability to handle guest requests with confidence and courtesy.
A team-oriented attitude with a willingness to learn and develop within the hospitality industry.
Flexibility to work rotational shifts, weekends, and public holidays as required.
Why Join IHG
At IHG Hotels Resorts, we are committed to creating a workplace where colleagues can belong, grow, and make a difference. You will have the opportunity to develop your hospitality career, learn from experienced professionals, and contribute to meaningful guest experiences within a globally recognized hotel brand.
Join Holiday Inn Gurugram Sector 90 and help us create memorable moments through the power of True Hospitality.

About the Role
We are looking for an enthusiastic and target-oriented Admission Counselor to guide working professionals in choosing the right upGrad programs based on their career goals and professional experience.

Connect with working professionals through calls and other communication channels to understand their career and learning requirements.

The skilling major has achieved two consecutive years of remarkable growth, closing FY23 and FY24 with over 55,000 successful career transitions, further establishing the credibility and mettle of the online higher education segment in India and globally.

Description:
#ACN Song GN Reinvention Services Customer Service Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Job Title Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Management Level: L07 Manager
Location: Bangalore, Gurgaon, Mumbai (India; global remit)
Experience: 10+ Years (L07)
Must have skills: Retail Service Reinvention / Customer Service Strategy Transformation; a blend of industry and consulting experience with deep understanding of the end-to-end retail value chain and how it drives service demand, volume and exceptions; experience shaping AI-native / agentic service operating models.
The Practice A Brief Sketch
The practice works with clients across their marketing, commerce, sales and service functions to reinvent how they engage customers. As part of the Reinvention Services Customer Service team, you will help the worlds leading retailers transform service from a reactive, cost-driven function into an intelligence-led, AI-native capability that senses signals in real time, resolves issues before they escalate, and continuously improves from every interaction across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystem driving customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience.
Job summary
As a Retail Service Reinvention Senior Manager / Associate Director, you will advise C-suite executives, shape AI-native service operating models, and lead end-to-end transformation for the worlds leading retailers. Reporting to the Customer Service Managing Director, you will build and lead a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts and carry accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M. The role requires a strong blend of retail domain expertise, consulting leadership, end-to-end value chain understanding, executive stakeholder management, and business development capability to shape and deliver scalable, future-ready retail service solutions.
Roles and responsibilities
Service Strategy Advisory
Define enterprise and omnichannel service strategy across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystems.
Shape AI-native service vision, target operating models and multi-year transformation roadmaps.
Develop business cases, prioritize investment and establish value-realization frameworks.
Advise boards and C-suite on where to sequence quick wins against enterprise-scale change.
Experience Design
Map end-to-end journeys for shoppers (order, delivery, returns, loyalty, complaints), associates (store, picker, contact centre) and suppliers (onboarding, purchase orders, invoicing, disputes).
Blueprint services across people, process, data and technology layers.
Identify moments of truth and design service recovery for stock-outs, failed deliveries, substitutions and disputed refunds.
Define channel strategy spanning mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social, store desk and associate/picker devices.
Operating Model Process Transformation
Design target operating models spanning shopper services, supplier services, store workforce services, and fulfilment/ecosystem services.
Design the workforce across shoppers, store associates, pickers and inventory teams, contact-centre specialists and leads, supplier account teams, and delivery partners/dispatchers.
Establish governance frameworks policy and business rules, approval/escalation thresholds, SLAs and entitlements, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
Build KPI and performance frameworks tied to customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience outcomes.
Technology AI Transformation
Set CRM and CCaaS platform strategy (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect).
Shape knowledge and case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk).
Design conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow) intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs and decisioning/policy engines.
Integrate across order, store and supply-chain systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, supplier/EDI portals) and IoT/GPS-enabled field and delivery tracking.
Build service analytics, predictive/prescriptive models and root-cause analysis capability.
Human + Agentic Operations
Design hybrid workforce models blending advisors, associates, AI copilots and autonomous agents across the shopper, supplier, store and fulfilment domains.
Design agents for high-volume service capabilities order status, substitutions, returns, refunds, delivery orchestration, supplier collaboration and dispute resolution.
Lead change management, upskilling and adoption programmes for frontline and support teams.
Establish AI governance, ethics and bias controls, and ongoing model/agent performance oversight.
Enterprise Transformation Delivery
Lead end-to-end programmes from strategy through implementation, adoption and value realisation.
Orchestrate multi-workstream delivery across business, experience, operations, technology and data/AI teams.
Manage executive steering committees and track value against committed business cases.
Practice Building
Develop market-leading thought leadership and intellectual property.
Build reusable methods, accelerators, assets and AI workflows for retail reinvention services.
Coach and mentor consulting teams.
Support business development and strategic pursuits collaborating with Song leadership to identify new opportunities and with Songs Consulting, Technology and Data AI teams for delivery.
Professional Technical Skills
Deep expertise in grocery, apparel or large omnichannel retail, with working knowledge of the end-to-end value chain merchandising and assortment planning, inventory and price management, promotions execution, digital commerce, in-store operations, supplier and partner operations, and last-mile fulfilment and how each stage drives customer demand, service volume and service exceptions.
First-hand practitioner experience inside leading grocery, apparel or omnichannel retailers (not advisory-only) having lived these operations, partnered with frontline teams, and redesigned them at enterprise scale.
Proven track record across service strategy advisory, experience design, operating model transformation, technology AI transformation, and enterprise delivery; consulting background is valuable but strong industry leadership experience counts equally.
Hands-on shopper/customer service experience across the lifecycle: order status and delivery-exception handling; substitutions, out-of-stock and refund/credit resolution; returns and reverse-logistics servicing; loyalty, rewards and membership servicing; complaint, feedback and social/review response; and multi-channel delivery (mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social) with consistent resolution regardless of entry channel.
Supplier and partner service experience: onboarding, compliance and account management; forecast, purchase-order and inventory collaboration; quality issues, disputes and score-carding; invoice, payment and reconciliation servicing; and supplier/partner portals, EDI exchanges and account-management workflows.
Store and workforce service experience: inventory accuracy, price integrity and promotion execution at store level; pick, pack and in-store fulfilment; store-to-contact-centre escalation and case hand-off; associate empowerment tools (store apps, picker/associate devices, knowledge assistants); and workforce scheduling, service standards and frontline performance management.
Fulfilment and ecosystem service experience: delivery orchestration, routing and ETA/live tracking; failed-delivery, missed-slot and delivery-recovery workflows; reverse logistics and returns-to-warehouse operations; driver, dispatcher and 3PL partner management; and last-mile SLAs, on-time performance and partner score-carding.
Working knowledge of core retail service processes order-to-delivery, returns refunds, complaint case management, store-to-contact-centre escalation, substitution/refund workflows and supplier dispute resolution with the SLAs and benchmarks that define operational excellence, and fluency in how cases move end-to-end (detect, triage/categorise, route/assign, investigate/enrich, decide/approve, orchestrate, execute/communicate, confirm/close).
Exposure to the retail service technology and AI stack: CRM CCaaS (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect); knowledge case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk); conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow); systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, PIM/MDM, pricing and promotions engines); supplier/EDI portals and IoT/GPS-enabled tracking; and the underlying AI/ML stack (intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs, policy/rules engines, predictive/prescriptive models, decisioning/optimisation and root-cause analytics).
Experience designing target operating models that combine human and AI/agentic capacity reusable service capability design, hybrid workforce design, and governance/guardrail frameworks (policy business rules, approvals escalation, human-in-the-loop controls, SLAs entitlements, privacy consent, security access, compliance audit, model/agent performance governance, ethics bias controls, and data quality traceability).
Demonstrated track record of driving measurable outcomes customer value (NPS/CSAT, trust, advocacy); growth (repeat purchase rate, average order value, attach rate, customer lifetime value); service quality productivity (first-contact and overall resolution, reduced cost-to-serve and contact volume, higher associate productivity); and availability resilience (in-stock rate, on-time delivery/payment, margin protection, and supply/compliance resilience).
Executive stakeholder management, communication and storytelling; ability to build and defend a business case at board level; fluency across business, experience, operations, technology and AI/data teams; and comfort translating complex operating models into a clear enterprise narrative.
Additional information
Experience in retail, customer service or enterprise service transformation, including large-scale programmes delivered end-to-end from strategy through implementation; the ideal candidate blends industry and consulting experience.
Reports to the Customer Service Managing Director; builds and leads a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts, with accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M.
Employment type: Permanent. Work arrangement: remote / hybrid / onsite, flexed to client and project needs; travel expectation varies by client engagement.
MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred. Relevant certifications a plus CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking, or platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).



Qualification
Experience in Retail industry (physical + digital) - Grocery, Apparel or large omnichannel retail sector experience
Good to have skills: relevant certifications (CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking) and platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).
Educational Qualification: MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred; MBA or equivalent degree in Business, Strategy, Sales Marketing.

Job Summary
To provide hands-on ownership of Acuity's enterprise Salesforce ecosystem across user support, platform administration, data management, integration, enhancements and user enablement. The role will translate business needs into secure, scalable CRM solutions; strengthen data quality; support responsible AI adoption; and turn Salesforce data into actionable commercial insight.
Another important angle will be to improve forecasting accuracy by developing repeatable, data-led approaches that use opening pipeline position, conversion, win rates, sales cycle dynamics and deal level signals to better anticipate quarterly and year-end sales outcomes.
Responsibilities
Business-facing support and ownership: Act as the primary contact for Salesforce incidents, service requests, enhancements and user queries; manage intake, prioritization, communication, resolution and escalation; provide training, release updates and clear documentation.
Salesforce administration: Manage users, licenses, profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing settings and access reviews; configure Flows, approvals, validation and assignment rules, record types, page layouts, Dynamic Forms and Lightning pages; maintain reports, dashboards, queues and notifications.
Platform development and continuous improvement: Apply configuration-first thinking while using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and APIs where appropriate; troubleshoot defects, address root causes, reduce technical debt and coordinate environments, deployments and post-release validation.
Integrations and data management: Support Salesforce integrations with ERP, billing, CPQ, e-signature, marketing and other enterprise platforms; oversee APIs, authentication, middleware, monitoring and error handling; lead migration, cleansing, deduplication, reconciliation, backup and validation activities.
AI, analytics and forecasting: Build operational and executive dashboards covering pipeline, conversion, sales, forecasting, revenue, customers, adoption and service performance; establish repeatable predictive methods to forecast quarterly and year-end landing positions using opening pipeline, stage conversion, win rates, sales-cycle velocity, slippage and deal-level risk; identify and deliver high-value use cases using Agent force, Einstein and related capabilities.
Governance, risk and documentation: Maintain effective release, change, backup, testing and deployment controls; support audits and ITGC requirements; maintain solution designs, SOPs, configuration inventories, deployment records and user guidance; coordinate vendors while retaining clear internal accountability.
Stakeholder partnership: Work closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Billing, Delivery, IT and external partners to support connected Lead-to-Order and Order-to-Cash processes, including merger and acquisition initiatives.
Key Competencies
Customer and support orientation: Approachable and accountable front line for Salesforce users.
Technical depth: Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, APIs, testing and deployment, balancing configuration-first thinking with development and integration capability.
Commercial forecasting and analytical judgement: Converts CRM data into reliable forecasts, early-warning indicators and practical actions for Sales Leadership; challenges assumptions and explains variance clearly.
AI and automation mindset: Identifies AI and automation opportunities that simplify day to day business processes
Ownership and delivery: Takes responsibility from problem definition through design, delivery, validation, adoption and support.
Communication and stakeholder management: Make complex principles easy to understand and explain technical and analytical topics clearly to users, technical teams and senior leadership.
Continuous improvement: Identifies opportunities for automation, simplification, innovation and improved user experience.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in computer science preferred but Information Systems, Engineering, Analytics or a related discipline considered too, Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification required, with Sales Cloud Consultant, Platform Developer, Omni studio, CPQ, platform data architect or Agent force certification advantageous.

Strong verbal communication skills in both English and Tamil.
Graduate degree.
Proven ability to handle in-person interactions with empathy, patience, and professionalism.
Excellent problem-solving skills and a resourceful mindset when addressing challenges.
Highly organized, self-motivated, and team-oriented with a passion for empowering others.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Position- Sales Development Representative (US)
About Simplilearn
Founded in 2010 and based in Plano, Texas, and Bangalore, India, Simplilearn, a Blackstone portfolio company, is a global leader in digital upskilling, enabling learners across the globe with access to world-class training to individuals and businesses worldwide. Simplilearn offers 1,500+ live classes each month across 150+ countries, impacting over 8 million learners globally. The programs are designed and delivered with world-renowned universities, top corporations, and leading industry bodies via live online classes featuring top industry practitioners, sought-after trainers, and global leaders. From college students and early career professionals to managers, executives, small businesses, and big corporations, Simplilearns role-based, skill-focused, industry-recognized, and globally relevant training programs are ideal upskilling solutions for diverse career or business goals.
We are disrupting the talent development market with our one-of-a-kind online subscription product, Simplilearn Learning Hub+, which enables organizations to offer their workforce unlimited live and interactive learning led by experts, along with a comprehensive library of on-demand content and hands-on projectsall in one single plan.
Job Summary: We are looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our team. As an SDR, you will be responsible for identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and managing leads through the sales pipeline. You will work closely with the sales team to ensure that our company’s sales goals are met.

We are looking for someone who has excellent communication skills, a strong work ethic, and a proven track record of success in sales. If you are a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to apply.
Key Responsibilities
Identify potential customers and generate new business opportunities for the company.
Contact and qualify potential customers.
Set appointments and follow up on leads.
Track progress towards meeting sales goals.
Collaborate with the sales team to develop strategies for reaching sales targets.
Use customer relationship management (CRM) software to manage leads and sales activities.
Stay up-to-date on market trends, competition, and industry developments.
Attend networking events and tradeshows to build relationships and generate leads.
Provide regular reports on sales activities and results to management.

Qualifications
0-1 years of experience in sales or customer service.
Proficiency in customer relationship management (CRM) software.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to build and maintain relationships with potential clients.
Knowledge of sales techniques and strategies.
Strong problem-solving and negotiation skills.
Time management and organizational skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Flexibility and adaptability to change.
A desire to learn and grow in the sales field.
Bachelor’s degree in business or related field.

Why Join Us?

Work with a high-performing international team in a dynamic, rapidly growing company.
Make a significant impact by contributing to the most disruptive technologies of AI and Blockchain.
Attractive compensation package with performance-based incentives.
Collaborative and innovative environment offering ample opportunities for professional growth and development.
Shift Timing:
US - 6:00 PM - 3:00 AM

Description:
Picture yourself brightening someones day. When you join our Hotels team, thats exactly what youll do every time you come to work. As a Food Beverage Attendant, youll play an essential role in delivering friendly, attentive, and efficient service across our dining outlets.
Whether welcoming guests, taking orders, serving food and beverages, or ensuring the outlet is ready for service, youll help create experiences that make every stay special.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Previous experience in food and beverage, hospitality, or customer service is preferred.
A passion for delivering friendly and attentive guest service.
Basic knowledge of food and beverage service procedures.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.
Positive, team-oriented, and adaptable approach.
Well-presented, reliable, and committed to maintaining high service standards.
Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays when required.
Ability to stand for extended periods and perform the physical requirements of the role.
Heres what youll do during a typical day:
Deliver warm and attentive service: Welcome guests, take orders accurately, serve food and beverages, and respond promptly to guest requests.
Create memorable guest experiences: Build positive relationships with guests, anticipate their needs, and handle feedback professionally.
Maintain service excellence: Follow Hiltons service standards and ensure food and beverages are presented and delivered to the highest quality.
Support smooth outlet operations: Assist with table setup, clearing, resetting, cleaning, and preparing the outlet before, during, and after service.
Work effectively as a team: Coordinate closely with colleagues, supervisors, kitchen teams, and other departments to ensure seamless service.
Support revenue and efficiency: Promote menu items and special offers where appropriate, process orders accurately, and minimize wastage.
Uphold health and safety standards: Follow food safety, hygiene, sanitation, alcohol awareness, and workplace safety procedures at all times.
Develop your skills: Participate in training and continuously build your knowledge of menus, service techniques, and hospitality standards.

Job Title
CLO Administrator (TSS Operations), NCT
Location
Mumbai, India
Role Description
Our purpose as a business is to be dedicated to our clients lasting success and financial security. We want to be a bank that creates a positive impact for clients, employees, investors, and society. This is made possible by our people. As youll discover, our culture supports this - diverse, international, and shaped by a variety of different perspectives. We are driven by a shared sense of purpose. At every level agile thinking is nurtured and rewarded with support and provided with opportunities to excel together.
Trust Securities Services (TSS) have over 1,500 clients ranging from multi-national corporations to banks and financial institutions, hedge funds, asset managers and supranational agencies around the world. TSS Operations support all types of transactions in the debt capital markets - from conventional to structured debt products, Project Finance, REITs and Islamic Finance - and services for escrows, restructurings, exchanges, Loan Agency, Depository Receipts, Structured Finance and US Mortgage. This is a knowledge intensive role responsible for managing the Debt security lifecycle operations.
The Trade and/or Transaction Analyst role will require the individual to liaise with internal partners and/or external clients and within the wider market to improve market practices and platforms. To build and manages partnerships between internal businesses to ensure that the bank s business objectives are delivered, comply with operational control, external regulation and continue to improve the bank s technology platforms, as appropriate. Where relevant, they focus on new business initiatives and working as a team to ensure full front-to-back operational readiness for products ranging from high-volume vanilla trading through to highly complex structured transactions. Regulatory change and an ever-evolving business environment mean that the Trade and/or Transaction Analyst must continually provide input and create innovative solutions to deliver efficiencies and protect the bank and its shareholders.
Your key responsibilities
As an Analyst, you are expected to be self-driven and to collaborate with internal team/s.
Responsible and accountable for the operational performance and day to day deliverables aligned with business goals. Perform internal controls and support daily production.
Plan and execute responsibilities to manage People, Process, Risk and Operational Excellence.
Should be able manage the daily calls with the Business/onshore, understand and articulate requirements from the onshore for the smooth functioning of the process.
Responsible for addressing ad-hoc issues and client queries on a timely basis, ensuring all communications have been responded to before end of day.
Ensure standard operating procedures and all documentation are updated regularly for your process to audit standards.
Ensure team follows standard operating procedures for all operational functions.
Work in compliance with company policies and procedures. Ensure mandatory compliance courses are completed on time by you and your team.
Coach, mentor, develop and provide career development planning and opportunities to the team members. Motivate and support them to achieve their objectives and goals.
Conduct performance review and provide performance feedback to staff.
Identify and reward performers through various recognition programs.
The role requires excellent leadership, people management, time management, communication and influencing skills at a senior level.
Work collaboratively with different departments and stakeholders.
Process improvement and redesign - proactively identify, analyze, and improve existing processes / process reengineering.
Partner extensively with IT for system issues, system changes and enhancements and assist in requirements gathering and managing the execution.
Your skills and experience
Ability to analyze training needs and requirements.
Excellent interpersonal communication and organizing skills to coordinate project activities
Good decision-making skills with appropriate response to high pressure situations
Ability to manage multiple task effectively and efficiently
Willingness to work in the rotational shift.
Good written verbal communication skills.
MS Office skills (especially MS excel)
Ability to deliver high transaction productivity and a high level of attention to detail.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.
How we'll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

Purpose & Scope of Position
The Construction Manager (CM) has the overall responsibility for managing all construction activities at the site, in collaboration with the Project Manager and in accordance with the Project Execution Plan. The CM working from the project office is responsible for the overall planning, direction, organization, and budgeting of all construction work, on the project to the highest safety and quality levels within time and costs constraints. The CM participates in the conceptual development of a construction project and oversees organization, scheduling and implementation strategy. The CM acts as the TCE representative for all relationships with the client or owner, local authorities, partners, contractors and vendors.
Experience
• Minimum 10-15 years of previous construction management experience • Typically 15-20 years of experience in the design or constructability, implementation and management of construction sites for large scale industrial multidisciplinary projects
Qualification
• Postgraduate or graduate in an engineering discipline • Post graduate degree or diploma in construction management (preferable)
Key Responsibilities
1. Manages and is responsible for the following onsite functions like Health, safety, environment and security, Quality assurance and quality control, Construction supervision, Field engineering, Site project controls, Site contract administration, Site materials management, Site administration etc 2. Manages the day to day operations of the project site including associated facilities and services 3. Reports to the Project Manager on the progress of works and of any occurrence in the field that may affect the project execution 4. Coordinate with the client, project management, and project services in identifying required reporting procedures and formats for client and TCE management needs 5. Ensure corporate policies and procedures are fully implemented 6. Direct, monitor and motivates construction engineers and other subordinates or construction specialists in performance and direct activities as necessary to ensure project requirements are achieved 7. Establish the construction requirements for pre-fabrication and modularization 8. Ensure adherence to all local regulations and statutory requirements in site activities planning 9. Ensures project complies with applicable national or international, provincial or state or territorial, municipal or local legislation and regulations 10. Maintains efficient and respectful relations with the client or owner on site, and reinforces the importance of client or owner relations and satisfaction within the site organization 11. Ensures that work is carried out in accordance with current and (or) applicable codes, and standards, design deliverables (drawings, specifications, etc.). 12. Responsible for Modularization plans, constructability review and construction strategies 13. Establish and maintain effective working relationships with clients and take responsibility for ensuring customer satisfaction for construction and completions activities. 14. Provide an environment of continual improvement of construction management skills, expertise, and capacity to ensure our success in project delivery. Provide development initiatives to create and sustain a holistic approach to the Construction Management Talent Pool. 15. Manage subcontractors and vendors: Ensure their work is scheduled and coordinated well in advance. Provide direction as requested or required. Ensure compliance with subcontract terms, and adherence to the overall project schedule 16. Ensure proper implementation of the corporate Health, Safety and Environment program, and any applicable project specific policies and procedures. Intervene to resolve safety concerns immediately 17. Manage the change process: Identify and communicate scope changes, prepare and submit cost and schedule change estimates, negotiate and process client change orders and issue subcontractor and vendor change orders 18. Supervise project demobilization, staffing transitions and document archiving

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! As a Front Office Associate , you re not just supporting guest services operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
Heres what youll do during a typical day:
Support guest services operations: Coordinate department activities and support lobby and bell team members as needed to ensure consistent, high-quality guest service
Provide exceptional service: Respond promptly and professionally to phone, email, and in-person inquiries from clients, guests, and team members
Delight our guests: Greet guests warmly and assist with directions, local recommendations, and general information as needed to enhance the guest experience
Prepare group documentation: Organize and verify all paperwork, rooming lists, and necessary details to ensure accurate and timely delivery of guest amenities and group luggage
Support special projects: Assist with coordinating departmental initiatives or ad-hoc assignments
Provide administrative support: Assist department managers with clerical work such as word processing, data entry, filing, and copying

Job Description
Designation - Field Sales Executive
About Rentokil PCI
Rentokil PCI is India's leading pest control service provider and a Rentokil Initial brand. Formed in 2017 through a joint venture between Pest Control India and Rentokil, it operates across 300 locations, aiming to set new standards in customer service. The company focuses on
industry-leading operations through best practices, innovation, and digital technologies. In 2024, Rentokil PCI strengthened its market leadership by acquiring HiCare, expanding its services and
footprint further.
For more details: https://www.rentokil-pestcontrolindia.com
About the Role:
The role is responsible for identifying, sourcing and securing long-term and short-term pest control & prevention business opportunities. The incumbent shall be primarily responsible for the New Sales Productivity, Renewal and Collection as per the assigned targets.
The person will report to the Branch Manager. The incumbent will have to work as part of a multi-functional team involving collaboration with the internal team and external stakeholders.
Job Responsibilities:
Job Responsibilities:
Business Development (Sales):
Achieve sales targets as per the branch's approved business plan
Execute sales promotion activities within the assigned territory
Ensure all Sales KPIs are achieved on a month-on-month basis
Identify and follow up with prospective customers; respond to enquiries within defined
timelines
Maximise the conversion of enquiries into confirmed orders
Ensure contract renewals are in line with company expectations
Track market developments and identify new business opportunities
Prepare and regularly update the Monthly Performance Grid (MPG)
Customer Service:
Ensure high-quality service delivery to all customers
Maintain strong liaison and communication with clients
Prepare and submit customer reports promptly
Address customer complaints and work with Operations and Back Office to resolve them
effectively
Conduct detailed site inspections and SRAs
Generate quotations through the system as per company guidelines
Share customer feedback with the Branch Manager and collect appreciation letters from
RBU/CBU clients
Set realistic and accurate customer expectations regarding pest management services
Capture correct and complete customer information (email, two contact numbers, address
with landmarks)
Promote visit-based sales as per iCABS frequency to enable structured annual service
calendars
Share cost sheets and material requirements with Operations; communicate customer
expectations before service delivery
Ensure new sales are visible in iCABS for planning and execution via Service Companion
Punch new sales in SRA on time to allow sufficient lead time for planners; coordinate with
Service Planners for scheduling
Avoid making direct service scheduling commitments to customers without planner
confirmation
Administration & Accounts:
Ensure timely invoice submission and obtain necessary acknowledgements
Coordinate with the Back Office for accurate and timely invoicing
Share costings and customer expectations with Operations in advance
Ensure timely submission of collections and review daily billing status with the Back Office
team.
Maintaining Systems and MIS
Ensure timely and accurate updates in all sales-related systems
Prepare daily and monthly sales reports
Maintain an updated and organised customer database
Key Result Areas:
Business Development (Sales)
Upselling
Renewals (if assigned)
Calls / Survey / Quotations/ PDSA as per the Regional plan
Collection & DSO
Customer Service
On-Time Invoice Submission

Educational Qualification / Other Requirement:
Any Graduate (Any discipline)
Proficient in MS-Office/G-Suite
Experience - Jr. SE - 2 years | SE - 4 Years | Sr. SE - 5-6 years.
Minimum 2 years of direct sales experience in Facilities Management services
Minimum 2 years of experience in home products, home services, or residential cleaning
