Job Description & Candidate Preparation Guide
Career Development Ocer (CDO)
1. About Jaro Education
Jaro Education is India's most trusted online higher education company and a pioneer in the executive
and online education industry. Founded in 2009 by Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe, the company has been self-
funded and protable since inception. Jaro Education has been honored with the EdTech Leadership
Award and recognized as a National Best Employer by the World HRD Congress.
Jaro Education bridges the gap between top-tier global academic institutions and ambitious
professionals. The organization nurtures entrepreneurs and working executives across entry-level to C-
Suite roles through strategic aliations with globally renowned universities and business schools,
including:
IIMs: IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Indore, IIM Kozhikode, IIM Mumbai, IIM Nagpur, IIM Tiruchirappalli,
IIM Visakhapatnam
IITs and IIT-linked institutions: IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Jammu, IIT Palakkad, IIT Roorkee,
E&ICT Academy IIT Kanpur, E&ICT Academy IIT Guwahati, IITM Pravartak IIT Madras
Technology Innovation Hub
Other premier Indian institutions: IISc, XLRI, IMT Ghaziabad, Loyola Institute of Business
Administration (LIBA), IFEEL Institute for Future Education, Entrepreneurship and Leadership,
MIT Institute of Design / MIT IDSS, Niranjan Hiranandani School of Real Estate & HSNC University
Indian Universities and Higher Education Partners: Adani Institute of Digital Technology
Management, Amity University, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bharati Vidyapeeth / BVDU,
Chandigarh University, Dayananda Sagar University (Bengaluru), Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth
Centre for Online Learning (DPU-COL, Pune), Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute, JAIN
Online, MAHE Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Manipal University, Manipal University
Jaipur, Parul University, Sikkim Manipal University, Symbiosis International (Deemed University) /
SSODL
Global Academic and Executive Education Partners: Deakin University (Australia) & KPMG
in India, Harvard Business Impact, Imperial College Business School Executive Education, Rotman
School of Management (University of Toronto) & IITM Pravartak, Wharton Interactive
Company Vision: To be globally recognized for providing a seamless learning platform for professionals
around the world.
Page 1 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Company Mission: To make high-quality, outcome-oriented executive education accessible to every
student and professional at all stages of their career.
2. Role Overview & Snapshot
The Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist plays a critical role in driving
business growth by engaging with working executives, assessing their career goals, and counseling them
on higher education options. This is an end-to-end sales and counseling role that combines lead
generation, relationship building, and consultative program matching.
Designation
Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist
Admissions & Executive Education Sales
Department
Target Audience
Working Days
Working Professionals, Corporate Executives & Freshers
Monday to Saturday (Sunday Weekly-O)
10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Note: Shift may stretch basis business
requirements)
Working Hours
Dress Code
Mon Fri: Business Formals | Saturday: Smart Casuals
Primary CRM Tool
LeadSquared
3. Key Responsibilities & Performance Expectations
High-Volume Lead Outreach & Prospecting
¢ Connect daily with a minimum of 80 working professionals sourced from the LeadSquared CRM
database to build a healthy sales pipeline.
¢ Initiate conversations using cold-calling and warm lead nurture strategies, establishing rapid rapport
with high-potential prospects.
Consultative Counseling & Needs Analysis
¢ Analyze candidate professional backgrounds, current skills, domain expertise, and future career
aspirations.
¢ Identify skill gaps and recommend optimal executive programs, degree courses, diplomas, or
certications from Jaros university partners.
¢ Conduct structured telephonic, virtual, or in-person counseling sessions detailing curriculum
highlights, faculty credentials, learning methodologies, and career outcomes.
Page 2 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
End-to-End Sales Execution & Enrolment
¢ Guide prospects through the complete sales funnelfrom cold calling to lead nurturing, objection
handling, fee negotiation, and nal enrolment closures.
¢ Maintain consistent, personalized follow-up schedules with high-intent leads to maximize conversion
rates.
¢ Meet or exceed assigned daily activity deliverables, weekly conversion targets, and monthly revenue
metrics.
Operations & Data Management
¢ Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead statuses, meeting notes, follow-up dates, and payment
stages in LeadSquared.
¢ Coordinate closely with internal Admissions, Student Support, and Operations teams to ensure a
seamless onboarding experience for enrolled learners.
¢ Stay up-to-date with evolving EdTech trends, institutional accreditation updates, and competitor
oerings.
4. Candidate Prole & Prerequisites
¢ Education & Experience: Bachelors degree in any discipline. Freshers with exceptional
communication skills or candidates with prior sales/EdTech outreach experience are preferred.
¢ Communication Skills: Fluency in English with strong verbal, written, and persuasive articulation
capabilities.
¢ Sales Mindset: High competitive drive, negotiation skills, objection-handling capability, and comfort
working in target-driven environments.
¢ Interpersonal Skills: Empathy, active listening, and the ability to build immediate rapport with mid-to-
senior working professionals.
¢ Technical Savvy: Basic familiarity with Microsoft Oce (Excel, Word) and CRM applications like
LeadSquared.
5. Career Growth Pathway
¢ Structured Career Path: Opportunities to transition from CDO to Senior CDO, Team Leader,
Assistant Manager, and Business Manager based on performance and target achievements.
Page 3 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Interview Preparation Kit
Please review the following instructions and preparation guidelines before attending your interview with
Jaro Education.
A. General Interview Hygiene & Rules
1. Professional Appearance: Dress in business formals (MonFri style) to demonstrate
professionalism.
2. Technical Setup: Ensure a stable high-speed internet connection, functional camera/microphone,
and a silent, distraction-free environment for virtual meetings.
3. Communication Delivery: Keep answers crisp, structured, and focused. Avoid lengthy anecdotes
or o-topic details.
4. Energy & Condence: Demonstrate high energy, enthusiasm, and articulate speech throughout
the conversation.
5. Past Employer Etiquette: Maintain a strictly positive, objective, and factual approach when
discussing previous employers. Do not speak negatively about former companies or colleagues.
B. Fundamental Concepts to Master
1. What is EdTech?
Denition: EdTech (Educational Technology) refers to the integration of technology, software, and
hardware tools into educational processes to enhance learning accessibility, engagement, and
eectiveness.
Industry Context: Explain why online higher executive education is essential todayallowing
working professionals to upskill without pausing their full-time careers.
2. What is Consultative Selling?
Denition: A sales approach focused on prioritizing the buyer's needs, challenges, and goals rather
than aggressively pushing a product.
Application at Jaro Education: As a CDO, you do not simply "sell a course." You rst identify a
professionals career bottlenecks, understand their skill gaps, and then recommend the specic
executive program that aligns with their career growth.
Page 4 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
C. Sample Interview Questions & Preparation Strategies
Important Note: Interview questions may change from person to person depending on individual
candidate proles and interviewer evaluation. The questions below are representative FAQ example
types to aid your preparation.
¢ "Walk me through your resume and key achievements."
Tip: Focus on your outreach metrics, target achievements, past sales/counseling experience, and
everyday responsibilities.
¢ "Why do you want to build a career in the EdTech industry?"
Tip: Highlight the rapid growth of the online education sector, your passion for career counseling, and
the impact of upskilling working professionals.
¢ "How do you handle a candidate who says the program fee is too high?"
Tip: Demonstrate consultative sellingreframe the fee as a long-term career investment, highlight the
prestige of partner institutes (e.g., IIMs, IITs, Wharton Interactive, Harvard Business Impact), and
discuss nancial exibility (EMIs, loan support).
¢ "What is your reason for leaving your current/previous role?"
Tip: Provide an honest, professional, and growth-oriented answer (e.g., seeking better exposure,
career progression, or entry into the EdTech industry).
¢ "How do you explain gaps in your career (if applicable)?"
Tip: Be transparent, condent, and concise. Explain how you utilized the gap period productively
(certications, skill-building, personal responsibilities).
D. Quick Checklist Before Joining the Interview
Researched Jaro Educations company background, leadership (Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe), vision, and
mission.

Memorized key partner institutions across categories (e.g., IIMs, IITs, IISc, XLRI, Wharton Interactive,
Harvard Business Impact).

Prepared to explain past key performance indicators (KPIs), call targets, and sales achievements.

Reviewed the core denition of Consultative Selling and EdTech.

Dressed in crisp business formal attire.

All the best for your interview!

Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our
Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a
minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local
network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting
monthly disbursement targets.

targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by
the company.
• Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities
through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
• Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used
vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.

customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.

collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.

monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired
portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used
CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
• Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle
market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
• Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-
building skills.
• Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for
extensive field travel.

What We Offer
• Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive
structure.
• Travel allowances.
• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.

The role focuses on acquiring new academic partners, expanding existing accounts, and positioning L&T EduTechs industry-aligned skilling and learning solutions to higher education institutions. The incumbent will manage end-to-end sales cycles, engage academic stakeholders, and ensure sustained business growth within the assigned territory.

Key Responsibilities
Drive B2B institutional sales for College Connect programs across assigned regions.
Identify and engage with engineering colleges, universities, and academic institutions to promote L&T EduTech offerings.
Build strong relationships with Principals, Directors, Deans, HODs and academic leadership.
Understand institutional needs and propose solution-based skilling programs aligned to curriculum enhancement and employability outcomes.
Manage the complete sales lifecycle including lead generation, proposal submission, negotiation, and deal closure.

Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)

Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting monthly disbursement targets.

Key Responsibilities & KRAs
Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by the company.
Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-building skills.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for extensive field travel.
What We Offer
Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive structure.
Travel allowances.
Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial institution.

Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.

Field Account Manager BioA

For Sartorius India Pvt. Ltd, we are looking for a Field Account Manager to join our team in Ahmadabad Pune Mumbai. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting the growth of revenue by proactively managing a range of accounts throughout Maharashtra, Gujrat, and Goa by developing and maintaining strong KOL relationships. Job Summary
For Sartorius India Pvt. Ltd, we are looking for a Field Account Manager to join our team in Ahmadabad Pune Mumbai. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting the growth of revenue by proactively managing a range of accounts throughout Maharashtra, Gujrat, and Goa by developing and maintaining strong KOL relationships. The goal is to achieve individual and assigned group sales target within the financial year for BioAnalytics product portfolio.
Main Responsibilities Tasks:
Initiate and manage the full sales process within the assigned territory and product range
BioAnalytics group consist of BLI (Octet), SPR (SF3), Live Cell Analysis system (Incucyte), Flow Cytometer (iQue), and Cell Selection and retrieval system (CellCelector).
Maintain the CRM with relevant and up-to-date customer and sales opportunity information in SFDC.
Develop and achieve account targets understanding customer needs and future plans.
Be customer-centric ensuring customer satisfaction without compromising the business.
Expand networks and sellupsell additional products and services.
Provide trainings, technical and commercial support to Sales Reps and customers in relevant products and processes.
Actively contribute to sales growth by identifying new opportunities at customer site.
KOL Management and development.
Identify and implement appropriate action plans to track key accounts consumption patterns.
This is an Individual contributor role.
Qualification Skills:
Master in life sciences (Biotechnology, Microbiology or Biochemistry), With a PhD preferred. Experience in the industry from Bioasay group or Biosimilar groups preferred.
Minimum 5 years of field sales experience in the west region. Candidates with international experience are an addition.
Experience in handling Live Cell imagers, Confocal microscopes, Flow Cytometry, SPR or from the Cell Biology field will be preferred.
Relevant technical knowledge and extensive industry knowledge (eg. Biotech, Pharma, etc.)
Experience in selling capital instrumentation is an addon.
Result-oriented and highly motivated.
Capable of providing outstanding customer service.
Ability to manage complex issues using innovation and processes.
A track record of strong compliance and customer reference is required.
Ability to manage and work in Matrix organization.

Sales Manager - Engineering Plastics Non-Auto
You are responsible for business-to-business (B2B) sales and market expansion for high-performance polymers (such as PC, PBT, PET, ABS, PMMA, PA, PP, ASA, PET, Nylon, Poly and POM blends) outside the automotive sector.
Key Role Responsibilities
Non-Automotive Application Development:
F Target sectors including electrical and electronics, consumer appliances, industrial machinery, lighting, packaging, and medical/healthcare.
F Manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation to negotiation and order closure.
New Business & OEM Acquisition:
F Identify prospective OEMs, tier-1/tier-2 converters, and processors to pitch custom polymer compounds and engineering resins.
F Forecast sales, develop out of the box sales strategies/models and evaluate their effectiveness.
F Evaluate Customer needs and build productive long-lasting relationships.
F Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements to identify new business opportunities.
F Achieve monthly and annual sales targets while ensuring high customer satisfaction.
Technical & Commercial Coordination:
F Bridge the gap between R&D/technical teams’ production, planning, quality and procurement departments to run material trials, sample approvals to ensure timely execution of customer orders and volume negotiations
F Prepare sales forecasts, MIS reports, and pipeline updates for management review.
Key Account Management:
F Manage distributor networks, handle pricing/forecasting, and track accounts receivable (A/R).
F Research accounts and generate of follow through sales leads.
F Meet personal and team sales target.
F Report and provide feedback to management using financial statistical data.
F Maintain and expand client database within your assigned territory.
F Conduct customer visits, product presentations, and technical discussions to promote packaging solutions.
F Prepare quotations, negotiate commercial terms, and finalize contracts while maintaining company profitability.

Preferred candidate profile
1. BE or BSc with 5 to 13 years of B2B field sales experience in polymer raw materials, engineering plastics, or masterbatches.
2. Proven track record of handling key accounts and achieving sales targets.
3. Strong B2B sales and business development expertise.
4. Experience in key account management and strategic customer acquisition.
5. Strong commercial acumen and market analysis skills.
6. Familiarity with different sales techniques and pipeline management.
7. Computer literacy including Office Productivity Software - CRM, MS Office, and sales reporting tools etc
Excellent negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills.
8. Self-motivated and driven
9. Knowledge of polymer extrusion/injection molding, strong negotiation skills, and a willingness to travel for client site visits.
10. Willingness to travel extensively for customer meetings and business development.

Remuneration:
An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Description:
Role & responsibilities
Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs.
plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development
(Attrition
Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards
Preferred candidate profile :
Candidate should has to 4 to 10 Years of Experience in store managing

Perks and benefits
ESI and PF
Family insurance policy
Incentive policy : Daily - weekends - monthly - festival incentive program.
Professional Training : 25 Days training in Bangalore post selection in Lenskart Academy .

Location: Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bangalore
Department: Alliances & Partnerships
Company:Livspace
About the Role
Livspace is looking for energetic and customer-focused MBA graduates to join our Alliances & Partnerships team.
As a **Marketing Specialist*, you will be stationed at assigned premium builder projects and will act as the face of Livspace at the property. You will own the complete customer journey—from the first interaction at the builder site to the final home interior booking.
This is a high-ownership role where you will collaborate with builder sales teams, engage prospective homeowners, drive Experience Centre visits, coordinate with Livspace designers, and ensure an exceptional customer experience throughout the buying journey.
---
Key Responsibilities
 Project Ownership
* Own one or more assigned builder projects end-to-end.
* Build strong working relationships with builder sales, CRM, and project teams.
* Ensure seamless execution of all Livspace partnership activities at the assigned property.
Customer Engagement
* Represent Livspace at the builder sales office.
* Engage with prospective homebuyers visiting the project.
* Explain Livspace's exclusive partnership benefits, offers, and interior solutions.
* Capture customer information and qualify potential interior requirements.
Experience Centre (ECV) Conversion
* Drive customers to visit the Livspace Experience Centre.
* Schedule appointments and coordinate customer visits.
* Follow up consistently to maximize Experience Centre visit conversions.
 Sales Coordination
* Work closely with Livspace Design Consultants and Sales teams after the customer's Experience Centre visit.
* Ensure smooth handover and continuous customer engagement.
* Track customer progress through every stage of the sales funnel until booking.
Customer Relationship Management
* Act as the single point of contact for customers throughout their interior journey.
* Resolve customer concerns by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
* Deliver an outstanding customer experience to improve conversion rates and customer satisfaction.
Stakeholder Management
* Maintain strong relationships with builder stakeholders.
* Coordinate marketing activities and partnership initiatives at the project.
* Share regular project performance updates with internal teams.
AboutCompany: Livspace is Asias largest and fastest-growing omnichannel home interiors and renovation platform. Founded in 2014, we are a high-growth, unicorn startup backed by top-tier global investors like KKR, Goldman Sachs, and Jungle Ventures. By seamlessly combining cutting-edge technology, certified design talent, and a trusted marketplace of vendors and contractors, we deliver an end-to-end, predictable home design experience across India, Singapore, and the Middle East. At Livspace, we are redefining an unorganised industry into a structured digital ecosystem. We thrive on innovation, speed, and customer-centricity, offering an entrepreneurial environment where builders, creators, and technologists can make a massive impact at scale.

bout the Role
Are you a strategic recruiter who thrives in high-volume, dynamic environments? We are looking for a Recruitment Lead to drive end-to-end frontline manpower hiring across west region. Recruitment Process Execution & Monitoring (80%)

Ensure full compliance with internal company policies, statutory regulations, and labor laws governing recruitment.
Issue Letters of Intent (LOI) to selected candidates and actively follow up to ensure seamless transition to training centers with required documentation.
Coordinate directly with training schools on candidate rosters and arrival schedules.
Track hiring event effectiveness, course-correct plans as needed, and maintain accurate recruitment MIS and reporting.
Stakeholders & Relationships
Internal: Hub & Branch Operations Teams, ISM Officers, Recruitment Lead.
External: Prospective candidates, Government/State agencies, Gram Panchayats, local community authorities, and NGOs.
What We Are Looking For
Qualifications & Experience
Education: Graduate degree or equivalent (minimum required).
Experience: 5-7 years of relevant HR experience with a strong background in managing volume recruitment processes.

Financial Accounting & Closure: Manage day-to-day general ledger accounting, plant/project accounting, and ensure timely month-end financial closure for the Cable Division.

Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial institution.

Hi,
Job Description Solution Architect - Asset Management

Experience: 12–15 Years
Location: PAN India
Industry: Manufacturing, Utilities, Mining, Process and Asset-Intensive Industries
Technology Stack: Hexagoan

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect - Asset Management to lead Hexagon-based enterprise asset-management and shopfloor integration solutions that improve equipment reliability, maintenance execution, and production availability. The candidate must have delivered implementation programs linking maintenance with MES, operations, engineering, stores, and enterprise systems.

MES or shopfloor implementation experience is mandatory. Pre-sales and solutioning experience is also mandatory.

Key Responsibilities
Define Hexagon asset-management architecture, standards, governance, implementation approach, and roadmap.
Design asset hierarchy, equipment master data, preventive and predictive maintenance, work management, inspections, spares, and reliability processes.
Architect integration with MES, ERP, procurement, inventory, GIS, documents, mobile solutions, PLC/SCADA, historians, and condition monitoring.
Connect maintenance events and equipment availability with production schedules, work orders, downtime, OEE, and shopfloor execution.
Lead discovery, fit-gap, configuration, customization, data migration, testing, deployment, cutover, and hypercare.
Define data governance, security, mobility, performance, availability, reporting, and production-support standards.
Collaborate with operations, quality, engineering, supply chain, IT, OT, vendors, and business stakeholders.
Mentor delivery teams and enforce architecture governance, documentation, coding/configuration standards, and DevOps best practices.

Technical Skills

Mandatory
Hexagon EAM or equivalent Hexagon asset-management expertise
End-to-end EAM implementation in asset-intensive operations
Asset hierarchy, maintenance strategy, work management, inspections, spares, and reliability
MES, ERP, inventory, GIS, mobile, PLC/SCADA, historian, and condition-monitoring integration
Master-data migration, testing, deployment, cutover, and hypercare
Solution architecture, integration design, security, performance, and technical governance
Pre-sales, RFP/RFI response, estimation, solutioning, workshops, and customer presentations

Preferred
OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs, messaging, and event-driven integration
Cloud platforms, containers, DevOps, cybersecurity, analytics, and multi-site rollouts
ISA-88 / ISA-95 and relevant manufacturing-domain standards

Manufacturing Domain Knowledge

Strong understanding of:
Production execution and work-order management
Track and trace, genealogy, quality, and nonconformance management
Production-scheduling integration and material/inventory tracking
Machine, equipment, PLC, SCADA, historian, and shopfloor integration
Plant deployment, cutover, ramp-up, hypercare, and continuous improvement

Implementation Experience – Mandatory
Proven ownership of at least one full MES, shopfloor, automation, historian, or asset-management implementation lifecycle—from discovery and architecture through build/configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
Ability to lead customer and plant teams during workshops, design reviews, testing, cutover, production stabilization, and rollout.

Pre-Sales & Solutioning – Mandatory
Support RFP/RFI responses, effort estimation, technical solutioning, architecture definition, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and commercial inputs.
Create solution blueprints, integration architectures, sizing models, bills of material, implementation roadmaps, and delivery plans.
Lead customer workshops, technical presentations, architecture reviews, demonstrations, and Proof-of-Concept initiatives.

Leadership & Collaboration
Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Ability to work across business, IT, OT, engineering, quality, operations, vendors, and globally distributed teams.

Role Name: SAP BASIS Consultant
Experience: 4 to 12 Years
Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli
Work Mode: Hybrid
Roles & Responsibilities
Install, configure, administer, and monitor SAP systems across landscapes.
Perform SAP system upgrades, migrations, refreshes, and patching activities.
Manage SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver, and HANA database environments.
Execute client copies, system copies, kernel upgrades, and transport management activities.
Monitor system performance and optimize SAP application and database performance.
Perform user administration, role assignments, security, and authorization support.
Handle SAP Backup, Recovery, Disaster Recovery, and High Availability configurations.
Support incident management, problem resolution, and root cause analysis.
Collaborate with functional, development, infrastructure, and cloud teams.
Support implementation, upgrade, migration, and maintenance projects.
Ensure system availability, reliability, and compliance with organizational standards.

Mandatory Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP BASIS Administration.
Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA landscapes
Experience in Kernal Upgrade and Solution Management.
Strong knowledge of:
SAP HANA Database Administration
SAP NetWeaver Administration
Transport Management System (TMS)
SAP System Monitoring
Performance Tuning
Client Copy/System Copy
Kernel Upgrades and Patch Management
Experience in SAP installation, upgrade, and migration activities.
Knowledge of SAP security, users, roles, and authorizations.
Experience in troubleshooting SAP system performance issues.
Understanding of Backup, Recovery, High Availability, and Disaster Recovery concepts.
Experience in Linux/Unix operating systems.
Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Skills
SAP S/4HANA Conversion or Migration projects.
Exposure to SAP Solution Manager.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
HANA database migration and administration experience.

Description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way youd like, where youll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where youll be able to reimagine whats possible. Join us and help the worlds leading organizations


Your Role

We are hiring Workdaycertified Functional Consultants with strong handson experience in Workday HCM to support implementations, enhancements, and production support for global clients and business units.
You will be responsible for one or more of the following modules: Core HCM, Absence Management, Compensation, Talent Performance, Recruiting, and Benefits.
Configure and support Workday Core HCM and assigned functional modules
Work on Business Process Framework (BPF), Security, Job Architecture, and Calculated Fields
Gather business requirements and translate them into effective functional solutions
Support EIBs, Workday reporting, testing, UAT, and deployments
Perform Workday release impact analysis and provide postgolive support
Partner closely with HR, IT, and other key stakeholders to ensure successful delivery



Your Profile

HCM Core + one Advanced Workday certification is mandatory.
Overall 6+ years of IT experience in the HCM domain, with 5+ years of handson Workday experience across implementations, rollouts,andAMS engagements.
Experience in at least two full lifecycle Workday implementations.
Strong expertise in Workday HCM Core along with one advanced module: Recruiting or Absence or Time Tracking or a relevant HCM submodule.
Deep understanding of HCM business processes and endtoend HiretoRetire lifecycle.
Good understanding and practical application of Workday implementation methodologies.
Handson experience with testing, data migration, and validation activities.
Ability to conduct client workshops and requirementgathering sessions.



What you''ll love about working with us

Opportunities to work on largescale global Workday HCM implementations.
Exposure to diverse clients and complex HR transformation programs
Structured learning paths, certifications, and continuous upskilling in Workday and cloud technologies
A collaborative, inclusive culture that values flexibility and worklife balance
We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise andstrong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of 22.5 billion.
Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.

Description:
Job Summary:We are looking for a dynamic and result-driven Sales Executive to join our team in the paint industry. The ideal candidate will be responsible for generating leads, meeting sales targets, developing new customer relationships, and ensuring customer satisfaction in their designated territory.

Key Responsibilities:
Promote and sell a wide range of decorative and industrial paints to dealers, contractors, architects, and end-users.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, and key clients.
Conduct regular market visits to identify business opportunities and gather market intelligence.
Ensure timely order booking, payment collection, and inventory management at dealer/distributor points.
Achieve monthly and annual sales targets as assigned.
Organise product demonstrations, on-site sampling, and training sessions for clients.
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, sales, and follow-up actions using CRM or sales reporting tools.
Provide after-sales support and ensure customer satisfaction.

Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
Knowledge of the local market and dealer/distributor network.
Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Self-motivated and target-oriented.
AboutCompany:
Company Brief: British Paints

About Us:
British Paints is a well-established and trusted brand in the Indian paint industry, with a legacy dating back to 1919. After being acquired by Berger Paints India Ltd. in 1947, British Paints was relaunched in 2009 and has since expanded rapidly across the country.
We offer a comprehensive range of decorative and industrial paints, including emulsions, enamels, distempers, primers, and specialty coatings. Our products are known for innovation, quality, and durability, catering to residential, commercial, and industrial segments.
Head Office: New Delhi, India
Parent Company: Berger Paints India Ltd.

Why Join British Paints?
Legacy of trust and quality
Strong backing of Berger Paints
Dynamic and fast-growing organization
Opportunities for learning and advancement
Focus on employee engagement and growth

Customer database

Receipt generation
Ensure proper cash reconciliation at end of day

Support smooth coordination between:
Customers
Appraisers
Sales staff

Customer queue
Branch workflow

Attention to detail

Retail or telecalling

Customer satisfaction levels
Accuracy of documentation

Number of customer interactions handled

Entry-level role in NBFC structure
Repetitive but fast-paced work
High interaction with customers
Moderate pressure during peak business hours
Important support role but not core decision-making




Day-to-DayWork
Typicalday includes:
Handling walk-in customers
Completing KYC and documentation
Coordinating loan processing
Calling customers for follow-ups
Updating system records

Job Description
The Customer Engagement Manager is responsible for bridging the gap between Information Technology Enterprise Applications and our customer. The customer is generally internal to the Corporation. The primary objective for this role is to augment the delivery capabilities of IT services; effectively build personal relationships, provide consistent representation and leadership, and facilitate corporate growth and develop strategic vision.

Responsibilities
- Manage service requests for tools/applications (in-house and vendor) through life cycle management process including coordination with development, test, audit, security, and architecture teams.
- Ensure strength in requirements definition and appropriate level of integration is considered.
- May provide and manage configuration of certain applications supported by the Applications department.
- Provide advanced level technical support to projects as well as serve as a focal point for escalation.
- Provide Executive level presentations of implementation status and technical challenges of our customers that explain core issues, plans, and escalation topics in an easy to understand format.
- Budget and cost management of scopes of work associated with their customer base.
- Serve as an extension of both automation and enterprise database teams in order to share issues and contribute growth to support capabilities and overall maturity model.
- Develop relationships with core, regional, and local application teams as a means of fostering a standardized approach to development and deployment practices.
- Problem determination on performance and availability breaches against mission critical project infrastructure (network, domain, storage, server, database, application, client).
- Assist with prioritization of identified issues, associated fixes, and communications to resolving parties (internal technical staff, service providers, and vendors).
- Assist with development of Help Desk knowledge packs for establishing proper operational support matrix and means of identifying escalation; this includes ensuring ticket queues in place.
- Maintain a technical forum of known issues and fixes for consumption by global staff.
- Develop and maintain hosting documents for key applications in order to provide a standardized delivery mechanism across data centers and ensure consistent performance.
Basic Job Requirements
- B.E./ B.Tech degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent work experience
- 8-15 years experience in systems analysis, production support, or application development
- May have knowledge of MSSQL Server platform services (performance tuning, various types of replication, profiler and data collection, resource governor, data management views)
- Familiarity with application virtualization technologies and delivery methods to remote users
- May have Big 4 Consulting experience
- Should have participated in, and be familiar with, Agile application development methodology and practices
- Should have participated in, and be familiar with, Quality Assurance application testing methodology and practices
Other Job Requirements
Preferred Qualifications
- Accredited degree or global equivalent in Computer Science or related discipline
- Experience in computer systems or Information Technology (IT) support, with technical proficiency in operating systems and programming languages
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Strong interpersonal skills
- Excellent analytical, technical, planning, and organizational skills

Key missions of the position:
We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Service Engineer to join our team, specializing in the Troubleshooting of field complaint and perform installation, commissioning and maintenance of Wabtec systems. The candidate will require to have a strong understanding of mechanical, electrical and Pneumatic circuit diagrams, electronic components, and their working principles. This role requires hands-on experience in trou
bleshooting, repairing of Electrical, mechanical and pneumatic systems.
Roles and responsibility are as below:
Production Support: Assist in the Installation, commissioning, Testing of Wabtec system/Product in the rolling stock
Field Complaint Resolution: Troubleshoot and resolve the field complaints related to Wabtec systems, providing timely resolution and closure of the complaints. Such requirement relates to troubleshooting the Mechanical, electrical, electronics, pneumatic or maintenance related issues and relacing the defective part to close the complaint within the contractual timelines.
Installation and Commissioning: Support the installation and commissioning of the Wabtec product and performing the required testing. Enabling customer to perform the task in a right manner if needed.
Retrofit, Maintenance and Repairs: Perform retrofit, regular maintenance and emergency repairs on Wabtec products inline with procedure and site requirement.
Reporting and Documentation: Report and record the field interventions performed by himself and associated team. The service engineer would require making a report of the issue and also get the Joint notes or associated document as needed by customer contract. Daily, weekly and Monthly reports to be submitted to manager.
NCR and Failed Part Management: Maintain accountability for Non-Conformance Reports (NCR), maintain consumed spares/Failed part and site spares data. Organizing the dispatch of the defective parts from site to plant in co-ordination with plant team.
Customer Interaction: Communicate effectively with clients to understand their issues and provide clear explanations of the work performed. Follow up the closure of Nonconformity reports and work orders issued.
Travel: Willingness to travel across India to various sites as needed for warranty, installation & Commissioning, retrofit and maintenance service for the customer order.
Safety, Quality, and Compliance: Ensure all work is performed in accordance with our organizations strict safety, quality, and compliance standards.
Education/Training
Degree or Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical & electronics.
Professional Experience:
How many years of professional experience in a specific professional area are required for the position?
Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar role (Field service) preferably in the transportation railways or Lifts and escalator with good troubleshooting skills

Reading and interpreting circuit diagrams : Intermediate
Knowledge on software installation : Novice
Troubleshooting & repair:Advanced
problem-solving abilities: Advanced
Microsoft Office:Intermediate
Communication: English speaking and writing:Intermediate
Languages:
English and Hindi & Any other regional language (is an added advantage)
Other Specifications:
Position will be initially in Eastern region, subsequently transferrable anywhere in the country
Ability to learn quickly. Agility to adapt to new environment/ business strategies
Collaborate with multiple departments
Passionate to lead and take initiatives
Good attitude and interpersonal relationship

Job Title: Assistant Manager/Deputy Manager - Human Resources (Generalist Role)

Location: Ahmedabad
Experience: 4+
Department: Human Resources

Key Responsibilities:
Partner with business leaders to provide strategic HR support aligned with business goals.
Drive end-to-end HR operations including recruitment, onboarding, policy implementation, payroll coordination, and HRIS management.
Manage employee life cycle activities: joining formalities, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and exit formalities.
Act as a change agent and drive initiatives on employee engagement, retention, and culture building.
Coordinating for the performance management process including goal setting, quaterly reviews, and annual appraisals.
Handle employee grievances and disciplinary matters while ensuring within TAT and empathetic resolution.
Prepare HR dashboards, MIS reports, and analytics for decision-making and strategy.

Requirements:
Education: MBA in HR, MSW, or any equivalent postgraduate qualification in Human Resources.
Experience: Minimum 4 years of relevant HR generalist experience.
Skills:
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Proficiency in Excel, HRIS systems, and MIS reporting
Problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive issues professionally

Travel: Should be open to travel within the Gujarat State as per business needs.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. In-Plant Operations & Line Feeding
Manage day-to-day in-plant material handling, warehouse operations, and line-feeding activities.
Ensure timely and accurate delivery of materials to production lines as per the customers production schedule.
Coordinate with production, stores, planning, and supply chain teams to prevent line stoppages due to material shortages.
Monitor material movement, replenishment, FIFO compliance, and inventory accuracy.
Ensure adherence to customer SOPs, material handling procedures, and operational SLAs.
2. Key Account Management
Act as the primary point of contact for the customer and maintain strong working relationships.
Conduct regular operational review meetings and resolve customer escalations.
Monitor customer satisfaction, service quality, and KPI performance.
Identify opportunities for process improvement, additional business, and operational cost optimization.
3. Manpower & Team Management
Manage supervisors, team leaders, material handlers, and line-feeding personnel.
Ensure optimum manpower deployment as per operational requirements and production shifts.
Monitor attendance, productivity, overtime, and shift-wise performance.
Train employees on operational procedures, safety, quality, and productivity standards.
4. Performance & Cost Management
Monitor key operational KPIs, including:
Line-feeding adherence and on-time material delivery.
Inventory accuracy and material damage.
Manpower productivity and utilization.
Customer complaints and service-level compliance.
Operational cost and budget adherence.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
Drive productivity improvements, waste reduction, and cost-saving initiatives.
5. Safety, Quality & Compliance
Ensure compliance with EHS standards, 5S, and customer safety requirements.
Ensure proper material identification, storage, handling, and traceability.
Conduct regular safety audits and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and company policies.
6. Coordination & Reporting
Coordinate with customer production, warehouse, quality, procurement, and logistics teams.
Plan resources according to production schedules and changes in customer demand.
Escalate critical operational issues and implement corrective actions.
Report operational performance, risks, and improvement plans to management.

Preferred candidate profile
Graduate in any discipline; a degree or diploma in Engineering, Logistics, or Supply Chain Management is preferred.
812 years of experience in warehouse operations, in-plant logistics, line feeding, or material handling.
Prior experience in automotive or manufacturing plant operations is preferred.
Experience in customer handling, manpower management, and operational KPI monitoring is essential

The Company has grown substantially over the years and expanded It array of services across the SCM including 3PL, Transportation, Packaging, Freight Forwarding and Last Mile Delivery.
The company has been an early mover in digitising its operations in India and across the world.

Description:
Key Account Manager is responsible for Efficiently manage the therapy area by effectively reaching out to customers and increases product awareness, answer queries and introduce new products. Also responsible for Customer Focus and have industry knowledge and schedule and plan the frequency of calls and personally visit the targeted doctors as per agreed coverage list.
Our Sales team support our customers by providing clinical information about products, educational information, clinical training programs and resources.

We support healthcare providers and healthcare systems meet the goals of the patients in their communities.
Your role at our organization is integral to helping the world meet new breakthroughs that affect generations to come, and we re counting on your skills and inventiveness to help make meaningful contributions to global medical advancement.

Responsibilities

Customer Focus and Coverage
Proficient with the therapy and product related features/benefits including scientific information thereto, so as to effectively communicate with the medical doctors and handle product related customer queries.
Actively participate in identifying key and potential medical practitioners and specialists in the respective therapeutic segment in the assigned territory, and prioritize for the purpose of systematic customer coverage so as to generate maximum prescription sales for the company s range of products as per business plan.
Schedule and plan the frequency of calls and personally visit the targeted doctors as per agreed coverage list. Call on the Chemists, wholesalers as the case may be to track in-market sales of the products, booking of orders to ensure timely and adequate availability of products to meet market demand.
Utilize customer focused selling techniques (CSSP), continually assessing the knowledge of the customer and strategize to maintain high customer confidence and customer knowledge of company products.
Maintain current, approved protocol (CSSP) and promotional materials to be included in sales presentation/ detailing.
Contact customers on regular basis and deliver informative sales presentations based on customers need.
Constantly explore opportunities to develop new business within assigned therapy area.


Sales Performance & Results
Achieve and exceed the sales targets on a consistent basis through effective implementation of the sales promotion strategies and follow-up initiatives.
Specialist in the product knowledge, therapy knowledge and detailing skills so as to enhance productivity levels as expected by the Company.
Carry out Product Visibility and such ancillary or incidental activities related to the Products of the Company or Products of any other Company as may be decided from time to time, in accordance with any arrangement or agreement entered into by the Company with such other Company.
Explore opportunities to develop new businesses within assigned therapy area.


Planning & Sales Performance Management
Tactically plans to generate tertiary demand generation
Plans and executes field working as per approved tour programmes so as to cover all stakeholders as per decided frequency
Takes follow-up initiatives on feedback and customer service requirements.
Handles special product campaigns, new product launch campaigns as per Company s plans.
Covers the Nursing homes, clinics and hospitals as per agreed coverage requirements
Collects data on annual budget for medicines, mode of purchase, rate contract/tendering etc. as may be required and takes initiatives to tap these business growth avenues.
Assists in the collection of receivables, as per company policy.


Key Account Management
To nurture strategic relationships with top accounts, so a KAM must possess an in-depth knowledge of the company and its customers.
KAMs need to have a strategic perspective that goes beyond short-term gains. They must be able to juggle many moving parts and orchestrate deals and long-term plans that align with a mutually beneficial strategy.
Communication Meets
Actively participate in Cycle meetings, periodic Sales & Marketing meeting and conventions.
Conducts group meetings, medical education camps, speaker programmes as may be necessary from time to time for assigned therapy area.
Guides and helps other team members within therapy area to design and execute scientific activities as per experience.
Coaching and supervision
Actively participate in training, orienting and handholding the new comers
To be a Mentor to the Trainees, probationers and freshly inducted sales professionals in the assigned therapy area.
Expert in the therapy area and constantly providing guidance and coaching to TMs and STMs as per need.
To sanction leave of the sales professionals, as per company procedure.

About Us
Tata Consulting Engineers Limited (TCE) is the largest Indian private sector engineering and project consultancy and an emerging global leader in integrated engineering solutions. With more than 60 years of engineering excellence, TCE has a presence in over 64 countries and over 12000 completed projects, the company operates in 3 core Industry segments -Infrastructure (Water, Environment, Urban Development, Buildings, Manufacturing Facilities, Ports and Harbours, Transportation), Power (Thermal, Hydro, Nuclear, Renewable, Transmission and Distribution) and Resources - Hydrocarbons and Chemicals (Oil, Gas and Refineries, Chemicals, Petrochemicals, Fertilizers, Speciality Chemicals, Pulp and Paper, Cement, Food, Pharmaceuticals and Beverages, Tyre, Glass) as well as Mining and Metallurgy (Mining, Geology, Beneficiation, Steel, Non-ferrous). TCE serves domestic as well as international markets and is known for several first-of-its-kind projects offering Engineering Studies, Design Engineering Services, Project Management Consultancy Services, OPEX and IIOT across all three verticals. A part of Tata Group - India’s most respected group, TCE is a 100 percent subsidiary of Tata Sons Limited Design your Future with us At TCE, you will experience a supportive environment that empowers you to excel, whether you are based in our offices or at a client site. We embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, fostering a workplace where every individual can thrive by contributing their unique skills and perspectives to deliver exceptional results for our clients. Our comprehensive compensation and benefits packages are designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families, complemented by a robust global well-being program. As a leading global infrastructure firm, we are committed to your growth and success, offering access to cutting-edge technology and impactful projects that offer flexibility and significant professional opportunities. Join us and become part of a global company that values your potential and supports your career development.
Purpose & Scope of Position
Working Engineer (WE) will be part of an engineering team providing engineering services to large and small projects. WE is responsible for engineering in a 3D environment and production of 3D models and 2D drawings in accordance with project requirements under the supervision of the Project Engineer (PE). WE is required to apply specialized and/or advanced engineering principles at conceptual and detailed level. The WE participates in a wide range of projects and the activities include modeling and drafting for detailed engineering phase for multi-disciplinary projects.
Experience
• 1-4 years of experience in relevant design discipline • Experience in engineering packages
Qualification
• Postgraduate or graduate in an engineering discipline
Key Responsibilities
1. Assist the PE with the delivery of project requirements as they relate to scope, quantities, quality, cost and schedule 2. Responsible to work in an integrated 3D environment and produce design calculations, reports, specifications, evaluation reports, technical recommendations and, 3D models and 2D drawings as per project requirements 3. Produce and maintain technical and engineering deliverables using 2D and 3D engineering software as required 4. Facilitate the sharing of technical expertise across projects including archival of project documents. 5. Provide and/or participate in training for resources assigned to the project 6. Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytms B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytms PA PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. Indias largest digital lending story is brewing here. Its your opportunity to be a part of the story!

PERFECT PLACER (www.perfectplacer.com), Promoted by a team of dedicated professionals with varied background, having comprehensive and extensive industry and consultancy exposure, is “One of the most preferred and referred consultants” today in Executive Search & Placement.

PERFECT PLACER in less than half a decade has grown to be a force to reckon with, having offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, and New Delhi.

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

General Manager Sales & Marketing (Engineering Polymers / Plastics)
You are responsible for leading the commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds.
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P&L (Profit & Loss), and building B2B partnerships and oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics (e.g., Nylon, PEEK, Polycarbonates, customized polymer compounds) across target industrial segments.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic & Financial Leadership
F P&L Management: Own revenue targets, gross contribution margins, pricing strategies, and annual budgeting for engineering polymer lines.
F Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy: Formulate and execute regional or global business development plans to scale market presence.
F Market & Competitor Analysis: Track raw material pricing volatility (petrochemical trends), freight costs, and competitor benchmarks.
Business Development & Key Accounts
F OEM & Processor Relationships: Build direct relationships with major OEMs, tier-1/tier-2 suppliers, and injection moulders/converters.
F Product Substitution: Drive metal-to-plastic or standard-to-engineering polymer conversion initiatives.
F Channel Management: Establish, evaluate, and manage distributor and channel partner networks.
Commodity Market Analysis
F Monitor petrochemical pricing fluctuations, global supply chain bottlenecks, global commodity trends (PP, PE, PVC, PET), currency fluctuations, and competitor pricing to manage risk and optimize trading margins.
B2B Brand Management
F Build brand equity and trust among suppliers (refineries/producers), logistics providers, and industrial buyers.
Commercial Strategy & Trading
F Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for trading commodity and engineering polymers.
Technical & Cross-Functional Coordination
F Technical Sales Support: Collaborate with R&D, production, and quality assurance teams to define technical specifications (MFI, density, impact, tensile strength, fillers) and manage customer trials.
F Product Development: Guide sample testing, custom grade development, and compliance validation for client applications.
Team Management
F Leadership & Mentoring: Direct, coach, and evaluate regional sales managers, technical application engineers, and account executives.
F Performance Tracking: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including sales volume in metric tons, customer acquisition rates, and collection cycles.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Revenue Growth: Target achievement in sales volume and overall market share.
Profitability: Margin optimization against global commodity volatility.
Supplier & Client Acquisition: Diversity of supplier networks and conversion of B2B key accounts.
Risk-adjusted Return on Capital (RAROC): Management of credit cycles, inventory holding, and trade logistics.
Gross profit margins on plastic raw materials and compounding resins.
Sales volume (in Metric Tons) vs. quarterly/annual forecasts.
Customer acquisition rates and retention in key end-use verticals.
Inventory turnover and logistical cost optimization

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor of Engineering in Polymer or Plastics Chemical or related Engineering Field is a must with MBA in Marketing is strongly preferred with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics, polymer compounding, or chemical raw materials.
2. Strong grasp of polymer rheology, resin properties, application engineering, and ERP/CRM tools (e.g., SAP, Salesforce).
3. B2B contract negotiation, high-volume account management, cross-functional leadership, and data-driven forecasting
4. Proficiency in data-driven decision-making, supply-demand forecasting, and CRM utilization.
5. Ability to communicate complex market intelligence to C-suite executives and board members.
6. Decisive leadership when navigating volatile commodity markets or supply chain crises.

Remuneration:
An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.

Client Partnership & Business Growth

Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.

Lead development of cloud-native AI and data modernization solutions leveraging AWS services.
Contribute to thought leadership through client workshops, industry forums, conferences, and publications.
Promote innovation through reusable frameworks, automation accelerators, and solution assets.
Financial Leadership
Develop and manage annual business plans and growth targets for the AWS practice.
Drive profitable growth through effective resource planning and portfolio management.
Monitor key business metrics including revenue, margins, utilization, pipeline, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization.

Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA preferred.
18+ years of experience in technology consulting, cloud services, digital transformation, or managed services.
Proven experience leading large AWS practices, cloud consulting organizations, or strategic cloud businesses.
Demonstrated track record of managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios and driving profitable growth.
Strong understanding of AWS Cloud services, Data Platforms, AI/ML, GenAI, Security, DevOps, Modernization, and Migration services.
Experience managing executive client relationships across Fortune 500 organizations.
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal shaping, negotiations, and contract management.

We have an exciting opportunity at our company Tata Business Hub for a Lead Sourcing Role, and based on your experience and skill set, we believe this role could be a great fit for you.

Company Details : Tata Business Hub is a digital first B2B organization setup by TATA Group to holistically address the needs of Emerging Businesses. We value the pivotal role of emerging businesses in our Nations economic growth and prosperity, and believe in empowering them to be deeply aware, widely connected and digitally integrated. Offering a host of economical and highly relevant business capabilities, Tata Business Hub aims to be the catalyst, propelling emerging businesses into new frontiers of growth and performance.

At Tata Business Hub, our ambition is vast-

We want to become the pre-eminent company that works for MSMEs in India
Grow their business
Solve their challenges
Optimize their processes

Lead implementation and execution of procurement processes with existing and new vendors/ partners

Continuously assess and improve procurement processes to enhance efficiency, reduce lead times, and drive cost savings.

Exposure of MSME universe preferably in the Raw Material procurement sector.

Strong team player and comfortable with new categories and customer profile.

Work experience:

Atleast 10 years of proven experience in purchase/ procurement in one or more industries/ market/ commodity segments such as EPC, Manufacturers, OEMs, Automotive, Building materials
Entrepreneurial and business owner mindset (startup experience a big plus) owning some big accounts themselves
Passion and energy to drive hyper growth in a new yet rapidly growing business segment
If you're a motivated individual with a keen eye for quality and a desire to drive excellence in every project, we invite you to apply and join our team.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Role & responsibilities:
Customer Engagement
Manage lifecycle relationships with ~250 customers across allocated segments/projects.
Deliver proactive engagement at key milestones and moments of truth” to build trust and loyalty.
Drive customer delight through responsiveness, personalisation, and high-touch service.
Revenue Ownership

Service Excellence

Culture & Contribution
Represent HoABL’s values through respectful, professional, and customer-first behavior.
Be flexible, adaptive, and solution-driven — especially in high-stakes or emotionally charged scenarios.
Bring market intelligence and service innovation ideas from outside-in.

F&B Production 7-8 Years Full-time Leh, Ladakh
Job Summary:
Job Summary

The Sous Chef - Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting the Executive Chef in managing the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires strong knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, menu execution, and kitchen procedures, along with proven leadership skills and the ability to manage a team effectively in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

Key Responsibilities

Assist the Executive Chef in managing the day-to-day operations of the Indian kitchen.
Supervise and coordinate the work of Chefs de Partie, Commis Chefs, and other kitchen team members.
Prepare and oversee the preparation and cooking of Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, portion control, and overall food quality.
Conduct regular quality checks and ensure all dishes meet the required standards before service.
Plan and supervise mise en place and ensure adequate preparation for daily operations and service.
Assist in menu planning, development of new dishes, and implementation of seasonal and special menus.
Ensure proper handling, storage, labeling, and rotation of food items in accordance with FIFO practices.
Monitor ingredient quality, freshness, and availability and coordinate with the relevant departments for timely replenishment.
Control food wastage and assist in maintaining food-cost targets through effective production and portion control.
Ensure strict compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.
Maintain cleanliness, organization, and discipline across the Indian kitchen and assigned work areas.
Assist in managing buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, special events, and other culinary requirements.
Train, guide, and develop junior kitchen team members in Indian cooking techniques, hygiene, and standard operating procedures.
Allocate daily duties and ensure efficient deployment of kitchen personnel during service.
Monitor kitchen equipment and report maintenance requirements, malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to the Executive Chef.
Take responsibility for the Indian kitchen in the absence of the Executive Chef, ensuring uninterrupted and efficient operations.
Work closely with other kitchen sections and service teams to ensure smooth coordination and timely food delivery.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 7-8 years of experience in a professional Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Previous experience in a Sous Chef, Junior Sous Chef, or senior Chef de Partie position is preferred.
Strong knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines.
Proven experience in supervising and leading a kitchen team.
Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, ingredients, and regional cuisines.
Strong leadership and team-management skills.
Ability to maintain consistency and quality during high-volume service.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet service timelines.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good understanding of food cost, portion control, and wastage management.
Ability to train, motivate, and develop junior kitchen team members.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Ability to maintain a clean, disciplined, and professional kitchen environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, and ingredients.
Ability to work under pressure and meet service timelines.
Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Team-oriented attitude with a willingness to learn.
Ability to maintain a clean and disciplined work environment.

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.

Competitive compensation and benefits.

Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh (HIAL) is an upcoming Alternative Institute for Mountain Development which follows Contextual Learning and Experiential Pedagogy where students learn by doing and earn while they learn. Key Responsibilities:

Promote Responsible Tourism Events:
Develop and implement marketing plans to promote responsible tourism-related events and activities curated by HIAL.
Collaborate with local and international partners to create awareness and attract participants.
Utilize digital marketing channels, social media, and content marketing to reach the target audience.
Promote Institute Courses:
