Description:
Job Summary
The Senior People Officer is the experienced HR generalist within NagaEd, responsible for managing the applicant tracking system (ATS) pipeline, maintaining HR documentation and policies, administering compliance filings, and supporting the full employee lifecycle with growing independence. This role bridges the gap between administrative HR execution and strategic people operations handling complex HR processes that require judgement, accuracy, and a working knowledge of Indian employment practice. Reporting to the Operations Manager, the Senior People Officer takes ownership of HR processes rather than simply executing them. Where the People Officer handles coordination and data entry, this role manages the ATS pipeline end-to-end, drafts and maintains HR policy documents, prepares compliance filings, conducts initial screening of candidates, supports performance review administration, and serves as a knowledgeable resource on HR processes for the wider team. The Senior People Officer also provides task-level guidance to the People Officer and People Associate on shared workflows. Success in this role is measured by the quality and currency of HR documentation, the integrity of recruitment and employee data, the timeliness of compliance filings, and the ability to manage HR processes independently while knowing when to escalate.


Job Details
Department: Operations
Direct Reports: None (provides task-level guidance to People Officer / People Associate)
Manager: Operations Manager
Mentor/support: Operations Manager
Location: Kohima


Organisational Unit Function
ATS Pipeline Recruitment Management: Manage the applicant tracking system maintaining pipeline stages, updating candidate statuses, and ensuring data integrity throughout the recruitment cycle. Conduct initial CV screening and shortlisting against position description criteria, preparing shortlist recommendations for the hiring manager and Operations Manager. Coordinate and support interview processes scheduling panels, preparing assessment materials, collecting interviewer scorecards, and compiling evaluation summaries. Draft offer letters, employment contracts, and pre-employment correspondence for the Operations Manager s review and approval. Maintain recruitment analytics time-to-fill, pipeline conversion rates, and source effectiveness and surface insights to the Operations Manager. Ensure a professional, timely, and consistent candidate experience across all touchpoints.
HR Documentation Policy Administration: Maintain, update, and version-control NagaEd s HR policy documents, SOPs, the Employee Handbook, and associated templates. Draft new HR policies and SOP updates as directed by the Operations Manager researching best practice and ensuring alignment with Indian employment law requirements. Ensure all employees have signed and acknowledged current versions of key HR documents employment contracts, NDAs, handbook acknowledgements, and code-of-conduct agreements. Manage the HR documentation lifecycle drafting, review routing, approval tracking, distribution, and archiving maintaining a clear audit trail. Prepare HR correspondence confirmation letters, role change notifications, warning letters, and other employee communications for the Operations Manager s review.
Compliance Filing Statutory Administration: Prepare and coordinate statutory compliance filings POSH annual returns, Shops and Establishments Act returns, Professional Tax, and other applicable filings in coordination with the Operations Manager and external advisors. Maintain compliance calendars and trackers, ensuring all filing deadlines are surfaced to the Operations Manager at least two weeks in advance. Support POSH compliance administration maintaining the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) register, scheduling mandatory awareness training, and tracking completion. Coordinate with the Senior Finance Officer on employee-related statutory matters EPF, ESIC, and TDS records ensuring consistency between HR and finance records. Prepare documentation for labour inspections, audits, and regulatory queries as required.
Employee Lifecycle Records Management: Manage the HRIS (Zoho People or equivalent) employee master data, employment history, contract records, probation dates, and lifecycle milestones. Administer the probation review cycle tracking probation end dates, sending reminders to reviewing managers, compiling review documentation, and preparing confirmation or extension letters. Process employee changes promotions, transfers, reporting line updates, and salary revisions ensuring all changes are documented, filed, and reflected in HR systems. Maintain accurate and complete personnel files for all employees, ensuring audit readiness at all times. Administer the offboarding process exit checklists, knowledge transfer coordination, access revocation, final settlement documentation, and exit interview scheduling.
Performance Management Engagement Support: Support performance review cycles distributing review templates, tracking submission deadlines, compiling completed reviews, and maintaining performance records. Administer the goal-setting and OKR/KPI tracking process, ensuring all employees have current documented goals and that review cadences are maintained. Support the Operations Manager in running engagement initiatives pulse surveys, recognition programmes, team events, and feedback mechanisms. Compile and analyse HR data for engagement reporting participation rates, survey results, and trend tracking presenting summaries to the Operations Manager.
Leave, Attendance Payroll Coordination: Oversee leave and attendance management reviewing leave records for accuracy, resolving discrepancies, and maintaining up-to-date leave balances. Prepare monthly payroll inputs attendance summaries, leave adjustments, new joiner and leaver details, and variable components for handoff to the finance function. Respond to employee queries on leave policy, entitlements, and attendance with accuracy and in a timely manner.
Team Coordination Task Guidance: Provide day-to-day task-level guidance and quality checks to the People Officer and People Associate on recruitment coordination, data entry, filing, and onboarding logistics. Serve as the first escalation point for HR process queries from NagaEd staff before matters reach the Operations Manager. Ensure continuity of people operations during the Operations Manager s absence by maintaining standing HR processes and escalation protocols.


Reporting Relationships
This role reports directly to the Operations Manager. The Senior People Officer works with all NagaEd staff and managers on HR processes, coordinates with external advisors on compliance matters, and collaborates with the finance function on payroll and statutory employee contributions. The role does not hold formal line-management authority but provides task-level guidance to the People Officer and People Associate.


Selection Criteria
This role requires an experienced HR generalist who can manage multiple HR processes with accuracy and growing independence. The Senior People Officer must have a working knowledge of Indian employment practice, be comfortable drafting HR documents, and be able to exercise judgement on routine HR matters while knowing when to escalate.


Essential
Minimum 2 3 years of experience in HR generalist, HR administration, or people operations roles.
Working knowledge of Indian employment law fundamentals leave entitlements, POSH obligations, statutory filings, employment contract requirements.
Experience managing an ATS or structured recruitment pipeline.
Strong documentation and writing skills able to draft policies, SOPs, employment letters.

Strong knowledge of operating principles and practices.

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities.

Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Familiarity with safety procedures and protocols.

Ability to lift heavy objects and stand for long periods.

Trainee, Program Implementation
Location: Nagaland, Haryana
About Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical
Antarang Foundation runs 2 programs: 1) Career Aware with students of municipal schools and low-income private schools studying in 9th and 10th standard across Mumbai, Pune, Udaipur and Goa. 2) Career Ready with students of low-income private junior colleges studying in 11th and 12th standard across our five geographies. The role of Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical is to provide end to end support to the facilitators and partner schools/colleges to be able to deliver the program with the required quality. From orienting the schools/colleges at the start of the year, distributing the books/materials to them, allocation of facilitators, to ensure data comes back on a timely basis and gets scanned and uploaded on to our systems, we do it all.
Position Overview
If you have a knack for management, multi-tasking, problem solving coupled with the traits like consistency, spontaneity and dependability, this is the place you may want to be in.
This position is an opportunity for you to impact the career journeys of more than 60,000 young adults and you will need to do everything to make their experience with us, a smooth and memorable one. You will specifically have a very important role in working with our High-tech OMR scanner to ensure student information gets uploaded on our systems timely and accurately. This is a Full-time position and requires an dependable and committed candidate who has an eye for detail.
Responsibilities
Data Management and Upload (PRIMARY): Ensuring filled OMR sheets come back on a timely basis from facilitators
Checking if the sheets are filled as expected, else getting it rectified with facilitators
Scanning approx 2000 sheets per hour on our high tech scanner and and doing minor troubleshooting if required
Operations and Administration: Sorting and Packaging of student books and getting it couriered to schools
Operations and Administration: Managing the storage of books and scanned OMRs and optimum utilization of office space.
Operations and Administration: Packaging of gifts/momentos if required and couriering it to all the Headmasters
Operations and Administration: Maintaining the inventory of medium wise books and other program Related materials
Vendor Management: Coordinating with the vendors (Courier, Books printing and Scanner) to get the tasks done
Vendor Management: Maintaining the bills/invoices and submitting it to the Finance department
Communication: Coordinating with Headmasters to share the progress and solve for the issues Escalate it on a timely basis to ensure speedy resolution of the same
Communication: Keeping the internal teams looped in to seek their support and inputs
Communication: Writing emails to the stakeholders in reference to the task in hand
Student Support and Tracking: Making student support calls to collect information and tracking their journeys post of our programs
Student Support and Tracking: Maintaining, updating the database with the same and preparing reports
Student Support and Tracking: Interpreting data from dashboards and reporting trends to the team.
Profile Requisites
Minimum 1-year commitment required with 8.5 hrs per day
Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks
Clear verbal and written communication, knowledge of local language
Tech Savvy (comfortable using Microsoft Office; confident of learning to operate scanners, dashboards)
Ability to do a certain task multiple times with focus without getting bored
Readiness to give hand and feet support even at odd hours (if and when required).

Description:
Job Summary
The Employment Livelihood Supervisor will be responsible for supporting the implementation, supervision, and monitoring of employment, livelihood, skilling, entrepreneurship, and value-chain development initiatives across Nagaland.
The role will work closely with youth, entrepreneurs, producers, community groups, artisans, trainees, government departments, financial institutions, corporates, development partners, and other stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of programmes and achievement of project outcomes.
Responsibilities
Employment Livelihood Programme Implementation: Support the planning and implementation of Employment Livelihood programmes and projects.
Coordinate day-to-day field activities and ensure timely achievement of programme targets.
Supervise programme activities across assigned locations and ensure compliance with project plans and guidelines.
Identify implementation challenges and coordinate with the concerned team for timely resolution.
Livelihood Value-Chain Development: Support the implementation and strengthening of various livelihood value chains promotion.
Work with producers, entrepreneurs, community groups, and other stakeholders across different stages of the value chain, including production, processing, value addition, packaging, marketing, and market linkage.
Support initiatives related to Banana Fibre, Pineapple Fibre, and other livelihood enterprises.
Assist in identifying opportunities for improving productivity, product development, market access, and income generation.
Document challenges, learnings, innovations, and success stories from livelihood interventions.
Financial Institution-Supported Initiatives: Support the implementation and field-level coordination of programmes undertaken in collaboration with development and financial institutions.
Coordinate with beneficiaries, entrepreneurs, producer groups, community institutions, and project stakeholders.
Ensure that project activities and deliverables are implemented in accordance with approved plans and timelines.
Support beneficiary identification, mobilisation, training, enterprise development, monitoring, and reporting.
Maintain accurate project records and supporting documentation as required by partners and funding agencies.
Youth Mobilisation Employment Support: Mobilise youth for employment, skill development, entrepreneurship, and livelihood opportunities.
Conduct outreach activities in communities, educational institutions, training centres, and other relevant locations.
Support career guidance, job-readiness, and employment-related activities.
Facilitate linkages between youth and relevant employers, training institutions, and livelihood opportunities.
Track employment and livelihood outcomes of programme participants.
Enterprise Entrepreneur Support: Provide field-level support to aspiring and existing entrepreneurs.
Assist entrepreneurs in identifying opportunities, challenges, and potential market linkages.
Support enterprise development activities, including business planning, capacity building, product development, and market access.
Coordinate with relevant technical experts, financial institutions, and market partners where required.
Field Supervision Stakeholder Coordination: Conduct regular field visits to monitor programme activities and beneficiary progress.
Supervise field staff, mobilisers, trainers, and other project personnel, as assigned.
Build and maintain relationships with government departments, financial institutions, employers, educational institutions, community organisations, producer groups, and other stakeholders.
Represent in field-level meetings, workshops, consultations, exhibitions, and other programme events.
Monitoring, Documentation Reporting: Maintain accurate records of beneficiaries, enterprises, training activities, production, employment, placements, and livelihood outcomes.
Collect, verify, and maintain programme data and supporting documentation.
Prepare regular field visit reports, progress reports, case studies, success stories, and other project documentation.
Track project indicators, milestones, outputs, and outcomes against approved targets.
Support the preparation of reports and updates required by YouthNet s partners and funding agencies.
Market Linkages Promotion: Support market linkage initiatives for products developed through livelihood value chains.
Assist in identifying potential buyers, institutional markets, retailers, distributors, and other market opportunities.
Support exhibitions, fairs, product showcases, buyer-seller meets, and promotional activities.
Coordinate with relevant teams on branding, packaging, marketing, and product promotion.
Key Deliverables
Timely and effective implementation of assigned Employment Livelihood projects.
Achievement of beneficiary, training, employment, enterprise, and livelihood targets.
Effective field-level implementation of financial institution-supported initiatives.
Strengthened livelihood value chains.
Increased participation of youth and communities in sustainable livelihood and employment opportunities.
Improved market and institutional linkages for livelihood enterprises.
Accurate and timely programme data, documentation, and reporting.
Regular field monitoring and follow-up with beneficiaries and stakeholders.
Documentation of programme outcomes, success stories, and lessons learned.
Qualifications Requirements
Bachelor s degree in Development Studies, Social Work, Rural Development, Management, Economics, Sociology, Agriculture, Entrepreneurship, or a related field.
2-4 years of relevant experience in livelihood development, employment, entrepreneurship, skill development, value-chain development, community development, or programme implementation.
Experience working with development organisations, government programmes, financial institutions, NGOs, CSR programmes, or donor-funded projects will be an advantage.
Experience in livelihood value chains, enterprise development, market linkages, or community-based programmes will be preferred.
Familiarity with the socio-economic and livelihood context of Nagaland will be an advantage.
Key Skills Competencies
Employment and livelihood programme implementation
Value-chain and enterprise development
Field supervision and community mobilisation
Youth engagement and employment facilitation
Stakeholder and partner coordination
Market linkage and business development
Monitoring, data collection, and reporting
Team coordination and problem-solving
Strong written and verbal communication
MS Office/Google Workspace proficiency
Willingness to undertake frequent field travel across Nagaland
Personal Attributes
Strong ownership and accountability
Proactive and solution-oriented approach
Good interpersonal and community engagement skills
Ability to work with diverse stakeholders
Strong organisational and coordination skills
Adaptability to field-based working environments
Commitment to youth development, employment generation, and sustainable livelihoods
Employment type
Full Time
Notes
For Queries - Working Hours: Monday to Friday (10:00 am to 4:30 pm)
Or you can upload your resume via WhatsApp and one of our YouthNet Job Centre Representatives will call you back

Description:
Position: Regional Head Northeast: Manipur, Nagaland and Assam (Programmes, Partnerships & Business)

About Dharmalife
Dharmalife (www.dharmalife.in) is a social impact organization advancing inclusive progress across India through two core pillars — People and Planet. Working in over 40,000 villages across 15 states, it has built a rural network of 20,000+ women entrepreneurs, known as Dharmalife Entrepreneurs (DLEs), who drive sustainable community development.

The organization works alongside women by enhancing their economic power, agency, and leadership, while addressing key social and environmental challenges. Through this network of DLEs, Dharmalife promotes sustainable livelihoods, behaviour change, and solutions across key domains — Health, Well-being, Livelihood, Education, Care, Clean Energy, Sustainability, and Circular Economy.

By 2030, Dharmalife aims to advance 1 million rural women through sustainable livelihoods and care support. Its group entities — Dharmalife Foundation, Gajam India Pvt. Ltd., Dharmalife Labs, and Dharmalife Society — work together to create lasting systemic change at scale.

Position Summary
The Regional Head – Northeast-Manipur, Nagaland and Assam is the senior leadership position in the region responsible for driving Dharmalife’s growth, programme delivery, partnerships, and operational excellence across the region.

The role combines four critical dimensions:
Business and Sales Growth through the Dharmalife Entrepreneur (DLE) network
DLE Group Development and Entrepreneur Ecosystem Strengthening
High-Quality Execution of Donor and CSR-Funded Programmes
Strategic Government and Institutional Partnership Development

The Regional Head serves as the primary representative of Dharmalife within the Northeast region, along with central office functions, and is responsible for achieving commercial, social impact, operational, and stakeholder engagement objectives across all assigned districts

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Growth & Revenue Generation
Drive state-level sales and revenue targets across region, across Dharmalife products, services, and programme-linked business opportunities.
Strengthen entrepreneur productivity, customer outreach, and market penetration.
Develop district-wise growth plans and sales strategies.
Monitor sales conversion, order fulfilment, collections, inventory movement, and business performance.
Identify new business opportunities and market expansion areas.
Improve DLE earnings and income-generating opportunities.
Drive sustainable business growth through community-based distribution models.

2. DLE (Dharmalife Entrepreneur) Network Development & Community Engagement
Lead recruitment, onboarding, activation, and retention of DLEs and DLTs.
Build and strengthen village-level DLE groups and entrepreneur collectives.
Increase active participation and engagement of women entrepreneurs.
Develop leadership capabilities among high-potential DLEs.
Ensure regular field engagement, group meetings, and entrepreneur support.
Improve entrepreneur retention and productivity.

3. Programme & Project Execution
Lead implementation of donor-funded and CSR-supported programmes across the Northeast.
Ensure achievement of programme deliverables, timelines, budgets, and impact indicators.
Monitor beneficiary outreach, training completion, adoption metrics, and community engagement.
Ensure high-quality implementation across Health, Livelihood, Education, Care, Clean Energy, Sustainability, Circular Economy, and future programmes.
Maintain programme documentation, field evidence, case studies, and reporting standards.
Support surveys, assessments, research activities, audits, and donor visits.
Ensure safeguarding, compliance, and quality standards are maintained.

4. Government & Strategic Partnerships
Develop strategic relationships with: State Rural Livelihood Missions (SRLMs); Women & Child Development Department; Labour Department; Education Department; Tribal Development Department; Skill Development Missions; Renewable Energy Agencies; District Administration; and Panchayati Raj Institutions
Build partnerships with CSR foundations, corporate partners, financial institutions, NGOs, development organizations, Academic and research institutions
Identify opportunities for programme convergence, co-funding, and scale-up.
Represent Dharmalife at state-level/ region level forums, consultations, and stakeholder meetings.
Facilitate approvals, coordination, and institutional support for programme implementation.

5. Team Leadership, Governance & Operations
Lead and mentor Territory Channel Managers, Cluster Heads, Enterprise Leaders, and other teams.
Drive performance management, coaching, and capability development.
Conduct regular reviews and field visits.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies and operating procedures.
Monitor budgets, resource utilization, and operational efficiency.
Ensure data quality, reporting discipline, and governance standards.

Candidate Profile

Education
Graduate or Postgraduate in: Rural Management; Business Administration; Social Work; Development Studies and Related disciplines

Experience Required
8–12 years of relevant experience.
Experience in rural markets, social enterprises, development sector, livelihood promotion, microfinance, channel management, CSR, or large-scale field operations.
Proven experience managing multi-district or state-level teams across the region.
Demonstrated success in both programme delivery and business development.
Experience working with government stakeholders and donor-funded programmes will be preferred.

Competencies Required

Leadership Competencies: Strategic Thinking; Execution Excellence; Team Leadership; Ownership & Accountability

Functional Competencies: Rural Market Development; Programme Management; Sales & Business Development; Stakeholder Engagement; Partnership Development; Community Mobilisation; Data-Driven Decision Making;

Behavioural Competencies: Integrity; Collaboration; Resilience; Learning Agility; Entrepreneurial Mindset; Relationship Building

Travel Requirement
This position requires extensive travel across the Northeast, including regular visits to the Head office (Delhi), villages, DLE groups, programme sites, government offices, partner organizations, and district headquarters. Field immersion and direct stakeholder engagement are critical success factors for this role.

Why Join Dharmalife
This role is a chance to lead one of India's largest women-led rural entrepreneurship and impact ecosystems and to directly contribute to livelihoods, sustainability, community development, and social transformation at scale.
AboutCompany: Dharmalife is a grassroot level social impact organization committed to fostering inclusive progress for both people and the planet. Its initiatives are driven by women change agents, known as Dharmalife Entrepreneurs (DLEs), and are supported by data-driven insights, innovative approaches, and technology. Operating through a network of over 20,000 rural women entrepreneurs across 40,000 villages in 15 states, Dharmalife has positively impacted more than 17.5 million individuals, including 500,000 children. We aim to enhance womens economic autonomy and leadership while promoting sustainable practices, thereby contributing to the creation of resilient communities. By 2030, Dharmalife aims to empower 1 million rural women through sustainable employment, livelihood growth, and care support.

Description:
Join us and build your career in the Modular Kitchen & Home Interiors industry, with opportunities to learn, grow, and be rewarded for your performance.

Experience
Minimum 2 years of experience in Sales, preferably in Direct Sales, Field Sales, or B2C Sales.
Proven track record of achieving sales targets within the assigned/local market.

Key Skills
Strong communication, negotiation, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with a team.
Proficiency in English and Hindi, along with at least one regional language.
Strong customer-handling and relationship-management skills.

Preferred Experience
Experience in the Modular Kitchen, Home Interiors, Furniture, Building Materials, or related industries.
Experience in working with architects, interior designers, builders, or channel partners will be an advantage.
An existing network of architects, interior designers, builders, or relevant local customers will be an added advantage.

Additional Requirements
Own two-wheeler is mandatory for field sales activities.
Willingness to travel within the assigned local market for customer meetings and business development.

Roles & Responsibilities
Generate new business leads through cold calling, networking, referrals, and market visits.
Identify and develop potential customers within the assigned territory.
Conduct face-to-face meetings to understand customer requirements and present suitable solutions.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales cycle.
Understand customer needs and recommend appropriate products and solutions.
Develop and manage the sales pipeline, ensuring regular follow-ups and timely closures.
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, leads, opportunities, and follow-ups.
Negotiate with customers on pricing and commercial terms within approved guidelines.
Consistently work towards achieving monthly and annual sales targets.
Identify new business opportunities and contribute to the growth of the assigned market.

Why Join Us?
Opportunity to build a career in the growing Modular Kitchen & Home Interiors industry.
Performance-based incentives in addition to fixed compensation.
Opportunity to develop strong sales and customer-management skills.
Growth opportunities for high-performing individuals.

Interested?
If you are passionate about sales, customer relationships, and business growth, we would love to hear from you.

Share your updated CV at Recruitment@ultrafresh.in or contact us at +91 8655844179 to explore this opportunity.

Perform any other programmatic, M&E, or capacity-building responsibilities assigned by the Reporting Manager.

Proficiency in data collection, validation, analysis, and reporting.
Experience with SOCH Application
Good understanding of HIV/AIDS programs and National AIDS Control Programme (NACP).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and data management tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Experience in planning and delivering training and capacity-building programs.
Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

Willingness to travel extensively to project locations.

Description:
1. Background of The Hans Foundation
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust working towards creating an equitable society and enhancing the quality of life of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. THF works to improve the health and wellbeing of remote and underserved populations, with additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women, alongside education and livelihood development.
2. Project Overview: Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre project aims to strengthen access to essential healthcare for rural and hard-to-reach communities in Meghalaya. In its first phase, THF has committed to supporting 50 Sub-Centres through gap assessment, provision of equipment and facilities, deployment of skilled human resources, training, regular operations and monitoring. The project seeks to improve grassroots health services and contribute to better health outcomes, including maternal health.
3. General Information Position MIS Associate Project Hans Health & Wellness Centre (HWC), Meghalaya Location To be specified based on project requirement (e.g., assigned HSC / Project Office) No. of Positions 1 (or as per approved project requirement) Employment Type Contractual for one year; renewable based on performance and project requirements Reporting To Project Manager 4. Key Duties and Responsibilities A. Data Collection, Entry and Management
Collect, compile and enter data received from HSCs in approved registers, Excel sheets, MIS platforms and reporting formats.
Provide data-entry and documentation support to HSC staff, Project Manager and MEL Manager, as required.
Maintain an updated and organised database of HSC-wise service delivery, beneficiary and programme information, as applicable to approved project indicators.
Ensure that records are complete, legible, accurate and updated within prescribed timelines.
B. Data Quality and Verification
Review submitted data for completeness, consistency, duplication, missing entries and obvious errors; seek clarification or corrections from the concerned HSC staff.
Cross-check digital data with source registers and records wherever required.
Maintain proper documentation and an audit trail for corrections and updates; do not alter clinical records without authorisation.
Flag data gaps, discrepancies and delayed submissions to the Project Coordinator for timely resolution.
C. Reporting and MIS
Prepare and submit regular HSC-wise and consolidated project progress reports as per the reporting calendar and formats approved by THF.
Compile monthly and periodic data on service delivery and project indicators, as applicable and approved by the project team.
Support preparation of summary tables, charts, dashboards and presentations for internal reviews and management meetings.
Share verified data with the Project Coordinator and authorised stakeholders within stipulated timelines.
D. Record and Document Management
Maintain and organise registers, reporting files, attendance records and other programme documentation assigned to the role.
Ensure systematic filing, version control, safe storage and timely retrieval of records, in both digital and physical formats.
Support documentation of data-related observations, follow-up actions and reporting submissions.
E. Coordination and Field Support
Coordinate with MLHPs, GNM/ANMs and other HSC personnel to obtain timely and accurate data and clarify reporting requirements.
Follow up on pending reports and support staff in understanding prescribed data formats and reporting timelines.
Participate in project review meetings, trainings and data-verification visits as assigned.
Undertake other MIS, data management and administrative responsibilities relevant to the HWC project, as assigned by the reporting officer.
F. Confidentiality and Compliance
Maintain confidentiality and protect personal and health-related information of beneficiaries in accordance with THF policies and applicable requirements.
Share data only with authorised personnel and use approved systems and formats for storage and transmission.
Adhere to THF policies, professional conduct standards and instructions issued by the project management team.
5. Educational Qualifications
Graduate in any discipline from a recognised institution.
Diploma or certificate in Computer Applications / IT is preferred.
6. Experience and Technical Skills
Preferably 2-3 years of experience in MIS, data entry, reporting, programme support or a related role. Fresh graduates with strong computer skills may also be considered.
Working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, email and data-entry systems; ability to maintain structured spreadsheets and prepare basic summaries is essential.
Experience in health programmes, public health reporting or work with healthcare facilities would be an advantage.
Ability to check data for accuracy, maintain organised records and meet recurring reporting deadlines.
7. Behavioural and Other Requirements
Good communication, coordination and follow-up skills.
Attention to detail, integrity, reliability and respect for confidentiality.
Ability to work with frontline health staff and manage multiple reporting tasks within deadlines.
Proficiency in English and Hindi; knowledge of the local language/dialect is desirable.
Willingness to travel to assigned HSCs or project locations, as required.
8. Equal Opportunity Statement
The Hans Foundation is an equal opportunity employer and encourages women, persons with disabilities and individuals from economically and socially excluded communities who meet the requisite skills and qualifications to apply. Description:

Type of Employment: Contractual for 1 year, renewable basis performance
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Manager

JOB PURPOSE
The Project Coordinator will be responsible for successful implementation of field level activities and will report to Project Manager.

1. Duties and Responsibilities:
The key responsibilities of this position are as given below:

Responsible for implementation of the project activities at the field level and coordination with other external stakeholders at the project area level.
Support the MMU team in mobilizing the community for taking up the MMU services.
Facilitate in compliance with government norms with respect to MMU operations.
Coordinate baseline survey and project monitoring.
Identify Health workers from the community and support their recruitment
process
Support Senior Project Coordinator /Project Manager in preparing MMU movement schedule and ensure effective implementation of all the project activities.
Responsible for tracking of MMUs through GPS tracking and other mechanism.
Prepare all reports and documentation related to the project, such as MIS reports, financial reports, narrative reports, field observation and visit reports, collection and compilation of case studies and photographs.
Coordinate with various departments/institutions like Health Sub Centres (HSCs), Primary Health Centres (PHCs), Community Health Centres (CHCs), PRI members, Women Self Help Groups, Village Health Sanitation and Nutrition Committees etc.
Liaison with Health and other line departments in district and blocks, ensuring their support and involvement in the project activities.
Conduct regular field visits to monitor and the project progress and provide supportive supervision to the teams and village health workers as and when required.
Other tasks which may be assigned by the Project Manager from time to time.

2. Other Indicative Requirements

Educational Qualifications
Graduation in Social Sciences/ any relevant field, preferable to have a diploma or certificate in computer application

Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experiences of more than 3 years, ideally with a public health program or non-profit or organization
Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with strong project management skills.
Demonstrated passion for social impact and development sector.
Good communication and documentation skills in English and Hindi.
Data analysis, reporting and presentation skills.
Leadership and team management skills.
Willingness to travel extensively in remote areas.

Job Summary
ITC Labs is looking for an experienced and skilled Microbiologist to manage microbiological testing, quality control, and laboratory operations at its Meghalaya location. The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise in microbiological analysis, laboratory quality systems, testing procedures, and compliance with applicable standards.


Key Responsibilities
Conduct microbiological testing of food, water, raw materials, finished products, and other relevant samples as per laboratory requirements.
Perform microbial enumeration, pathogen detection, and sterility testing wherever applicable.
Handle microbiological techniques such as media preparation, microbial culturing, incubation, colony counting, and identification.
Ensure compliance with applicable testing standards, SOPs, GLP, GMP, and laboratory quality management systems.
Operate, maintain, and calibrate microbiology laboratory equipment.
Maintain accurate testing records, worksheets, and laboratory documentation.
Investigate out-of-specification (OOS) results, deviations, and non-conformities, and support root cause analysis and corrective actions.
Ensure proper handling, storage, and disposal of microbiological samples and biohazardous waste.
Maintain laboratory hygiene, biosafety, and contamination-control practices.
Support internal and external audits, method validation, proficiency testing, and accreditation requirements, wherever applicable.
Guide junior team members and ensure timely completion of testing activities.


Required Skills
Strong knowledge of microbiological testing and analytical techniques.
Hands-on experience in food, water, pharmaceutical, or other relevant testing laboratories.
Knowledge of relevant BIS, FSSAI, ISO, or other applicable testing standards.
Familiarity with laboratory documentation, SOPs, quality control, and audit procedures.
Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and manage laboratory testing schedules.


Eligibility Criteria
Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in microbiology.
Sc. in Microbiology, Biotechnology, or a relevant scientific discipline.
Prior experience in a commercial testing laboratory or NABL-accredited laboratory will be preferred.
Experience in food and water microbiology will be an added advantage.
Company-provided accommodation in Meghalaya.
Competitive compensation based on experience and skills.

Review the existing process of reporting of key commercial parameters of the Distribution utility.

Engage with all the Stakeholders and get the feedback from them on the proposed SOP including middle and lower management.
Assist in the implementation of the Standard Operating Procedure within timeframes as approved by the Management.
Provide on recommendations on digital interventions along with the probable solutions along with the cost benefit analysis.
Formulate standardized daily, weekly and monthly reporting formats on key parameters with diagnostic analysis along with probable interventions to capture adverse deviations.

Billing and Collection
Monitoring the effective of billing and facilitating in ensuring 100 % billing.
Formulating Process of Billing Quality check. like- Under billed consumers, Overbilled, never billed.
Preparing of Billing, Collection & customer data Management Information reports from the billing Master data.
Billing & Collection Analysis of consumers of various categories.
Suggesting Changes & improvement of Billing system to minimize errors and system gaps.
Work in close coordination with the Unified Billing System provider.
Analyze the data of Smart Metered Consumers in terms of key parameters and prepare a report on the deviations along with the corrective actions. The report is to be circulated to all lower, middle and top management and vigilance team for corrective actions.
Suggesting the utilities on best practices in the industry for billing and collection checks.
Coordinate with Distribution Franchisee operator for submission of monthly MIS as per the contract document.

Management Review
Prepare presentation at sub-division level for the review meeting by management highlighting the key parameters along with the diagnostic analysis and suggestions for improvement.
Coordinate with the sub-divisions level officers for the Action Taken Report after each review meeting.

C. Required skill set:
Strong technical and commercial knowledge about the power distribution business.
Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
Experience in handling smart meter data
Working knowledge of key regulatory interventions effecting the commercial parameters of DISCOM.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
BE/ B. Tech/ MBA/ M. Tech (Candidates with B. Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
Knowledge of advanced MS Excel and Microsoft Power point is highly preferred.
Atleast 5 Years experience in Commercial Matters of DISCOM or consultancy company.

Shillong, Meghalaya.

Description:
Quality Assurance Specialist (Food)
Meghalaya MSc./B.Tech/B.Sc. 7+ years
Location: Meghalaya
Employment Type: Fixed
Experience: 7+ years
Joining: Immediate joiner preferred


Role Summary
We are looking for an experienced Quality Assurance Specialist with strong food testing and regulatory expertise to lead quality assurance activities at our Meghalaya facility. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in an NABL-accredited food testing laboratory and in-depth knowledge of FSSAI regulations, and can ensure analytical accuracy, compliance and audit readiness.


Key Responsibilities
Implement, maintain and continually improve the Quality Management System (QMS) in line with ISO/IEC 17025 and NABL requirements.
Ensure compliance with FSSAI Act, Rules and Regulations, including food safety standards, labelling, contaminants and residue limits.
Prepare, review and control SOPs, quality manuals, work instructions, formats and records.
Plan and conduct internal audits, and coordinate NABL, FSSAI and customer audits, including closure of non-conformances (NCs) with CAPA.
Oversee method validation and verification, measurement uncertainty, and equipment calibration and maintenance schedules.
Manage proficiency testing (PT) and inter-laboratory comparison (ILC) programs and evaluate results.
Monitor internal quality control (IQC) activities and review test data, reports and certificates of analysis for accuracy and compliance.
Handle customer complaints, deviations, out-of-specification (OOS) and out-of-trend (OOT) investigations.
Maintain document control, traceability of reference standards and records, and data integrity.
Conduct training for technical and quality staff on QMS, food safety and regulatory updates.
Support management reviews and prepare MIS and quality performance reports.
Track regulatory updates from FSSAI and other authorities and implement changes in a timely manner.


Qualifications
M.Sc. in Food Technology, Food Science, Chemistry, Microbiology or a related discipline (B.Tech/B.Sc. in Food Technology with relevant experience may be considered).
Minimum 7 years of experience in quality assurance in the food industry or an NABL-accredited food testing laboratory.


Technical Skills
Strong working knowledge of ISO/IEC 17025:2017 and NABL guidelines.
Thorough understanding of FSSAI regulations, standards and licensing/notification requirements.
Familiarity with HACCP, GMP, GHP and food safety management systems (FSSC 22000 / ISO 22000 is an advantage).
Experience with food testing parameters (chemical, microbiological, residue and contaminant analysis).
Knowledge of statistical tools, uncertainty estimation and method validation.
Good command of MS Office and report writing.


Desired Attributes
Lead assessor or internal auditor certification (ISO/IEC 17025, ISO 22000) preferred.
Strong documentation, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and leadership abilities.
Willingness to work and stay in Meghalaya for the contract duration.
Ability to join immediately.


What We Offer
Opportunity to lead quality systems in a regulated food testing environment.
Company-provided accommodation in Meghalaya.
Competitive compensation based on experience and skills.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on procurement and tendering functions. Key responsibilities include:

Procurement & Tendering Support
• Provide day-to-day support to MeECL and its subsidiaries on procurement and tendering activities.
• Review the existing Operating Procedure of MeECL for bidding of services and goods.
• Prepare Request for Proposals (RFPs) for procurement of materials and services as per client requirements and in line with the State and Central Procurement Guidelines.
• Coordinate with the State E Procurement management team.
• Advise the client from time to time on updation of the procurement process and digital intervention in the procurement.

Vendor Identification & Bid Management
• Identify and facilitate the selection of suitable vendors in line with MeECL procurement processes.
• Support release of RFPs and tender documents.
• Coordinate pre-bid meetings and manage clarifications with prospective bidders.
• Facilitate all procurement activities through to contract award.

Bid Evaluation
• Review all the technical and commercial bids.
• Find out the deviations in the submitted bids from the conditions in the RfP.
• Prepare comparative statements, bid evaluation reports, and recommendations for tender finalization.
• Support evaluation committees during the bid assessment process.

MIS & Reporting
• Prepare, review, and validate MIS reports, dashboards, progress reports, and periodic submissions.
• Prepare a database for the bids with details of technical requirement, deviations allowed, revisions in the tenders done if any etc.
• Maintain procurement documentation and ensure timely reporting to the Client.
• Ensure quality and accuracy of reports, presentations, and Minutes of Meetings (MoMs).

Stakeholder Coordination
• Coordinate with officials MeECL, contractors, vendors, and internal consulting teams.
• Monitor procurement milestones and facilitate timely resolution of issues.

Additional Responsibilities
• Prepare a Standard Operating Procedures with timelines for each type of procurement and ensure compliance of the approved procedure.
• Support any other procurement and tendering activities assigned by the Client.
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives and procurement best practices within the project.

C. Required skill set:
• Strong understanding of procurement and tendering processes in the Power Sector including, distribution, generation and transmission.
• Experience in preparation of RFPs, bid evaluation, vendor selection, and contract award processes.
• Knowledge of public procurement procedures and utility procurement practices.
• Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
• Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
• Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
• BE/ B. Tech or MBA (Candidates with B.Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
• Atleast 5 Years experience in Procurement, Tendering & Contracts Management in a Power Utility / Discom company or Power utility consultancy company.

E. Location:
• Shillong, Meghalaya.
• The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

• We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.

Description:
1. Shift In-Charge CPP Operations :
Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in DCS-operated Captive Power Plant operations
Key Responsibilities:
Manage and monitor day-to-day CPP operations through DCS, ensuring safe, reliable and efficient plant performance.
Lead shift operations, coordinate with Boiler, Turbine and E&I teams, and ensure smooth power generation.
Monitor plant parameters, troubleshoot operational issues and ensure compliance with safety and operational standards.

2. Engineer Boiler :
Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in Boiler Operations
Preferred: BOE Certificate
Key Responsibilities:
Monitor and operate boiler systems to ensure safe, stable and efficient steam generation.
Coordinate with shift teams for boiler start-up, shutdown, load management and troubleshooting.
Monitor key boiler parameters and ensure adherence to operational, safety and maintenance standards.
3. Engineer Turbine :
Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in Turbine Operations
Key Responsibilities:
Operate and monitor turbine systems to ensure reliable and efficient power generation.
Handle turbine start-up, shutdown, load changes and operational troubleshooting as per SOPs.
Monitor turbine parameters and coordinate with Boiler and E&I teams for smooth plant operations.

4. Engineer Turbine Field Operator :
Qualification: ITI/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in Turbine Operations
Key Responsibilities:
Conduct field monitoring and operation of turbine equipment and associated systems.
Perform routine equipment inspections, identify abnormalities and support troubleshooting activities.
Coordinate with the control room team during start-up, shutdown and load variation activities while maintaining safety standards.

5. Shift In-Charge E&I, CPP :
Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in E&I operations within a Captive Power Plant
Key Responsibilities:
Lead shift-wise Electrical & Instrumentation operations and ensure reliable functioning of CPP systems.
Monitor electrical and instrumentation equipment, identify faults and coordinate troubleshooting with maintenance teams.
Ensure proper preventive maintenance, safety compliance and availability of critical E&I systems.

6. Engineer Instrumentation :
Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering
Experience: 57 years in Instrumentation, preferably in a Captive Power Plant
Key Responsibilities:
Monitor and maintain instrumentation systems, control loops, sensors and field instruments across the CPP.
Troubleshoot instrumentation and control system issues to minimize downtime and ensure plant reliability.
Support calibration, preventive maintenance and smooth functioning of DCS/PLC and associated instrumentation systems.

Common Preference & Application :
Industry Preference: Candidates from Cement / Steel / Heavy Manufacturing industries will be preferred.

Location: Khliehriat, Meghalaya
Share CV: career@talentcraft.co.in

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Job Purpose
To lead and manage all store operations within the cement plant, ensuring efficient receipt, storage, preservation, inventory control, and issuance of materials, spare parts, consumables, and capital items. The role is responsible for maintaining inventory accuracy, optimizing stock levels, supporting uninterrupted plant operations, and ensuring compliance with company policies, safety standards, and audit requirements.
Key Responsibilities
1. Store Operations Management
Oversee day-to-day store activities including receipt, inspection, storage, preservation, and issue of materials.
Ensure systematic storage and identification of all inventory items.
Implement best practices in warehouse and store management.
Maintain proper housekeeping and safety standards within store premises.
2. Inventory Management
Monitor inventory levels and ensure availability of critical spares and consumables.
Optimize stock holdings to balance operational requirements and inventory carrying costs.
Conduct regular stock verification, cycle counting, and annual physical inventory.
Analyze slow-moving, non-moving, obsolete, and surplus inventory and recommend corrective actions.
3. Material Receipt & Dispatch
Ensure timely receipt and documentation of incoming materials.
Coordinate with procurement, quality, and user departments for material inspection and acceptance.
Manage material issuance as per approved procedures and authorization matrix.
Monitor transportation and dispatch activities where applicable.
4. ERP & Documentation Control
Ensure accurate and timely transactions in ERP systems (SAP/Oracle/other ERP platforms).
Maintain inventory records, stock registers, material movement records, and statutory documents.
Generate periodic MIS reports related to inventory, stock valuation, consumption trends, and KPI performance.
5. Coordination & Stakeholder Management
Liaise with procurement, maintenance, production, finance, and project teams for material planning and availability.
Support plant shutdowns, overhauls, and project activities through effective material management.
Coordinate with vendors and logistics partners regarding deliveries and material discrepancies.
6. Compliance, Audit & Governance
Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, and statutory requirements.
Facilitate internal, external, and statutory audits.
Implement inventory control procedures to prevent losses, pilferage, and material deterioration.
Ensure adherence to ISO, safety, environmental, and quality management systems.
7. Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop store personnel.
Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational excellence within the stores function.

Sustainability initiatives form a major part of our corporate social responsibility policy and strive to improve living conditions in surrounding areas.

Description:
ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.

Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills

Minimum 2 years of experience as an electrician, preferably in a steel plant setting.

Strong knowledge of electrical systems, including wiring, circuits, and testing.

Ability to read and interpret electrical diagrams and schematics.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Good communication and teamwork skills.

Familiarity with safety protocols and regulations related to electrical work.

Description:
About Virohan

Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal , Virohan is an education-to-industry partner building the workforce powering India s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry-aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real-world employability.

At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms. Our model combines academic learning with hands-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles. Today, Virohan has trained 13,000+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.
Backed by global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan) , we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare - two of India s fastest-growing sectors.

At our core, we are guided by a strong set of values that define how we work, build, and grow together - from ownership and bias for action to empathy, continuous learning, and raising the bar. If you re excited about building something meaningful at scale and solving real-world problems, you ll find yourself at home at Virohan.

Role Overview

The City Admission Manager will own Virohan s end-to-end performance in the assigned city-driving admissions, centre operations, team productivity, student experience, partner coordination, and local brand growth. This person will act as the single accountable business owner for the city, ensuring that all city-level teams deliver against growth, quality, and profitability goals.

What you ll be responsible for

Conduct market surveys alongside competitors.
Identify additional offerings for students.
Establish connections with educational institutions (schools, junior colleges, coaching classes).
Initiate discussions with HODs for seminar opportunities and other BTL activities.
Identify, onboard, and manage channel partners to expand offline sales reach and drive business growth.
Engage students, highlighting Virohans advantages.
Connect with parents during house visits.
Collect data from 12th board exam centers for attracting fresh students.
Plan canopy activities strategically for better outreach.
Plan and execute marketing activities, generating sales leads.
Manage local BTL activities effectively.
Reach monthly sales targets by nurturing agent relationships and networks.

An ideal candidate should have:

Comfortable with field sales; committed to daily market presence.
Proficient in consultative sale, adept at building trust without being forceful.
Capable of handling sales pressures.
Strong communication skills, particularly in regional languages.
Receptive to feedback, embracing learning from mistakes and setbacks.
Presentable appearance and previous fieldwork experience, preferably in education.
Strong presentation skills with the ability to effectively represent the company to diverse audiences.
Holds 2 to 5 years of marketing experience.

Required Skills
Counselling channel sales B2B partnership Telecalling Channel partnering

Role & responsibilities

Customer focus: Driving NPS and lower Detractor %
Greeting customers when they enter the store and coaching the team to do the same Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To carry out chemical analysis and quality control activities for raw materials, intermediate products, clinker and cement to ensure compliance with defined quality standards and specifications. The role will be responsible for XRF analysis, laboratory testing, monitoring chemical parameters and supporting consistent product quality throughout the manufacturing process.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Chemical Analysis & Quality Control
Conduct chemical analysis of limestone, additives, raw mix, kiln feed, clinker, gypsum, fly ash, slag and cement.
Perform routine and non-routine chemical testing as per established laboratory procedures.
Monitor key chemical parameters such as:
CaO, SiO, AlO and FeO
MgO, SO, KO, NaO and other relevant parameters
LOI and other quality indicators
Ensure test results are accurate, reliable and recorded properly.
B. XRF Operations
Operate and perform routine analysis using X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) equipment.
Prepare samples and pellets/beads as required for XRF analysis.
Perform calibration, standardization and routine checks of the XRF equipment.
Monitor instrument performance and identify abnormal readings or deviations.
Maintain XRF-related records, standards and calibration data.
Coordinate with the concerned team for troubleshooting and maintenance of XRF equipment.
C. Cement & Clinker Quality Monitoring
Monitor the chemical quality of clinker and cement at different stages of production.
Analyze and report quality deviations promptly to the concerned departments.
Support production teams in maintaining required chemical parameters.
Ensure final cement quality meets applicable BIS/IS specifications and internal quality standards.
Assist in maintaining consistency in cement quality.
D. Raw Material & Process Control
Analyze incoming raw materials and monitor their chemical characteristics.
Monitor raw mix and kiln feed quality.
Evaluate chemical variations and communicate deviations to the concerned team.
Support optimization of raw mix and process parameters based on laboratory results.
E. Laboratory Management
Ensure proper functioning, cleanliness and housekeeping of the chemical laboratory.
Maintain laboratory equipment, instruments, chemicals, reagents and standards.
Maintain proper records of test results, calibration, analysis and equipment maintenance.
Ensure safe handling, storage and disposal of laboratory chemicals.
Follow laboratory safety procedures and applicable environmental and safety requirements.
F. Documentation & Reporting
Maintain daily laboratory test reports and quality records.
Prepare and communicate test results to the concerned HOD/Manager.
Ensure timely reporting of critical quality deviations.
Maintain documentation as per departmental SOPs and quality systems.
Participate in internal/external quality audits whenever required.
3. Required Skills & Competencies
Hands-on experience in XRF analysis in a cement manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of cement chemistry and quality control.
Good understanding of raw mix, clinker and cement chemical parameters.
Knowledge of laboratory testing procedures and quality standards.
Ability to interpret XRF results and identify quality deviations.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to coordinate effectively with Production, Process, Mines and Quality teams.
Good documentation and reporting skills.
Strong attention to accuracy and detail.
Knowledge of laboratory safety and chemical handling procedures.
4. Preferred Experience
Candidates should preferably have:
4+ years of relevant experience in a cement manufacturing plant.
Strong hands-on exposure to XRF operation and analysis.
Experience in cement/clinker/raw material chemical analysis.
Experience working in a Quality Control / Quality Assurance laboratory of a cement plant.
Exposure to BIS/IS standards and cement quality specifications.
Experience with laboratory instruments and calibration/standardization activities.
5. Key Performance Areas (KPIs)
Accuracy and reliability of laboratory/XRF test results.
Timely completion and reporting of chemical analysis.
Compliance with cement quality specifications.
XRF equipment uptime and proper maintenance.
Reduction of testing errors and quality deviations.
Proper maintenance of laboratory records and documentation.
Compliance with laboratory safety procedures.
Effective coordination with Production and Process departments.
Candidate Profile
Minimum Experience: 4+ Years
Mandatory Industry: Cement Manufacturing
Mandatory Technical Skill: XRF Analysis
Qualification: B.Sc./M.Sc. Chemistry or equivalent
Department: Quality Control
Ideal Candidate: A technically sound Chemistry professional with 4+ years of hands-on experience in a cement plant, particularly in XRF operation, clinker/cement chemical analysis, raw material testing and quality control, with the ability to independently handle routine laboratory operations and support process-quality improvement.

About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Role & responsibilities

1. *Accounting Operations*

* Ensure accurate and timely recording of all financial transactions.

* Monitor vendor and customer accounts.
* Track outstanding payments and receivables and ensure timely follow-up.

8. *Expense & Payment Management*

* Verify expense claims and supporting documents.
* Process payments in accordance with company policies and approvals.

9. *Accuracy & Internal Controls*

* Maintain high standards of accuracy in accounting and reporting.
* Ensure compliance with established financial procedures and internal controls.

10. *Process Improvement*

* Identify gaps in existing accounting processes.
* Recommend practical improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and reporting.

Pathologist-Full Time
Raipur
Lab Operations
Role summary
Managerial Responsibilities:
Overall Management of the laboratory
Consumption management
Quality management

Technical Responsibilities:
Up gradation of advanced technologies Quality of the results.
What the role entails - Key accountabilities/ responsibilities
1. Provide advice to those requesting information about the choice of tests, the use of the laboratory service and the interpretation of laboratory data.
2. Serve as an active member of the medical staff in main lab, collection center,
3. Relate and function effectively with NABL other accrediting agencies, Appropriate administrative officials, healthcare community, the patient / clients.
4. Define, implement, and monitor standards of performance and quality improvement of the medical laboratory service orservices.
5. Monitor all processes in the laboratory to determine that reliable data is being generated.
6. Ensure availability of sufficiently qualified personnel with adequate training and experience to meet the needs of the laboratory.
7. Plan, set goals, develop, and allocate resources appropriate to the medical environment.
8. Provide effective and efficient administration of the medical laboratory service, including budget planning and control with responsible financial management, in accordance with institutional assignment of such responsibilities.
9. Provide educational programs for the medical and laboratory staff and participate in educational programs of the institution.
10. Implement a safe laboratory environment in compliance with good practice and applicable regulations.
11. Address any complaint, request, or suggestion from users of laboratory services. Ensure good staff morale.
12. Report authorization of Hematology, Biochemistry, Immunoassay, Clinical Pathology, and serology
13. Routine review of QC for all departments with review of reports including CBC, MP, PS, Reticulocyte count, Fluid routine, ICT/DCT, Blood group before approving
14. Formulate review and recheck policies for all tests and ensure compliance with the help of Lab supervisor and technicians.
15. Verification of critical, unusual, and abnormal test results before release
16. Interpret, Correlate, and generate medically significant laboratory data.
17. Attending all sorts of client queries related to test enquiries and interpretation of test results.
18. Approval of SOPs for use and ensure compliance with respect to accreditation requirements.
19. Ensure review of monthly MIS
20. Ensure results are reported within turnaround time with the help of section head.
21. Review and improvement of reports formats.
22. To identify new equipment, tests, technology, products and standardization of assays.
23. Identify needs for resources (human / equipment / infrastructure) and submit to senior management for approval.
24. Attending conferences/workshops to ensure updated knowledge about recent trends.
25. To spend time reviewing daily pendency status on reports not released as well as sample received cases to avoid patient dissatisfaction.
26. To keep a watchful eye on instrument maintenance and hygiene of lab and practice 0 tolerance in this area. Any instrument failure due to user s should be avoided totally as it affects our patient and business.
27. To ensure sample processing is not stopped due to KIT non availability.
28. To ensure that every PR is approved on time and any gaps are highlighted.
29. COL/ Lab Head should work with BU Heads in forecasting CAMP s and other seasonal activities and order KITs sufficiently.
30. To keep a close watch on technical complaints. Ensure analytical complaints get logged, DE flagging is minimized. For recorded complaints and initiate proper CAPA and must also discuss in weekly calls with the team on learning and preventive actionsand timely escalation of analytical complaints/ Legal threats
31. To spend quality time on understanding patient and customer VOC especially on cases we are not resolving on time. COL/Lab Head should guide the team to resolve issues on time andsupport them wherever technical input is required.
32. To participate in weekly meetings along with BU/SBU Heads to resolve issues as well as seek support wherever needs from nontechnical team.
33. To take responsibility to train the non-technical team for better business and customer engagement.
34. COL/Lab Head must contribute at least 8 hours in a month in training and sharing knowledge to the team through a formal mechanism.
35. To promote MHL test to larger communities of clinician through KOL Connects. They must use our report as a tool to promote test by recommending new test based on diagnosis in the report.
36. To make time at least once a month to meet B2B clients, collection centers, customers to understand the pulse of the market.
37. To follow guidelines objectively as per MHL Policy and ensure a culture of data-based decision making and discussions; hence every month compliance is very important. It is at most importance for to have self-Compliance from every lab and noncompliance is given utmost importance for closure.
38. To give sufficient time to check and review the Lab managers /Technical team on quality, material consumption and technical performance.
39. Ensure that processes needed for the quality management system are established, implemented, and maintained.
40. Reporting to laboratory management, at the level at which decisions are made on laboratory policy, objectives, and resources, on the performance of the quality management system and any need for improvement.
41. Ensuring the promotion of awareness of users needs and requirements throughout the laboratory organization.
What we are looking for in you
Excellent communication and analytical skill.
Working With
Lab Operations Team
Role demands (Travel)
Yes
Stakeholder interfaces
Yes
What we promise to you
A strong growth prospective.
