POSITION SUMMARY
The Associate Professor in the Department of Ophthalmology will serve as a senior academic and clinical faculty leader at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim. The incumbent will be responsible for delivering advanced undergraduate and postgraduate medical education in ophthalmology, providing specialist eye care across OPD, IPD, emergency, and Operation Theatre settings, and contributing meaningfully to research and publication activities. This role demands an accomplished ophthalmologist with strong academic credentials, surgical expertise, and a demonstrable commitment to shaping the next generation of eye care specialists in a NABH-accredited, NMC-compliant teaching hospital environment.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures, tutorials, and clinical classes in Ophthalmology as per university curriculum requirements.
Conduct postgraduate (MS/DNB) classes, bedside clinics, case presentations, seminars, and journal clubs for PG students and interns.
Participate in ward rounds with PG trainees and interns to develop clinical reasoning and examination skills.
Mentor postgraduate residents in thesis formulation, surgical skills, and research methodology.
Participate in curriculum development, examination setting, and academic assessment processes.
Cover duties of other Associate Professors when required to ensure academic continuity.

B. Clinical & Surgical Responsibilities
Attend and manage Outpatient Department (OPD) patients during assigned slots providing specialist ophthalmology consultation, diagnosis, and management.
Manage inpatients admitted under the unit and attend to inpatient referrals from other departments requiring ophthalmic consultation.
Attend to emergency ophthalmic patients during assigned on-call duties including ocular trauma, acute angle-closure glaucoma, and other ophthalmic emergencies.
Attend scheduled Operation Theatre sessions perform ophthalmic surgical procedures independently and supervise and train postgraduate students in surgical techniques.
Provide specialist ophthalmology services across the full spectrum of OPD, IPD, and emergency ophthalmic care.
Participate in ward rounds and case discussions with junior faculty, residents, and students.
Ensure accurate clinical documentation, NABH protocol compliance, and high standards of patient safety.

C. Research & Publications
Publish a minimum of two research papers in indexed national or international journals as per NMC requirements, with the candidate among the first three authors.
Submit articles and medical commentary to professional media and publications on a regular basis.
Lead or participate in departmental research projects in clinical ophthalmology, surgical outcomes, and ophthalmic sciences.
Guide postgraduate thesis work and support research training of PG residents.

D. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Assist the Head of Department in departmental administration, academic planning, and resource management.
Participate in NABH accreditation activities, hospital quality improvement committees, and patient safety initiatives.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME), national ophthalmology conferences, and professional development activities.
Undertake any additional duties assigned by the Head of Department or institutional management.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MS / DNB / MD in Ophthalmology from a recognized institution, as per NMC regulations.

Teaching Experience (as per NMC Regulations)

Candidates must meet one of the following experience criteria:
(a)(i) Minimum 4 years as Assistant Professor in Ophthalmology at a recognized medical institution; OR minimum 5 years for those directly appointed as Assistant Professor in a Government medical institution; OR
(a)(ii) Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces with at least 5 years post-PG clinical experience in Ophthalmology, of which at least 3 years as Assistant Professor in an Armed Forces teaching hospital; OR
(b) Non-teaching Consultant / Specialist / Medical Officer with a PG medical degree and at least 10 years of experience in a Government hospital of at least 220 beds (must complete Basic Course in Medical Education and Basic Course in Biomedical Research within 2 years of appointment).
Note (Aviation / Marine Medicine): Up to 4 years of experience in Flying Squadrons or Diving/Escape Training Schools counts as equivalent to 2 years of teaching experience for Associate Professor eligibility.

Research & Compliance Requirements
Minimum 2 research publications in indexed journals after becoming Assistant Professor (first three authors).
Completed Basic Course in Biomedical Research from an NMC-designated institution.
Must have undergone (or be willing to undergo) the Basic Course in Medical Education, as Ophthalmology is covered under undergraduate training.
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

Clinical & Surgical Expertise
Cataract surgery (phacoemulsification)
Glaucoma diagnosis & management
Retinal disease management
Ophthalmic emergency care
Slit-lamp & fundus examination
Surgical training & OT supervision
Academic & Research
• UG & PG medical teaching
Bedside clinical teaching
NMC regulatory compliance
Indexed journal publication
PG thesis guidance & mentoring
Curriculum development
Interpersonal & Soft Skills
• Excellent interpersonal skills
Strong verbal & written communication
Team leadership & collaboration
Organised & detail-oriented
Patient-centric approach
Adaptability in teaching hospital

Location: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Gandhinagar
Employment Type: Full-Time
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days Preferred
About the Role
Capgemini is seeking highly skilled SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultants to join our growing SAP Finance Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Central Finance, SAP S/4HANA Finance, financial process transformation, data migration, and system integration. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-wide Central Finance solutions for global clients.
Key Responsibilities
SAP Central Finance Implementation & Solution Design
Lead and participate in end-to-end SAP Central Finance (CFIN) implementation projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP Central Finance solutions.
Configure and support SAP CFIN functionalities including:
Initial Load & Replication
Central Payment
Central Reconciliation
Application Interface Framework (AIF)
Source System Mapping
Key & Value Mapping
Design and implement real-time financial data replication using SAP LT Replication Server (SLT).
Collaborate with business teams to harmonize finance processes across multiple ERP landscapes.
Integration & Data Migration
Integrate SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems into the SAP Central Finance environment.
Manage data migration activities, including data cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
Support financial master data governance and integration with SAP MDG.
Ensure data consistency, completeness, and accuracy throughout migration and replication processes.
Troubleshoot replication and interface issues to ensure business continuity.
Finance Transformation & Process Optimization
Drive finance transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA Central Finance capabilities.
Analyze existing business processes and recommend improvements based on SAP best practices.
Enable process standardization and harmonization across global business units.
Support business stakeholders in defining future-state finance operating models.
Financial Reporting & Support
Support financial reporting, analytics, and consolidation requirements.
Develop and enhance reporting solutions using SAP Fiori, Embedded Analytics, SAC, and BW.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Provide post-go-live support and resolve issues related to:
Data Replication
Financial Postings
AIF Monitoring
Mapping Errors
Reconciliation Discrepancies
Financial Reporting
Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP Central Finance (CFIN).
Expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance and SAP FI/CO.
Experience with:
SLT Replication
AIF Framework
MDG Integration
Data Migration & Reconciliation
Financial Master Data Management
SAP Fiori Applications
Understanding of SAP integration methodologies and architecture.
Functional Expertise
Strong knowledge of:
General Ledger (GL)
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Cost Center Accounting
Profit Center Accounting
Internal Orders
Bank Accounting
Financial Closing & Reporting
Preferred Experience
6 to 15 years of SAP consulting experience.
Minimum 4+ years of hands-on SAP Central Finance experience.
At least one full lifecycle SAP Central Finance implementation is preferred.
Experience working on global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
Exposure to Treasury, Group Reporting, and Cash Management would be an advantage.
Experience in Agile and SAP Activate methodologies.

Locations: Bangalore | Mumbai | Pune | Gandhinagar
Experience: 6-15 Years

Description:
SAP Project Manager S/4HANA Public Cloud
Location - Mumbai , Pune , Bangalore , Gandhinagar

Flexible / Hybrid / Remote

Experience
8-15 years in SAP Project Management with at least 2 end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementations.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP Project Manager to lead SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing project delivery, stakeholder engagement, budget oversight, risk management, and ensuring successful deployment of SAP best practices using the SAP Activate methodology.
The Project Manager will collaborate with business stakeholders, SAP consultants, system integrators, and technical teams to drive projects from initiation through go-live and hypercare support.
Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects.
Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and resources.
Drive project governance and ensure compliance with SAP Activate methodology.
Facilitate requirement gathering, fit-to-standard workshops, and solution design discussions.
Coordinate cross-functional teams including Functional, Technical, Integration, Data Migration, and Change Management workstreams.
Monitor project progress and provide regular status reporting to leadership and steering committees.
Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment with business objectives.
Identify and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies.
Oversee testing cycles including SIT, UAT, and Go-Live readiness activities.
Support cutover planning, deployment, hypercare, and project closure activities.
Ensure delivery quality, adherence to best practices, and customer satisfaction.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
8+ years of SAP project management experience.
Minimum 2 full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects.
Strong understanding of SAP Activate methodology and Cloud ERP deployment models.
Experience managing global or multi-country SAP programs.
Proven expertise in project planning, budgeting, risk management, and vendor management.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with Agile, Hybrid Agile, and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP Activate Project Manager Certification.
PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, or Agile certifications.
Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Signavio.
Knowledge of finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, or HR business processes.

Job Description:
Data Architect-Data Fabric
Location: Bangalore / Pune

The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Data Architect with strong expertise in data modelling and enterprise data architecture to design scalable, secure, and high-performing data solutions. The role will work closely with business, technology, data engineering, and governance teams to define data architecture and deliver strategic data initiatives.

Principal Responsibilities
Define and implement enterprise and solution-level data architecture aligned with business and technology strategy.
Develop and review conceptual, logical, and physical data models across complex business domains.
Establish data modelling standards, principles, naming conventions, and reusable patterns.
Design architectures for data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, and analytical platforms.
Define data integration patterns across ETL/ELT, APIs, batch, and real-time data pipelines.
Assess and recommend appropriate databases, cloud platforms, and data technologies.
Ensure solutions address data quality, governance, security, scalability, and performance.
Partner with data engineers, developers, architects, and business stakeholders to ensure effective implementation.
Review existing data landscapes and define target-state architecture and modernisation roadmaps.
Produce architecture documentation, data models, design standards, and technical recommendations.

Requirements
13+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Data Modelling, Database Architecture, or related roles.
Strong hands-on experience in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling.
Excellent understanding of relational, dimensional, OLTP, and OLAP data models.
Experience with data warehousing, data lakes/lakehouses, and cloud data platforms.
Strong SQL and database knowledge.
Experience with ETL/ELT, data integration, data governance, metadata, and data lineage.
Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP data services is desirable.
Experience with modelling tools such as Erwin, ER/Studio, Sparx EA, or equivalent is advantageous.
Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills.
Experience in large and complex enterprise environments preferred.

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
Certifications such as DAMA, TOGAF, AWS/Azure/GCP, or equivalent are advantageous.

Were building and growing our hyperlocal (on-demand) logistics business within Delhivery, and are for someone who can take ownership from day zero acquiring customers, shaping the GTM motion, and building a repeatable revenue engine.

Strong exposure to both SME and enterprise sales
Hands-on experience with solution selling (not just transactional sales)
High ownership mindset — comfortable operating in 0-1 environments
Strong understanding of last-mile logistics, fulfillment challenges, and operational nuances

You’re not inheriting a book of business — you’re building it

Opportunity to scale into a larger role as the business grows

Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs.
plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development
(Attrition
Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly

Description:
Application Engineer - Drill Bits
Would you like to help customers improve drilling performance and economics through innovative drill-bit solutions
Are you an engineering graduate ready to start or grow your career in application engineering
Partner with the best

Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company. We provide innovative solutions that make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient across the energy value chain. Operating in more than 120 countries, we combine deep industry expertise with advanced engineering and digital technologies to support energy production, transformation, and decarbonization. With more than a century of experience, we partner with customers across oil and gas, industrial, and emerging energy markets to help advance a more sustainable energy future.
Fuel your passion
As an Application Engineer for Drill Bits, you will provide technical and application support to customers and internal teams. You will use engineering analysis, field data, and collaborative problem-solving to recommend drill-bit solutions, improve drilling performance, and support business growth. This role is suitable for a fresh engineering graduate or an early-career professional who is eager to learn and develop within the drill-bit industry.
As an Application Engineer, you will be responsible for:
Providing technical support for drill-bit products and applications
Supporting the implementation of product strategies, engineering standards, and best practices across the assigned market and the wider Asia-Pacific region
Working with the sales team to develop account strategies, identify opportunities, and support profitable growth
Preparing drill-bit proposals, application engineering studies, design recommendations, drilling-parameter guidance, and vibration-mitigation recommendations
Analyzing drilling data and product performance to identify opportunities for performance improvement
Collaborating with customers and Baker Hughes design engineers to adapt existing products or develop new designs for specific applications
Investigating unusual or unsatisfactory product performance, identifying root causes, and recommending preventive and corrective actions
Supporting field activities and visiting rig sites when required
To be successful in this role, you will:
Hold a bachelor s degree in engineering from an accredited college or university
Be a fresh engineering graduate or have one to two years of relevant work experience
Demonstrate strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
Value (GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high.
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner.
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Role: Area Sales Manager
Location: Zonal office- Bhubaneswar
Reporting to: Regional Sales Manager
Team name: Sales team
About the Team and the Role:
The Sales team at Ather is responsible for building a network and establishing the blueprint for selling Electric Vehicles in India, driving a historic transformation of the two-wheeler commute through a breakthrough product and an engaged community.
This role is for an Area Sales Manager who will play a key role in the growth story, owning the business in their region and ensuring growth in sales while maintaining high levels of customer experience and operational profits.
Responsibilities:
Drive sales through assigned Channel Partners
Build teams and systems that ensure sustainable sales growth while maintaining exceptionally high customer experience standards.
Foster and manage strong relationships with retail partners to ensure business thriving and alignment with brand vision.
Execute operational excellence at Channel Partners covering local demand generation and sales driving activities.
Analyze the sales funnel to identify problem statements, develop solutions, and motivate teams for implementation.
Deliver against steep ramp-up plans with a focus on scaling the regional business effectively.
Manage multi-stakeholder inputs from internal teams and external partners to maintain design and operational integrity.
Conduct regular performance reviews and site assessments to ensure business health and consistency across locations.
Strategise and strive to improve Ather market share in the assigned territory
Required qualifications
Postgraduate or graduate degree in Business or Engineering from a Tier I/Tier II institute.
4 to 10 years of experience in B2C/Channel sales.
Must Have Competencies
Data-driven analysis of sales funnels to identify bottlenecks and implement strategic solutions for revenue growth.
Strategic channel management to align retail partners with corporate goals while ensuring partner profitability.
Operational excellence in retail management, specifically driving local demand generation and customer experience standards.
Expertise in B2C sales strategies and the ability to execute aggressive market ramp-up plans in competitive environments.
Good to Have Competencies
Deep understanding of technology or automobile retail landscapes and evolving mobility trends in the Indian market.
Advanced negotiation and persuasive communication skills for navigating complex stakeholder relationships and retail partnerships.
Proficiency in organizational planning and resource prioritization to manage multi-location business operations.
Ability to build and empower high-performing teams through structured mentorship and performance management systems.
Want to know more?
At Ather, weve built India’s first intelligent scooter, from scratch. Based on the philosophy of clean design and smart technology, we are transforming the urban commute experience. We are expanding in India, and in the coming years, we look forward to scaling up and launching more products globally. Today, our product offerings include the Ather 450X, 450S, 450 Apex, and Rizta. Beyond the product, we are also setting up an extensive charging network and re-imagining end-to-end ownership experience. To know more, check out our Careers site and our Substack.
Be You, With Us
The Ather story doesn't write itself - our people do. We believe everyone is equal, but not the same. Diversity is our strength, and building an inclusive and equitable workplace begins with acknowledging and embracing our differences. We are an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects a wide range of identities, experiences, and perspectives - all united by a shared passion to shape the Ather journey.

Description:
Project Role : Data Management Practitioner


Project Role Description : Maintain the quality and compliance of an organizations data assets. Design and implement data strategies, ensuring data integrity and enforcing governance policies. Establish protocols to handle data, safeguard sensitive information, and optimize data usage within the organization. Design and advise on data quality rules and set up effective data compliance policies.


Must have skills : Graph Databases


Good to have skills : Neo4j, Python Frameworks
Minimum
7.5 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education


Summary:
As a Data Management Practitioner, a typical day involves overseeing the stewardship of an organization''s data assets to ensure they meet quality and compliance standards. This role includes designing and implementing comprehensive data strategies that uphold data integrity and enforce governance policies. The practitioner establishes and maintains protocols for managing data securely, protecting sensitive information, and optimizing the use of data across various departments. Additionally, they provide guidance on data quality standards and develop effective compliance policies to support organizational objectives and regulatory requirements.


Roles Responsibilities:
Design and implement scalable ETL and ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load structured and unstructured data into graph databases.
Build and maintain knowledge graph infrastructure on platforms such as Neo4j, Stardog, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, or Apache Jena including indexing, query optimization, and availability tuning.
Write and optimize complex SPARQL, Cypher, and Gremlin queries for production graph workloads including traversal, inference, and aggregation.
Implement SHACL or ShEx constraints and automated validation pipelines to enforce data conformance against ontology schemas.
Develop APIs and microservices that expose graph data to downstream consumers including search, recommendation, and LLM/RAG pipelines.
Integrate knowledge graph layers with vector databases and embedding models to support hybrid semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation.
Collaborate with ontology designers to implement and version ontology changes safely in production without disrupting dependent services.
Monitor graph platform performance, diagnose bottlenecks, and drive reliability improvements across ingestion and query layers.
Conduct code reviews, define engineering standards, and mentor mid-level and junior developers on graph engineering best practices.
Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and internal tooling to support the broader knowledge graph team''s productivity.

Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
Responsible for team decisions.
Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
Lead initiatives to improve data governance frameworks and ensure alignment with organizational goals.
Facilitate communication and coordination between cross-functional teams to promote data compliance and quality.
Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and enhance team capabilities.


Professional Technical Skills:


Must To Have Skills:
Proficiency in Graph Databases, Neo4j, Python Frameworks.
Good To Have Skills: Experience with Neo4j, Python Frameworks.
Strong knowledge of data modeling and schema design specific to graph database technologies.
Ability to develop and optimize queries for efficient data retrieval and manipulation within graph databases.
Experience in implementing data governance policies and ensuring compliance with data protection regulations.
Familiarity with integrating graph databases into broader data ecosystems and workflows.
The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in Graph Databases.
This position is based at our Bhubaneswar office.

Education:
A 15 years full time education is required.


Qualification 15 years full time education

Description:
Job Summary:
Under general supervision, uses statistical analysis, collaborative cross-functional intelligence, and validated planning parameter settings to disaggregate the demand plan and determine the optimal inventory levels. Aligns the supply plan with the demand plan and drives stability in the supply chain.
Key Responsibilities:
Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Reports any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Complies with HSE standards, policies, procedures & regulations. Engages in HSE training. Quality Follows applicable standard work, process documentation, and quality procedures. Performs quality checks on system planning parameters (min/max inventory level, re-order point, upper/lower tracking signals, segments, etc.) taking action to support Plan for Every Part (PFEP). Delivery Performs supply and demand analysis, highlighting areas of concern for the next 12 months. Assists others in gathering and compiling information through primary and secondary research. Runs planning parameter setting changes in the simulation environment to analyze the impact to KPIs, and provides executive and detailed report of results. Monitors signals indicating abnormal demand and/or stock levels feeding the supply schedule. Makes adjustments to the planning parameter settings if approved. Enters approved forecast adjustments at the detail level to align with the aggregate demand plan. Takes ownership and accountability for the disaggregate demand plan, supply plan, and inventory plan that supports end Customer needs. Demonstrates the target level of proficiency in core competencies. Remains flexible and performs other miscellaneous duties, as required, to meet business goals. Teamwork Communicates effectively within the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements and career goals. Participates in improvement (quality, safety, process, material flow, etc.) projects.
Need hands on experience on reverse logistics.
Good written&verbal communication.
Competencies:
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Materials Planning System Utilization - Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day-to-day operations.

Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.

Inventory Management and Optimization - Uses analytics and algorithms to determine the optimal level of inventory investment across the end-to-end supply chain within specific constraints (warehouse space, customer delivery, etc.); provides guidance and expertise on planning parameter refinement; develops inventory strategies to support Cummins strategy and not just a business unit strategy.

Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.

Network Master Supply Planning - Uses statistical analysis and collaborates with other disciplines to provide a long term view of customers demand, and ensures the supply plan is aligned with the demand plan; balances supply and demand in a manner that achieves the financial and service objectives, while stabilizing the supply chain and optimizing the supply chain tensions.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Requires some work experience and intermediate level knowledge obtained through training or on-the-job experience.

Clinical Operations & Governance: Serve as the administrative bridge between executive management, clinical consultants, nursing staff, and operational teams. Oversee OPD/IPD clinical workflows, OT scheduling, and ICU/emergency department readiness.

Roles & Responsibilities
Onco-Reconstructive Surgery: Perform complex plastic, microvascular, and reconstructive surgical procedures following major oncological resections, including head and neck, breast, musculoskeletal, and soft tissue reconstructions.
Microvascular Procedures: Plan and execute free tissue transfers, pedicled flaps, and microsurgical vessel anastomoses to restore form and function in post-cancer resection cases.
Multidisciplinary Tumor Board Participation: Collaborate closely with surgical oncologists, head and neck surgeons, surgical mammologists, and medical/radiation oncologists in pre-operative planning and tumor boards to design comprehensive treatment paths.
Wound & Lymphedema Management: Oversee advanced wound care, complex tissue defect management, skin grafting, and surgical intervention for cancer-related lymphedema.
Inpatient & Post-Operative Care: Lead post-operative flap monitoring, ICU care, and rehabilitative planning to ensure flap survival and optimal functional recovery.
Quality & Accreditation Compliance: Uphold institutional surgical safety checklists, infection control protocols, clinical documentation standards, and NABH guidelines.
Academic & Mentorship Contributions: Train surgical residents, fellows, and specialized nursing staff in basic plastic surgical techniques, wound care, and microvascular monitoring.

Education: MCh or DrNB in Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery following an MBBS and MS in General Surgery.
Experience: Above 5 years of post-qualification experience in Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery, with significant exposure to onco-reconstruction and microvascular techniques in a tertiary care or dedicated cancer hospital.
Technical Expertise: High procedural skill in free flap transfers, pedicled flap harvests, microsurgery, and aesthetic/functional tissue restoration.
Clinical & Soft Skills: Fine manual dexterity, strong clinical decision-making during complex multi-stage procedures, empathetic patient communication, and a strong collaborative mindset across surgical specialties.

Surgical Uro-Oncology: Perform complex open, laparoscopic, and minimally invasive surgical procedures for urological malignancies, including radical prostatectomies, radical cystectomies with urinary diversions, partial/radical nephrectomies, retroperitoneal lymph node dissections (RPLND), and penile/testicular cancer resections.

Technical Expertise: Advanced proficiency in laparoscopic and complex open uro-oncological procedures, urinary diversion techniques, and endourological interventions.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Diagnostic Nuclear Imaging: Interpret and report diagnostic nuclear medicine procedures, including whole-body PET-CT scans (FDG, PSMA, DOTA), SPECT-CT, bone scans, thyroid scans, and renal dynamic imaging for cancer diagnosis, staging, and treatment monitoring.
Radionuclide Therapy & Theranostics: Administer high-dose and low-dose radionuclide therapies, including Radioiodine ($I^{131}$) therapy for thyroid cancer, $Lu^{177}$-PSMA therapy for prostate cancer, $Lu^{177}$-DOTATATE therapy for neuroendocrine tumors, and bone pain palliation.
Multidisciplinary Tumor Board Participation: Actively participate in weekly multidisciplinary tumor boards to collaborate with surgical, medical, and radiation oncologists in incorporating molecular imaging into personalized patient treatment plans.
Radiation Safety & AERB Compliance: Serve as a key custodian of radiation safety, ensuring strict compliance with Atomic Energy Regulatory Board (AERB) guidelines, radioactive waste management protocols, and institutional quality assurance programs.
Isolation Ward & Patient Care: Oversee the high-dose radionuclide therapy isolation ward, managing patient admissions, pre-therapy evaluations, radiation exposure monitoring, and post-discharge safety instruction.
Hot Lab & Quality Control Management: Oversee hot lab operations, radioisotope handling, radiopharmaceutical preparation, dose calibrator checks, and gamma camera/PET-CT quality control procedures.
Academics & Clinical Research: Guide residents, nuclear medicine technologists, and radiation safety officers, while driving clinical research and theranostic protocols.


Preferred Candidate Profile
Education: MD in Nuclear Medicine, with a recognized Fellowship in Nuclear Medicine.
Experience: Above 5 years of post-qualification experience in Nuclear Medicine.

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling
services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward
the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day
tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the
customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a
conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick
up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of
the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is
expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the
overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of
stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

To develop and implement the organization's industrial relations strategy, fostering a positive and harmonious relationship between management and employees, ensuring compliance with labor laws, and effectively managing industrial disputes.

Grievance Handling and Dispute Resolution:

Compliance with Labor Laws:

Stay updated on changes in labor legislation and advise management on their implications.

Experience - 20+ years of Experience.

In-depth knowledge of Indian labor laws and industrial relations practices.
Proven negotiation and collective bargaining skills.
Strong conflict resolution and mediation abilities.
Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with employees, unions, and external authorities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ethical and fair approach to handling employee and industrial relations issues.

Description:
Job Summary:
Under minimal supervision and in accordance with Cummins Delegation of Authority Policy, determines the quantity and order date for materials needed to meet the master production schedule or independent customer demand. Expedites purchase or production orders as appropriate.
Key Responsibilities:
Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Reports any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Complies with HSE standards, policies, procedures & regulations. Engages in HSE training. Quality Follows applicable standard work, process documentation, and quality procedures. Performs quality checks on material planning master data (lead time, order quantities, etc. ) taking action to support Plan for Every Part (PFEP). Works with Quality to disposition non-conforming material in a timely manner. Delivery Initiates purchase and work orders to support the demand plan. Participates on allocation calls with Sourcing Manager, supplier, and other Cummins entities to understand nature and impact of constraints. Works with suppliers to reduce lead time and order quantities balancing supply with demand. Collaborates with Supply Chain Planners across the organization to reposition excess inventory to locations with supporting demand. Provides accurate, timely updates specific to inventory availability and back order recovery plans. Manages part change requests and ramp up / ramp down activities to meet demand while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory. Reconciles order boards for critical suppliers, critical parts, and past due orders on a routine basis. Supports the Deliver Supplier Improvement Process initiative to improve performance metrics. Documents, communicates, and follows-up on action items impacting the ability to execute the plan. Takes ownership and accountability for delivery of supplier schedules that supports end Customer needs. Demonstrates the target level of proficiency in core competencies. Remains flexible and performs other miscellaneous duties, as required, to meet business goals. Teamwork Communicates effectively within the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements and career goals. Participates in improvement (quality, safety, process, material flow, etc. ) projects.
Drive end-to-end supply chain performance by ensuring superior customer service, achieving Customer On-Time Delivery (OTD) targets, managing order fulfillment processes, optimizing trading supply chain operations, and implementing functional excellence through system-driven planning and continuous improvement initiatives.
Key Responsibilities

1. Customer OTD & Customer Service
Ensure achievement of Customer OTD targets for internal and external customers.
Monitor customer demand, order fulfillment status, and service level performance.
Coordinate with Production, Procurement, Warehousing, and Logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries.
Analyze delivery performance and implement corrective actions to improve customer satisfaction.
Proactively manage supply risks to minimize customer service disruptions.

2. Order Management
Manage the complete order-to-delivery process.
Review customer orders, prioritize requirements, and ensure accurate order execution.
Monitor backlog orders and expedite critical customer requirements.
Ensure timely order confirmation, scheduling, invoicing, and dispatch coordination.
Resolve order-related issues through cross-functional collaboration.

3. Trading Supply Chain Management
Plan and manage trading product procurement and replenishment.
Coordinate with suppliers and distribution teams to maintain optimum inventory levels.
Monitor stock availability and prevent shortages or excess inventory.
Drive supplier performance improvement initiatives to ensure uninterrupted supply.
Manage inventory health, working capital, and product availability.

4. Functional Excellence
Lead continuous improvement initiatives across SCM processes.
Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Drive Lean, process optimization, and cost reduction projects.
Monitor key KPIs and implement actions for sustained performance improvement.
Support digital transformation and best-practice deployment across the organization.

5. System-Driven Planning
Utilize ERP, ASCP, and planning systems to drive data-based decision-making.
Maintain planning master data and planning parameters.
Improve forecast accuracy, material planning, and inventory optimization through system-generated recommendations.
Develop dashboards and reports to support planning reviews and business decisions.
Ensure effective adoption of digital tools, automation, and planning processes.
Key Competencies
Supply Chain Planning & Execution
Customer Focus
Order Management
ERP / ASCP Knowledge
Data Analytics & Reporting
Inventory Optimization
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Problem Solving & Decision Making
Continuous Improvement Mindset
Agility, Accountability, and Ownership
Competencies:
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Materials Planning System Utilization - Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day-to-day operations.

Part Change Control Management - Evaluates and implements engineering change request (obsolescence, supersessions, new part release, etc. ) to meet customer delivery requirements while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.

Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.

Master Supply Scheduling - Establishes and maintains a valid Master Production Schedule for a family of products, which meets customer s expectations and requirements while maximizing operational efficiency; validates procurement scheduling, production scheduling, and replenishment planning are aligned to manufacturing and assembly assets for conversion.

Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

College, University or equivalent degree in Business, Engineering, or related field preferred.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Requires significant relevant work experience or specialized skills obtained through education, training, or on-the-job experience in an equivalent field such as materials planning, production scheduling, manufacturing, or inventory control.

Description:
About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also
includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks,
dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Customer focus: Driving Net.

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification:Diploma/ Bachelors in Optometry
Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Job Summary:
Under general supervision, determines the quantity and order date for materials needed to meet the master production schedule or independent customer demand. Expedites purchase or production orders as appropriate.
Key Responsibilities:
Health, Safety Environmental (HSE) Reports any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Complies with HSE standards, policies, procedures regulations. Engages in HSE training. Quality Follows applicable standard work, process documentation, and quality procedures. Performs quality checks on material planning master data (lead time, order quantities, etc. ) taking action to support Plan for Every Part (PFEP). Works with Quality to disposition non-conforming material in a timely manner. Delivery Initiates purchase and work orders to support the demand plan. Participates on allocation calls with Sourcing Manager, supplier, and other Cummins entities to understand nature and impact of constraints. Works with suppliers to reduce lead time and order quantities balancing supply with demand. Collaborates with Supply Chain Planners across the organization to reposition excess inventory to locations with supporting demand. Provides accurate, timely updates specific to inventory availability and back order recovery plans. Manages part change requests and ramp up / ramp down activities to meet demand while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory. Reconciles order boards for critical suppliers, critical parts, and past due orders on a routine basis. Supports the Deliver Supplier Improvement Process initiative to improve performance metrics. Documents, communicates, and follows-up on action items impacting the ability to execute the plan. Takes ownership and accountability for delivery of supplier schedules that supports end Customer needs. Demonstrates the target level of proficiency in core competencies. Remains flexible and performs other miscellaneous duties, as required, to meet business goals. Teamwork Communicates effectively within the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements and career goals. Participates in improvement (quality, safety, process, material flow, etc. ) projects.
Procurement of MS commodity parts from various suppliers
Follow with suppliers for weekly material receipt and timely feedback to planning team
Creating releases for domestic parts for CPG PHP as per agreed process
Managing exceptions and closing , rescheduling releases in ASCP as per process to have right inventory in warehouse
Coordination with warehouse Logistics team.
OTD calculation for PHP CPG suppliers and RCA update
Arrange meetings with Senior members from suppliers.
Visit suppliers to ensure on time supply when necessary.
Escalate any issue regarding supply , price, failures in time, update issue register for issues of Level 3 and 4 level.
Fill PCA, Deviations and MPCR wherever needed.
Develop supplier cordial relation and ensure smooth transactions
Ensure stock updation by suppliers for VMI parts in SIM tool
Competencies:
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Materials Planning System Utilization - Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day-to-day operations.

Part Change Control Management - Evaluates and implements engineering change request (obsolescence, supersessions, new part release, etc. ) to meet customer delivery requirements while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.

Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.

Master Supply Scheduling - Establishes and maintains a valid Master Production Schedule for a family of products, which meets customer s expectations and requirements while maximizing operational efficiency; validates procurement scheduling, production scheduling, and replenishment planning are aligned to manufacturing and assembly assets for conversion.

Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Requires some work experience and intermediate level knowledge obtained through training or on-the-job experience.

Description:
Ways of Working - Mandate 3 : Employees to be located in their place of posting / respective office base location.
About Swiggy: 
Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city.
You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants - learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement.
This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success.
You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
-Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
-Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
-Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
-Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
-Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
-Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
-Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
-Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
-80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
-0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
-Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
-Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
-Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
-Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Skip Level City/Zonal Manager

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards
achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level
of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that
Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring
this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers Driving sales vs. Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership plan Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company development training modules
(Attrition Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to Control) execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Cash & Inventory Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions management are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring
the best customer experience to the Lenskart CustomerEnsuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues
Supervision are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality
standards
Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
SOP adherence &
implementation Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the storeMaintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other
Store upkeep &
maintenance equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or
damage in the store Personal attributes & competencies

Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships

Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
