Job Summary
Job Title: Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer (Agentic AI). Location: Jaipur / Indore. Employment Type: Full-Time. Experience: 3 to 6 years.
Role Overview: We are looking for a hands-on Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer who can independently design, develop, test, and deploy end-to-end Agentic AI applications using React.js and Python. You will be responsible for taking a business requirement, breaking it into modules, deciding the application architecture, designing data structures and APIs, integrating AI components, and delivering a fully functional, production-ready solution. We need someone who can think independently, make technical decisions, integrate services, and take complete ownership of the application lifecycle.
Responsibilities
End-to-End Development: Build complete AI applications using React.js for the frontend and Python for the backend.
Solution Design: Understand business requirements, divide work into modules, and define application architecture, data structures, and API requirements.
Agentic AI Development: Integrate LLMs, RAG pipelines, AI agents, tool calling, and frameworks such as Lang Chain and Lang Graph.
Service Integration: Integrate third-party APIs, databases, AI models, MCP servers, and other required services and protocols.
Database Design: Design and manage relational databases and vector databases based on application requirements.
Deployment Infrastructure: Handle end-to-end deployment, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, cloud infrastructure, and production releases.
Testing Quality: Perform end-to-end testing, including unit, integration, functional, and smoke testing, to ensure application reliability.
Performance Security: Monitor application performance, troubleshoot issues, and follow secure coding and deployment practices.
Ownership Communication: Work independently, communicate effectively with stakeholders, provide regular updates, and support off-hours activities when required by business needs.
Required Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience with React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frontend development.
Strong Python programming skills with experience in FastAPI, Django, or similar backend frameworks.
Practical experience building and deploying end-to-end AI applications.
Good understanding of LLMs, RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI agent workflows.
Experience with frameworks such as Lang Chain or Lang Graph.
Understanding of MCP, tool calling, function calling, and API integrations.
Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases, REST APIs, and data modelling.
Experience with Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms, and production deployments.
Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks such as Py-Test and Jest.
Ideal Candidate
The Architect's Mindset: You dont just write code; you think about systems. You understand how to structure data flow, optimize token limits, and design for long-term memory in AI agents.
The Polyglot: You can move seamlessly between the nuances of a React frontend, a high-performance Python backend, and the non-deterministic nature of Large Language Models.
The Perfectionist: You care about observability, evaluation metrics, and security - you want to build AI that is not only smart but reliable and production-ready.

Description:
Manages all engineering/maintece operations, including maintaining the building, grounds and physical plant with particular attention towards safety, security and asset protection.
Accountable for managing the budget, capital expenditure projects, preventative maintece and energy conservation.
Responsible for maintaining regulatory requirements.
Assists in leading the emergency response team for all facility issues.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the engineering and maintece or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Building and Construction, Engineering, Mechanics, or related major; 1 year experience in the engineering and maintece or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Engineering Operations and Budgets
- Manages the physical plant including equipment, refrigeration, HVAC, plumbing, water treatment and electrical systems.
- Ensures regulatory compliance to facility regulations and safety standards.
- Manages and controls heat, light and power and recommends current best methods for energy conservation and economical facility operations.
- Develops specifications and requirements for service contracts and administers such contracts to support building needs.
- Distributes preventive maintece and repair work orders and monitors timeliness and quality of completion.
- Oversees and directs the maintece of grounds, guestrooms, public space, restaurants, property vehicles and recreational facilities.
- Develops a long term plan for preventative maintece and asset protection and overseeing execution of plan.
- Develops project plans in accordance with renovation or new construction needs.
- Contacts contractors for bids and supervising construction to ensure timely completion of projects within budgetary guidelines.
- Builds positive relationships with external customers such as city building/zoning department, fire prevention bureau and vendors.
- Ensures fire crew has complete understanding of all procedures, equipment and alarms.
- Performs monthly property inspection to ensure buildings and grounds are maintained in excellent condition.
- Conducts guest room and common area inspection to ensure guest satisfaction.
- Inspects and evaluates the physical condition of facilities in order to determine the type of work required.
- Recommends or arranges for additional services such as painting, repair work, renovations, and the replacement of furnishings and equipment.
- Selects and orders or purchasing new equipment, supplies, and furnishings.
- Manages parts and equipment inventory.
Maintaining Property Standards
- Ensures building and equipment licenses and certifications are current.
- Maintains property life safety systems (fire fighting equipment, sprinkler systems and alarm systems).
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifying excellent customer service and creating a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Shares plans with property leadership and ensuring corrective action is taken to continuously improve guest satisfaction.
- Strives to improve service performance.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Sales Manager/Assistant Sales Manager/Senior Sales Manager, you re not just generating and managing group sales - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Description:
CustomerCare Executive IIFL Gold Loan (Detailed JD)

RoleOverview
A CustomerCare Executive (CCE) at IIFLFinance (Gold Loan division) is responsible for handlingcustomers at the branch, supporting loan processing, and ensuringsmooth service experience .
Insimple terms:
Youare the first point of contact for customers and the support systemfor the branch team.




CoreResponsibilities

1. Customer Handling Service
Welcome and assist walk-in customers
Understand customer requirements (loan, renewal, closure)
Explain:
Gold loan process
Interest rates
Repayment options
Ensure excellent customer experience and quick service




2. Documentation KYC Processing
Collect and verify:
Aadhaar / PAN
Address proof
Photographs
Ensure proper KYC compliance as per RBI norms
Fill and process loan application forms
Maintain accurate customer records




3. Loan Processing Support
Coordinate with:
Gold Appraiser
Branch Manager
Assist in:
Loan entry in system
Documentation completion
Ensure fast turnaround time (TAT) for disbursement




4. Customer Follow-ups Telecalling
Call customers for:
Loan renewals
Interest payments
Overdue reminders
Handle inbound customer queries
Maintain relationship with existing customers




5. Data Entry MIS Management
Enter customer and loan details into company systems
Maintain:
Daily transaction records
Customer database
Generate basic reports for branch operations




6. Cash Handling Support (in some branches)
Assist in:
Cash collection (interest/repayment)
Receipt generation
Ensure proper cash reconciliation at end of day




7. Branch Coordination
Support smooth coordination between:
Customers
Appraisers
Sales staff
Help manage:
Customer queue
Branch workflow




8. Compliance Process Adherence
Follow:
Company policies
RBI guidelines
Ensure error-free documentation
Support audits and verification processes




KeySkills Required

FunctionalSkills
Basic knowledge of:
Banking/NBFC processes
Documentation KYC
Computer skills (MS Excel, data entry systems)


BehavioralSkills
Good communication (Hindi/English + local language)
Customer handling patience
Attention to detail
Multitasking ability




EligibilityCriteria
Graduate (preferred) or 12th pass
03 years of experience in:
Customer service
Banking/NBFC
Retail or telecalling
Freshers are often hired




KPIs(Performance Metrics)
Customer satisfaction levels
Accuracy of documentation
Turnaround time (TAT)
Number of customer interactions handled
Follow-up conversion (renewals, payments)




RealisticNature of the Role
Entry-level role in NBFC structure
Repetitive but fast-paced work
High interaction with customers
Moderate pressure during peak business hours
Important support role but not core decision-making




Day-to-DayWork
Typicalday includes:
Handling walk-in customers
Completing KYC and documentation
Coordinating loan processing
Calling customers for follow-ups
Updating system records




CareerPath
Growthopportunities in **IIFL Finance Gold Loan:
Customer Care Executive
Senior CCE / Operations Executive
Assistant Branch Manager
Branch Manager
Territory Manager

Build talent pipelines and ensure timely closure of critical vacancies.
Monitor recruitment effectiveness, hiring quality and joining ratios.
Manage multiple recruitment assignments independently while ensuring a positive candidate experience.

7–8 years of proven recruitment experience with strong exposure to Manufacturing and Packaging industry hiring.

Strong understanding of manufacturing functions, organizational structures and talent requirements.
Excellent sourcing, headhunting, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage end-to-end recruitment independently and deliver results within defined timelines.

Competitive salary with no fixed upper limit for the right candidate, based on skills, experience and recruitment expertise.

Job Purpose:-

To oversee and manage overall plant operations, ensuring achievement of production targets, consistent product quality, optimum productivity, equipment reliability, effective inventory management, cost control, project execution, employee development, and compliance with applicable safety and statutory requirements.

3. Job Description (JD) Key Responsibilities:-

A. Production & Operations
Develop and execute production plans based on market demand, sales forecasts, and business requirements.
Ensure achievement of production targets, timely product availability, and optimum capacity utilisation.
Drive Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), lean manufacturing, productivity, and operational efficiency.
Identify production bottlenecks and implement corrective and preventive measures.
B. Quality Management
Ensure consistent product quality in accordance with approved specifications, GMP, ISO, and internal standards.
Minimise product rejection, wastage, quality deviations, and product holds.
Coordinate with the Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams to resolve quality issues.
Ensure implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
C. Maintenance & Asset Management
Plan and monitor preventive and predictive maintenance activities.
Ensure equipment reliability and minimise unplanned downtime.
Monitor asset utilisation and identify redundant or underperforming equipment.
Ensure timely maintenance, repair, and availability of critical machinery.
D. Inventory & Material Control
Monitor inventory levels of raw materials (RM), packaging materials (PM), engineering materials, and finished goods.
Ensure inventory accuracy, optimum stock levels, and uninterrupted production.
Monitor material consumption, wastage, and stock discrepancies.
Authorise material movements and NRGP documentation as per approved procedures.
E. Purchase & Billing Control
Review and authorise purchase and billing documents within delegated authority.
Ensure adherence to approved budgets, purchase requirements, and procurement procedures.
Monitor purchase variances, billing discrepancies, and unnecessary expenditure.
Maintain proper documentation and financial controls.
F. Projects & Capital Expenditure (CAPEX)
Lead plant expansion, automation, equipment installation, and technical upgradation projects.
Monitor project budgets, timelines, resources, and execution quality.
Coordinate with vendors, contractors, consultants, and internal departments.
Ensure timely commissioning, validation, and handover of projects.
G. Systems & Process Improvement
Implement and maintain SOPs, operational systems, and process controls.
Identify operational gaps and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
Implement cost-saving, waste-reduction, and energy-efficiency measures.
Ensure timely closure of audit observations and corrective actions.
H. People Management
Lead production, maintenance, and other plant teams.
Define responsibilities, monitor performance, and conduct periodic reviews.
Identify training requirements and develop team leaders.
Promote accountability, discipline, teamwork, and employee engagement.
I. EHS & Statutory Compliance
Ensure employee, machinery, equipment, and plant safety.
Maintain compliance with applicable statutory requirements, EHS standards, and the Environmental Management System (EMS).
Implement safety inspections, risk assessments, and preventive measures.
Minimise workplace incidents and Lost Time Injuries (LTIs).
Ensure timely closure of safety observations and management action points.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
Value (GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is
correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Role & responsibilities:
Planning, Executing & Monitoring end to end first mile and middle mile operations.
To implement and develop the SOPs and is a part of audit /continuous improvement team to find gaps and provide solutions.
Work with Engineering/SNOP team on capacity planning.
Perform ongoing analysis to improve facility metrics, service levels and productivity.
Improving metrics in the medium-long run with regard to design change, optimization of layout and line haul capacity.
Review infrastructure and asset requirements based on load projections and network changes.
Drive continuous improvement projects within their facility to improve throughput, reduce cost and increase productivity.
Responsible for training, mentoring, coaching of Managers & Team Leads (all on-rolls).
Liaise with Customer support teams to resolve client specific escalations and issues.
HR/Employee related KRAs Diversity Hiring, Maintaining Employee Morale, Employee safety on the floor


Person Specifications- Skillsets/Education:
Educational Background Bachelors Degree (is a MUST) – preferably engineering ; MBA preferred.
Functional Skills –People management, Operations Management.
Personal Attributes - Curiosity, Ownership, Agile
Having good time management skills
Behavioral Skills - Good communication and analytical skills. Excellent skills in problem-solving, task prioritization and follow-up.
Ability to work well in a team environment.

*Traveling will be a part of the role. (1-2 weeks of travel per month)
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.

For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.

Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Respond and attend to guest repair requests. Communicate with guests/customers to resolve maintenance issues. Perform preventive maintenance on tools and kitchen and mechanical room equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Carry equipment (e.g., tools, radio). Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment and all utility shut-offs for buildings. Maintain maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed. Communicate each day s activities and problems that occur to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards. Display basic knowledge or ability to acquire knowledge in the following categories: air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building. Perform all surface preparation, painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement and the complete and thorough cleanup of the painting or repair area. Test, troubleshoot and perform basic repair on all types of equipment, plumbing (e.g., plunge toilets and unclog drains), electrical components including lamps, cosmetic items, extension cords, vacuum cleaners, internet devices, replace electrical switches and outlets, and other guestroom items. Program TVs and perform general housekeeping and engineering-related inventory duties. Use the Lockout/Tagout system before performing any maintenance work. Perform repairs on interior and exterior landscaping as well as external landscaping sprinklers. Display basic computer skills including inputting air handler schedules and making temperature changes.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; and properly store flammable materials. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Adhere to quality expectations and standards. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and heavier lifting or movement tasks with assistance. Move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Enter and locate work-related information using computers. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Some experience in general maintenance, exterior and interior surface preparation and painting.
Experience in hotel engineering or maintenance a plus.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
License or Certification: Driver s License

Role & responsibilities

1. INSTRUMENTATION SHIFT INCHARGE

Handle day-to-day instrumentation shift activities, including troubleshooting, maintenance, and breakdown rectification of DCS, PLC, process analyzers, weighbridges, control valves, and field instruments.
Perform installation, connection, testing, inspection, and maintenance of field instruments, including RTDs, thermocouples, level sensors/transmitters, pressure and level gauges, and flow meters.
Carry out calibration of instrumentation equipment and ensure accurate and reliable measurement of process parameters.
Assist in troubleshooting and maintenance of DCS, PLC systems, field Remote I/O (RIO) panels, analyzers, and other instrumentation control systems.
Perform pneumatic tubing, instrument tubing connections, and associated installation work for control valves and field transmitters.
Support preventive and breakdown maintenance activities to ensure the availability and reliability of instrumentation equipment.
Carry out cleaning of DCS panels, field RIO panels, field instruments, and associated instrumentation equipment.
Assist senior technicians and engineers in instrument maintenance, fault identification, testing, and equipment restoration.
Follow plant safety procedures, permit-to-work requirements, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures where applicable, and proper PPE usage during maintenance activities.
Maintain good housekeeping in the instrumentation work area and ensure tools and equipment are handled safely.

2. INSTRUMENTATION TECHNICIAN

Field Instrument Maintenance & Connection: Connect, test, and troubleshoot primary field elements including RTDs (PT100/PT1000), thermocouples (J/K/R/S types), level transmitters, and flow meters (electromagnetic, vortex, Coriolis, differential pressure).
Gauge & Sensor Testing: Inspect, install, and calibrate pressure transmitters/gauges, differential pressure (DP) cells, and direct/remote level indicators.
Control Valve Servicing: Inspect air tubing, gland packing, stroke travel, limit switches, and positioners on control valves; assist in valve overhauling and bench testing.
Calibration Support: Conduct routine field and shop calibrations using deadweight testers, standard calibrators, and temperature baths; maintain calibration tags and records.
System Awareness: Maintain working familiarity with DCS/PLC I/O cards, junction boxes (JBs), weighbridge load cells, and analytical sampling lines to assist engineers during complex troubleshooting.
Safety Protocols: Follow plant safety regulations, including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), hot/cold work permits, and intrinsic safety practices in hazardous areas.


Preferred candidate profile

Candidates with experience in Black Carbon / Carbon Black, Cement, Glass, Steel, Iron & Steel, Sponge Iron, Iron Ore Processing, Mineral Processing, or other heavy-process manufacturing industries will be preferred.

Candidates should have practical experience in instrumentation maintenance, troubleshooting, calibration, installation, connection, and testing of field instruments in an industrial plant environment.

Experience with DCS, PLC, process analyzers, weighbridges, control valves, RTDs, thermocouples, level sensors/transmitters, pressure gauges, level gauges, and flow meters will be an added advantage.

Hands-on experience in pneumatic tubing, instrument tubing connections, control valve maintenance, transmitter installation, and field instrumentation work is preferred.

Candidates should be familiar with preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, fault identification, and safe maintenance practices in automated manufacturing plants.

Experience working in continuous-process industries involving high temperatures, heavy machinery, and shift-based operations will be an advantage.

Candidates must demonstrate a strong commitment to industrial safety, permit-to-work procedures, PPE compliance, and teamwork.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Senior Officer/Officer/Assistant Manager Administration
Position
Designation: Assistant Manager – Administration
Department: HR & Administration
Location: JSW Cement Limited, Nandyal Works
Purpose of the Role
To ensure smooth administration and facility management operations of the plant by managing transport, guest house operations, security coordination, housekeeping, vendor management, statutory compliance, employee facilities, and liaison activities.
Key Responsibilities
1. Facility Management
Manage administrative facilities including office buildings, canteen, guest houses, and employee amenities.
Ensure proper housekeeping, pest control, landscaping, and maintenance services.
Monitor utility services and infrastructure upkeep.
2. Transport & Fleet Management
Coordinate company vehicles and transportation services.
Monitor vehicle maintenance, fuel consumption, insurance, and statutory renewals.
Arrange transport for visitors, officials, and employees as required.
3. Guest House Management
Oversee guest house bookings and accommodation arrangements.
Ensure cleanliness, upkeep, and hospitality standards.
Coordinate food, transport, and support services for visiting guests.
4. Vendor & Contract Management
Manage administration-related contracts and service providers.
Process PRs, POs, invoices, and payment follow-ups.
Monitor vendor performance and adherence to service level agreements.
5. Statutory & Liaison Activities
Liaise with local government authorities and regulatory bodies.
Support land, property tax, and related compliance matters.
Maintain records and documentation required by authorities.
6. Employee Welfare & Support
Coordinate employee welfare initiatives and plant events.
Support accommodation, travel, uniforms, and employee facilities.
Assist in CSR and community-related administrative activities.
7. Budget & Cost Control
Prepare and monitor the administration budget.
Track expenses related to transport, guest houses, facilities, and contracts.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization.
8. Safety & Compliance
Ensure compliance with company policies and statutory requirements.
Participate in safety committees and audits.
Support emergency preparedness and crisis management activities.
9. Employee Colony & Township Maintenance
Ensure proper maintenance and upkeep of employee residential quarters, township infrastructure, and common facilities.
Coordinate civil, electrical, plumbing, carpentry, and housekeeping activities within the employee colony.
Monitor water supply systems, street lighting, drainage networks, sewage treatment facilities, and sanitation services.
Maintain parks, gardens, recreational areas, security barracks, and other common amenities for employees and their families.
Manage Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) and service providers related to colony maintenance.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Administration budget adherence.
Guest house occupancy and service quality.
Vehicle utilization and maintenance compliance.
Vendor performance and service quality.
Statutory compliance status.
Employee satisfaction with administrative services.
Educational Qualification
Graduate in any discipline.
MBA / PG Diploma in Administration, HR, or related field preferred.
Experience
5-10 years of experience in Administration, Facility Management, HR Administration, or Industrial Relations.
Experience in manufacturing, cement, steel, power, or industrial sectors preferred.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Execute API manufacturing activities as per approved Batch Manufacturing Records (BMRs) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Handle chemical reactions, charging, distillation, filtration, drying, centrifugation and material transfer operations.
Operate and monitor reactors, centrifuges, dryers and other production equipment.
Maintain process parameters, yield records, batch documentation and equipment logbooks.
Follow cGMP, EHS, safety procedures and housekeeping standards.
Coordinate with QA, QC, Engineering and Stores departments to ensure smooth production operations.
Report process deviations, equipment issues and safety incidents to the supervisor.

Preferred candidate profile
Qualification: B.Sc. / M.Sc. Chemistry or Diploma / B.Tech in Chemical Engineering.
Experience: 04 years in API manufacturing or pharmaceutical chemical production.
Basic knowledge of chemical reactions, unit operations, GMP documentation and industrial safety.
Ability to work in shifts and handle production activities in a manufacturing plant.
Freshers with relevant qualifications and a willingness to learn may also apply.

Perks and benefits
Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
PF, ESI and other statutory benefits as applicable.
Training and career growth opportunities.
Safe and professional working environment.
Shift allowance, overtime and other benefits as per company policy.
Opportunity to develop technical expertise in API manufacturing.
AboutCompany:
Integrin Life Sciences is a pharmaceutical manufacturing company engaged in the development and manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), advanced pharmaceutical intermediates and pharmaceutical pellets. Established in 2013, the company operates from Hyderabad with its manufacturing facility located in Jaggaiahpet, Andhra Pradesh.
The company serves pharmaceutical customers across domestic and international markets, with a focus on quality, regulatory compliance, manufacturing excellence and customer satisfaction. Integrin Life Sciences operates with GMP and WHO-GMP compliant manufacturing practices and has capabilities across multiple therapeutic segments.

Summary:

Graduate degree in any discipline(from 2021 to 2025 pass - out)
Freshers are encouraged to apply
Up to 11 months of prior sales or retail experience is acceptable
Must be a local resident within 10 km of the assigned store
Personal two-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
Prior exposure to the beauty, cosmetics, or FMCG retail sector is preferred
Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
Work Schedule: 6 days per week
Weekly Off: Sunday
Work Type: Retail store-based operations with regular local market visits

Benefits
Fixed salary:  11,500 from Nykaa + 4500 from Govt (16000 inhand)
Daily TA/DA: 200
Attractive performance-based incentives

Experience of preparing the drawings of pipe fittings, connection details for different material of pipelines
General knowledge of construction techniques and practices
Knowledge and project experience of working and delivering in a BIM environment
Good oral and written communication skills

Good interpersonal skills
Willing to work for different regions and willing to learn

Position : Project Coordinator - Digital Literacy (Urban)
Location : Visakhapatnam
Reports to : State Head
Tenure : 1 Year
HelpAge India is a secular, not-for-profit organisation in India, registered under the Societies Registration Act of 1860. Set up in 1978, the organisation works for the cause and care of disadvantaged older persons to improve their quality of life . It runs healthcare, agecare, livelihood, disaster response and awareness initiatives throughout the country & advocates strongly for the elder cause. It became the first and only Indian organization to be honoured with the UN Population Award 2020 for its exemplary work in the field of ageing and population issues, and earlier in 2014, has been the recipient of Vayoshreshtha Samman by Government of India, as an institution working for senior citizens. We have been awarded highest CRISIL VO 1A grading for excellence in operations and high credibility. We have been recognized as a Great Place to Work.

Role Overview
The Project Coordinator will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing the Digital & Financial Empowerment Programme for senior citizens across the state. The position requires close engagement with senior citizen associations, community volunteers, community stakeholders, and project teams to ensure effective program delivery, achievement of targets, and timely reporting.

Programme Implementation & Coordination
Coordinate and oversee programme implementation across designated districts and urban locations.
Develop and maintain a database of Senior Citizen Associations (SCAs), Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), clubs, elder groups, and urban slum communities.
Ensure adherence to project timelines, guidelines, and quality standards.
Monitor programme activities and provide regular updates to the State Program Manager, State Head, and Programme Lead.
Training & Capacity Building
Organize and facilitate monthly digital, financial, and legal literacy workshops for senior citizens.
Conduct awareness sessions on digital safety, cyber fraud prevention, online services, financial inclusion, and legal rights.
Train and mentor youth volunteers to support programme implementation.
Build local resource networks to strengthen outreach and programme impact.
Monitoring, Reporting & Documentation
Ensure achievement of monthly and quarterly programme targets.
Collect, verify, and maintain programme data for monitoring and evaluation.
Prepare and submit progress reports, MIS reports, success stories, photographs, videos, and case studies.
Track participant feedback and recommend improvements to enhance programme effectiveness.
Stakeholder Engagement
Build and maintain strong relationships with SCAs, RWAs, elder groups, banks, financial institutions, legal authorities, and community stakeholders.
Support stakeholder consultations, programme reviews, and planning meetings.
Represent the programme at local events, networking forums, and observances such as World Elder Abuse Awareness Day (WEAAD) and International Day of Older Persons (IDOP).

1. Account Management & Revenue Growth
• Deliver revenue, sell-in, sell-out, and gross margin targets for assigned RSS and top priority regional accounts.
• Build and execute Joint Business Plans (JBPs) for both national accounts operating in
the region and top priority regional accounts, covering sales, category expansion,
visibility, activation, and profitability levers.
• Drive regional store growth and category penetration by identifying new store listings,
kitchen category expansion opportunities, and assortment upgrades.
• Own commercial delivery for regional accounts, including revenue, profitability,
pricing realization, and mix improvement.
• Partner with corporate KAMs to align regional execution with national strategy and
ensure JBP milestones are achieved.

2. Customer & Relationship Management
• Develop strong working relationships with regional decision-makers, buying teams,
and cluster managers across priority accounts.
• Act as the primary regional interface to strengthen account engagement,
communicate program priorities, and resolve escalations.
• Partner with customer teams to jointly plan visibility, activation, and category
expansion initiatives at the regional and store-cluster level.
• Manage regional negotiations on visibility space, planogram adherence, and category
placement opportunities.

3. Channel & Customer Strategy Execution
• Translate channel and category strategies into actionable regional growth plans.
• Drive implementation of assortment direction, kitchen category expansion, pricing
adherence, and promotion execution as per corporate guidance.
• Collaborate with Category, Supply Chain, Retail Marketing PMO, and Corporate KAMs
to tailor execution plans for each priority account.
• Ensure national programs are deployed as per SOP across all strategic stores.

4. Operational Excellence & Field Execution
• Lead execution of regional programs, visibility interventions, category rollouts, kitchen
expansions, and new store openings.
• Steer and supervise regional tertiary sales teams to ensure strong sell-out delivery,
on-shelf availability, and planogram compliance.
• Drive structured store inspections for key outlets – assessing planogram compliance,
stock health, kitchen presence, pricing accuracy, and visibility standards.
• Ensure smooth operational coordination including orders, claims, supply chain
alignment, OTIF, and fill rate performance.
• Review account-wise service levels and drive corrective actions with SCM and
commercial teams.
• Maintain accurate forecasting inputs and provide guidance for S&OP alignment.
• Use analytics and reporting tools to monitor performance, identify gaps, and generate
actionable insights

5. Governance, Reviews & Commercial Control
• Track and present regional account performance across revenue, sell-in, sell-out,
kitchen penetration, gross margin, and JBP milestone delivery in monthly and
quarterly reviews.
• Monitor regional trade spend utilization, program execution efficiency, and
promotion ROI while ensuring adherence to commercial guardrails.
• Maintain pricing discipline and margin realization in line with category and account
targets.
• Ensure strong data hygiene, compliance with legal, financial, and credit-control
policies.
• Drive structured follow-ups to close performance gaps in revenue, category
penetration, and sell-out delivery.

 QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
• 6-9 years of experience in RSS Account Management within FMCG / FMEG / Consumer Durables.
• Proven track record in driving RSS account growth.
• Strong commercial acumen, negotiation, and analytical skills.
• MBA preferred; familiarity with data tools (Power BI, CRM) an advantage.

Description:
Location: Sri City
Job Summary
Could you be the full-time Warehouse -Receiving EPU in Sri City? we're looking for
Your future role
Take on a new challenge and apply your warehouse management and operational expertise in a cutting-edge field. You'll work alongside dynamic and collaborative teammates. You'll play a key role in ensuring seamless warehouse operations and production line feeding, contributing to the efficiency and success of our supply chain. Day-to-day, you'll work closely with teams across the business (e.g., Logistics Management, Material Planners, Quality, and Finance), oversee material receiving and kitting processes, and much more. You'll specifically take care of inventory accuracy and timely material availability for production, but also lead and coach your team to drive continuous improvement initiatives.
Responsibilities
Promoting a culture of safety and ensuring compliance with safety regulations
Self-manage the SQCD targets in Daily Work Management (DWM) APSYS board
Maintain On time unloading, GRN, put away activities with 100% accuracy.
Improve sustain the 5S in Warehouse.
Escalate the technical constrains to the internal/external Team members through mail
Identify Transaction errors/missing and update on time after analysis.
Drive Receiving team and maintain discipline punctuality in the warehouse
Maintain 100% accuracy in GSI Transactions
Propose the suggestions in the process for SQCD improvement through SWIP
Maintain good level of inventory accuracy against target.
Conducting training sessions for teams on warehouse processes and lean methodologies
Representing the warehouse during internal and external audits, ensuring zero NCR
Providing regular reports on warehouse activity metrics and performance
Identifying and resolving operational bottlenecks and inefficiencies
Performance Measurement
Adhering the safety norms in the warehouse and follow AZDP rules
Ensure On Time GRN and On Time Put-away targets
Improve 100% accuracy in GSI transactions
Maintain 100% put away and GRN accuracy
Productivity in Receiving Process
Improve 100% Location accuracy of store stock
All about you
We value passion and attitude over experience. Thats why we dont expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we've listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
Degree in Engineering or a related field from a reputed institution
3 to 5 years of experience in warehouse operations
Working knowledge in an ERP environment (SAP desirable), including MM, WM, and PP modules
Experience in inventory management material receiving, kitting, and line feeding activities
Strong problem-solving skills and quick reactivity to critical issues
Proficiency in team management and fostering collaboration
Knowledge of lean management and continuous improvement practices
Effective communication and leadership skills
Agility and process-oriented mindset
Things youll enjoy
Join us on a life-long transformative journey the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. Youll also:
Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
Work with new security standards for rail signalling
Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
Contribute to innovative projects
Utilise our agile and inclusive working environment
Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
Progress towards leadership roles or specialized expertise in supply chain management
Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)
You dont need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, youll be proud. If youre up for the challenge, wed love to hear from you!
Important to note
As a global business, were an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. Were committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Job Summary
Could you be the full-time Site Buyer for Indirect Sourcing in Sri City were looking for
Your future role
Take on a new challenge and apply your procurement and sourcing expertise in a new cutting-edge field. Youll work alongside collaborative, innovative, and forward-thinking teammates.
You'll play a key role in developing and executing country-specific sourcing strategies for indirect categories, ensuring alignment with global commodity strategies. Day-to-day, youll work closely with teams across the business (finance, legal, operations, project teams, and more), manage supplier relationships, and ensure effective procurement strategies that drive cost savings and support organizational objectives.
You'll specifically take care of sourcing strategies for categories such as Real Estate, Office Interiors, Civil Construction, Production Consumables, MRO, and Capex items, but also focus on supplier management and process improvements.
Well look to you for:
Developing and implementing sourcing strategies for various indirect categories.
Conducting market research to identify potential suppliers and benchmark pricing.
Managing the procurement process from requisition to supplier selection.
Building and maintaining strong supplier relationships to ensure quality, service, and compliance.
Analyzing spend data to identify cost-saving opportunities and monitoring procurement performance metrics.
Collaborating with internal stakeholders to ensure a holistic approach to procurement.
Requirements
Bachelors degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, or a related field (B.E preferred).
Experience in indirect procurement or sourcing (5-7 years preferred).
Proven track record in supplier negotiation and management.
Knowledge of procurement software such as ARIBA, SAP, or BASWARE, and proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
A professional certification in procurement (e.g., CIPS, CPSM) is an added advantage.
Strong analytical skills for assessing market trends and identifying cost-saving opportunities.
Excellent negotiation and communication skills with an international mindset.
Proven leadership and ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams.
What you will enjoy
Join us on a life-long transformative journey the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. Youll also:
Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines.
Work with new security standards for rail signalling.
Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues.
Contribute to innovative projects that have a tangible impact on the future of mobility.
Utilise our inclusive and agile working environment.
Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning opportunities.
Progress towards leadership roles in procurement or other functions.
Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).
You dont need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, youll be proud. If youre up for the challenge, wed love to hear from you!
Important to note
As a global business, were an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. Were committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Department: Administration & Operations
Industry: NBFC (Non-Banking Financial Company)

Job Purpose
To manage day-to-day administrative activities, office infrastructure, vendor coordination, documentation, asset management, and branch support to ensure smooth and efficient functioning of the NBFC office while adhering to company policies and applicable compliance requirements.
Key Responsibilities
1. Office Administration
Manage daily office administration and ensure smooth branch operations.
Maintain office premises, housekeeping, security, utilities, and general facilities.
Monitor office supplies, stationery, printing materials, and other administrative requirements.
Maintain records of office assets, equipment, and inventory.
2. Vendor and Facility Management
Coordinate with vendors for housekeeping, security, maintenance, internet, telephone, and other services.
Obtain quotations, process purchase requests, and follow up on vendor bills and payments.
Monitor vendor performance and ensure timely delivery of services.
Coordinate office repairs, maintenance, and facility-related issues.
3. Documentation and Record Management
Maintain administrative files, registers, invoices, bills, and supporting documents.
Ensure proper filing and secure storage of confidential company records.
Support internal audits and compliance reviews by providing administrative documents.
Maintain records of agreements, AMC contracts, insurance, and other office-related documents.
4. Branch and Operational Support
Coordinate with branch teams, regional offices, and the corporate office for administrative requirements.
Support employee onboarding, ID cards, access cards, seating arrangements, and exit formalities.
Arrange travel, accommodation, meetings, and official events as required.
Coordinate courier services, dispatches, and receipt of official documents.
Assist with branch opening, shifting, closure, and infrastructure-related activities.
5. Cost Control and Expense Management
Track administrative expenses and maintain supporting bills and invoices.
Prepare monthly administrative expense statements and MIS reports.
Monitor stationery, utility, housekeeping, and maintenance costs.
Ensure expenses are incurred within approved budgets and company policies.
6. Compliance and Internal Controls
Follow company policies, approval procedures, and administrative SOPs.
Maintain confidentiality of employee, customer, and business information.
Support internal and statutory audits by maintaining accurate administrative records.
Ensure office safety, security, and proper control of company assets.
Coordinate with relevant teams for document retention and secure disposal as per company policy.
Eligibility Criteria
Education: Graduate in any discipline; a qualification in Business Administration is preferred.
Experience: 13 years of experience in administration, preferably in an NBFC, banking, financial services, or a multi-branch organization.
Computer Skills: Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, email, and office documentation.
Communication: Good verbal and written communication skills.
Other Skills: Vendor management, coordination, record keeping, time management, and problem-solving.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Timely completion of administrative activities.
Cost control and adherence to approved budgets.
Accuracy and timely submission of bills, invoices, and MIS reports.
Timely resolution of facility and vendor-related issues.
Maintenance of accurate asset and inventory records.
Audit readiness and compliance with internal administrative policies.
Satisfaction of branch employees and internal stakeholders.
Preferred Competencies
Strong organizational and coordination skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy.
Professional conduct and integrity.
Ability to manage multiple tasks independently.
Ability to work under deadlines and coordinate with multiple branches.
High level of confidentiality and accountability.
Note: The role may require coordination with multiple branches, regional offices, vendors, and corporate administration teams depending on business requirements.

.Role: Sales Manager I

A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants learning their business understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.

Job Description:

Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggys products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Google sheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction 80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month What We're Looking For

Experience & Background:

0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partners.
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Site Head Rooftop Solar Projects (South)
Location: South India (Site-Based)
Business: Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited (TPREL)
Department: EPC / Rooftop Solar Projects
Experience: 7–14 Years
Education: B.E./B.Tech in Electrical & Electronics Engineering or Electrical Engineering
Age: 35–45 Years
Languages: Telugu and Kannada (Preferable)
Role Purpose
The Site Head – Rooftop Solar Projects will be responsible for end-to-end execution and management of rooftop solar projects at site, ensuring timely delivery within approved budget, scope, quality, and safety standards. The incumbent will lead site operations, coordinate with stakeholders, manage vendors and contractors, and drive project completion while ensuring adherence to organizational and regulatory requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Project Execution & Lifecycle Management
Lead the complete project lifecycle from site mobilization to commissioning and project handover.
Ensure successful execution of rooftop solar projects as per approved scope, timelines, quality standards, and budget.
Monitor project progress and implement corrective actions to mitigate delays and project risks.
Drive achievement of project milestones and ensure timely completion.
Site Operations Management
Oversee day-to-day site operations, workforce deployment, and resource utilization.
Conduct regular site reviews and progress assessments.
Planning & Project Controls
Develop detailed project execution plans, schedules, and tracking mechanisms.
Monitor project performance against planned timelines and budgets.
Coordinate material availability, manpower planning, and equipment deployment.
Maintain project documentation and reporting systems.
Quality & Safety Management
Ensure implementation of best-in-class quality standards and construction practices.
Drive compliance with all HSE (Health, Safety & Environment) requirements and statutory regulations.
Conduct safety audits, toolbox talks, and quality inspections.
Promote a strong safety culture across all project sites.
Stakeholder Management
Act as the primary point of contact for customers, consultants, local authorities, and internal stakeholders.
Ensure effective communication and alignment among project teams and business functions.
Manage client expectations and address project-related concerns proactively.
Vendor & Contract Management
Manage contractors, vendors, and subcontractors throughout the project lifecycle.
Monitor vendor performance against contractual obligations, safety, quality, and delivery parameters.
Resolve contractual and execution-related issues to ensure uninterrupted project progress.
Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop site engineering and execution teams.
Foster a high-performance culture focused on safety, quality, and timely project delivery.
Ensure effective coordination among engineering, procurement, and execution teams.
Technical Problem Solving
Identify and troubleshoot technical, operational, and execution challenges.
Drive resolution of site-level issues with minimal impact on project timelines.
Support commissioning, testing, and performance optimization activities.
Desired Candidate Profile
Education
B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or related discipline.
Experience
7–14 years of experience in solar, renewable energy, EPC, power, or infrastructure projects.
Proven experience in rooftop solar project execution and site management.
Strong exposure to project planning, construction management, commissioning, and stakeholder handling.
Technical Skills
Rooftop Solar Project Execution.
Project Planning & Control.
Electrical Systems & Installation.
Site Construction Management.
Quality Assurance & Safety Management.
Contract & Vendor Management.
Risk Assessment & Mitigation.
Project Scheduling Tools (MS Project/Primavera preferred).
Behavioral Competencies
Leadership and team management.
Excellent coordination and communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management capabilities.
Problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Result-oriented approach with ownership mindset.
Other Requirements
Willingness to work from project sites across South India.
Proficiency in Telugu and Kannada is mandatory.
Ability to travel extensively based on project requirements.
Reporting To: Project/Regional Execution Head – Rooftop Solar Business (TPREL)
Team Size: Site Engineers, Supervisors, Contractors & Vendor Workforce (as applicable).

Complete stock requisition and control of all expense of the department

Forecasting sales targets-daily / fortnightly / monthly / Yearly

Preparing a monthly report of the revenue generated by members dining usage in the outlets

Prepare strategies and techniques necessary for achieving the sales targets

Appointing consultants and conducting product and sales training

Map potential customers and generate leads for the organization

Maximizing business relationships and creating an environment where customer service is the best

Conducts detail check of all service periods

Works with all departments to ensure seamless service

Follow up on guestsfeedback

Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence

Perform other duties as assigned

Keeps the guest experience team focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction

Ensures guest experience team effectively handles guest requests and adheres to all hotel policies, procedures and standards while striving towards total guest satisfaction

Diploma or Degree from preferably hospitality or related field

Minimum 5 yearsrelevant experience

Excellent communication and written skills in English with the ability to communicate in a second language

Possess strong interpersonal skills

Understand and address guests' and/or colleagues' needs

Train and motivate colleagues

Create and maintain a cohesive environment for the team

Focus on service with an eye for detail and an approachable attitude

Self-motivated and shows good initiative in a dynamic environment

Ensure security and confidentiality of guest and hotel information

Possess good computer and property management system skills

Embrace and respond to change effectively

Work well under pressure, with the ability to analyse and resolve issues by exercising good judgment

Doctors For You is currently inviting applications for the position of Lab Technician within its TB
Projects. We are in search of a dedicated and skilled professional who will conduct TB diagnostics, including smear microscopy, staining, and NAAT for sputum, EPTB, and pediatric TB samples,
following SOPs and NTEP guidelines. Responsibilities include maintaining lab records, ensuring
timely reporting, coordinating sample testing, assisting in MDR-TB suspect identification, and overseeing sample collection and transport for DST. They will ensure biosafety compliance, support
quality assurance, implement new diagnostic tools, and manage data using Nikshay. Reporting to
the Cluster Coordinator, they will collaborate with the STLS to uphold lab standards. The ideal
candidate will work from the respective district.
Essential Qualification/ Requirements:
Intermediate (10+2) and Diploma or certified course in Medical Laboratory Technology or equivalent.
Preferential Qualification:
One year experience in NTEP sample testing using Sputum smear microscopy and NAAT
testing.
Candidates with Higher qualification (for example Graduates) shall be preferred.
Roles and Responsibilities
Adhere to standard operating procedures (SOPs) for smear preparation, staining, microscopy,
reporting, and M. tuberculosis detection using modern NAAT methods for sputum, EPTB, and
paediatric TB samples.
Maintain laboratory registers and ensure timely reporting of results to the Medical Officer and
project team.
Coordinate with staff to ensure prompt testing of pulmonary and extra-pulmonary samples
following the National Tuberculosis Elimination Program (NTEP) diagnostic algorithm.
Assist the Medical Officer in identifying MDR-TB suspects and ensure proper collection and
transportation of sputum specimens for Culture and Drug Susceptibility Testing (DST) per
guidelines.
Oversee and supervise the safe disposal of contaminated laboratory materials in compliance with
the Laboratory Manual.
Support the Senior TB Laboratory Supervisor (STLS) in implementing NTEP Laboratory
Quality Assurance measures.
Assist in the rollout and implementation of new TB diagnostic tools within NTEP.
Facilitate the adoption and effective use of Nikshay tools for data entry, validation, and public health action.
Note: The principal responsibilities listed above are an illustrative list and not an exhaustive list.
Additional responsibilities may be added from time to time depending on Project requirements.
Reporting: The Lab. Technician will be reporting to the State Coordinator.
Remuneration: The compensation for the above-mentioned position/s will adhere to internal policies
and market standards, determined by qualifications, relevant experience, budget availability, internal parity, and interview performance.
The above-mentioned position requires outstanding communication, analytical skills, documentations
skills, interpersonal, and computer skills, as well as the willingness to travel. Preference will be given
tocandidates with work experience in the relevant field and local candidates who possess the necessary
experience and skill sets.

Area

You will work closely with IT teams, functional consultants, and business stakeholders to implement best practices, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and support system upgrades, patches, and migrations. Experience supporting landscapes like S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, PO/PI, Fiori, Solution Manager, etc.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Maintain day-to-day accounting records, including sales, purchases, expenses, receipts, and payments.
Prepare and maintain invoices, purchase bills, vouchers, debit notes, and credit notes.
Maintain Tally or other accounting software and ensure accurate ledger posting.
Perform bank reconciliation and monitor customer outstanding balances and vendor payments.
Maintain accounts receivable and payable records and follow up on pending payments from customers.
Manage inventory and stock accounting for solar panels, inverters, batteries, cables, electrical equipment, and other materials.
Maintain project-wise accounting records for solar installations and EPC projects.
Track employee advances, reimbursements, expenses, and salary-related accounting entries.
Assist in preparing monthly financial reports, profit and loss statements, and cash-flow summaries.
Maintain proper documentation of purchase orders, delivery challans, e-way bills, and other statutory documents, wherever applicable.
Coordinate with the management, vendors, customers, and Chartered Accountant for accounting, taxation, and audit requirements.
Ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and timely completion of all accounting activities.


Preferred candidate profile
Graduate in Commerce (B.Com) or equivalent qualification in Accounting or Finance.
24 years of practical experience in accounting, preferably in solar, electrical, trading, EPC, or manufacturing businesses.
Good working knowledge of Tally Prime, MS Excel, and accounting software.
Strong understanding of GST, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, purchase and sales reconciliation, and GST input tax credit.
Experience in bank reconciliation, ledger maintenance, accounts payable and receivable, and vendor/customer account reconciliation.
Knowledge of inventory accounting, stock registers, purchase orders, invoices, delivery challans, and e-way bills.
Ability to maintain project-wise expenses, customer outstanding reports, cash-flow records, and monthly financial statements.
Familiarity with TDS, income tax documentation, and coordination with Chartered Accountants for statutory compliance.
Good numerical accuracy, attention to detail, honesty, and a responsible approach to financial records.
Good communication skills and the ability to coordinate with management, vendors, customers, and other team members.
Candidates based in Prayagraj or willing to work in Prayagraj will be preferred.
Candidates with experience in a solar EPC company or electrical goods trading business will receive preference.

Perks and benefits

Salary as per candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.
Opportunity to work with a growing solar energy and EPC business.
Professional learning and development opportunities in accounting, GST, taxation, and solar industry operations.
Supportive working environment with direct coordination with management.
Opportunity for long-term career growth based on performance.
Timely salary payments.
Paid leaves and holidays as per company policy.
Performance-based salary increments.
AboutCompany:
VHS Solar Enterprises (Veer Hanuman Shakti Solar Enterprises) is a solar energy and electrical solutions business based in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh. The company is engaged in solar power solutions, solar EPC services, supply of solar equipment, and electrical products.
Our business activities include solar panel and inverter supply, solar mounting structures, batteries, cables, electrical panels, and other solar and electrical accessories. We also undertake solar installation and project execution, providing solutions to meet customers' energy requirements.
At VHS Solar Enterprises, we focus on quality products, reliable service, efficient project execution, and long-term customer relationships. We aim to contribute to the adoption of solar energy by delivering practical and dependable solar power solutions.
We offer employees an opportunity to work in the growing renewable energy sector, gain practical experience in business operations, and develop their professional skills in a dynamic working environment.
CompanyAddress: Building No./Flat No.: 107, Near Dhussa Power House, Jhalwa, Prayagraj

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
The role involves converting 3D CAD models and engineering data into high-quality 2D illustrations, exploded views, assembly illustrations, installation/removal procedures, and procedural graphics.

The illustrations must comply with applicable technical documentation standards and support the development of Interactive Electronic Technical Publications (IETP), Repair Parts and Illustrations List (RPIL), Illustrated Parts Data (IPD), and Component Maintenance Publications (CMP).

Qualifications and Experience
B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or an equivalent discipline.
3-5 years of relevant experience in technical illustration and engineering documentation.
Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, CATIA, or equivalent tools.
Strong understanding of technical drawing and documentation standards, including ATA iSpec 2200 and S1000D.
Proven experience in creating technical illustrations compliant with S1000D standards.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, or equivalent technical illustration tools.
Experience in Illustration Content Number (ICN) management and associated technical publication workflows.
Experience with RPIL, Repair Parts Support (RPS) development, and IPD illustrations is highly advantageous.
Familiarity with IETP standards and Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) deliverables is highly desirable.
Experience working with engineering databases and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools such as Teamcenter, SAP, Agile PLM, Windchill, or 3D Via.
Proficiency in workflow and work-tracking tools such as JIRA.

Key Responsibilities
Create accurate 2D technical illustrations from 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, and technical references.
Develop detailed illustrations, including exploded views, assembly views, section views, detail views, and installation/removal procedures.
Produce procedural graphics and illustrations for technical manuals, maintenance manuals, service manuals, assembly instructions, and parts documentation.
Develop illustrations for IETP, RPIL, IPD, and CMP deliverables.
Use Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, or equivalent software to create high-quality, vector-based technical illustrations.
Interpret CATIA 3D models to understand product structures, components, assemblies, and engineering designs.
Ensure accuracy in geometry, orientation, proportions, and component relationships.
Apply appropriate line weights, colour shading, hatching, callouts, symbols, arrows, and graphical conventions in accordance with applicable standards.
Analyse complex engineering data, including drawings, specifications, CAD models, bills of materials (BOMs), schematics, wiring diagrams, and Service Bulletins, to develop technically accurate illustrations.
Collaborate with engineers, technical authors, designers, subject-matter experts, and the wider Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) team to clarify technical information and validate content.

Join our Team
About this opportunity:
Ericsson is looking for a diligent and competent Domain Support Specialist. to strengthen our Service Delivery team. In this role, you will ensure seamless Operations & Maintenance (O&M), manage incidents and emergencies, and provide advanced technical troubleshooting.
What you will do:

- Deliver O&M support, ensuring availability and performance of core and cloud systems.
- Lead incident and emergency handling, providing timely resolution and RCA for critical events.
- Support project execution including new node acceptance tests and technology rollouts.
- Drive automation and AI initiatives for predictive maintenance, proactive fault detection, and operational efficiency.
- Monitor and review TT, CR, and AT performance, ensuring adherence to MSTOP guidelines.
- Ensure MIR release and user access controls in line with Ericsson standards.
- Interface with regional and global support teams for escalated issues and knowledge sharing.
The skills you bring:

- 2-5 years in Telecom O&M, Service Delivery, or Customer Support.
- Hands-on experience with Ericsson Charging System preferred.
- Exposure to AI/ML-driven operations or automation frameworks is an advantage.
- Familiarity with incident, problem, and change management processes.
- Intelligent Networks (IN), CAMEL, INAP.
- Voice Call & Signaling Routing, Network Architecture & Protocols.
- End-to-End Performance Audit & Optimization.
- Knowledge of AI-based monitoring and data analytics tools.
- ITIL, Oracle, CCNA, Red Hat.
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.

You ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
