Join our Team
About this opportunity:
Ericsson is looking for a diligent and competent Domain Support Specialist. to strengthen our Service Delivery team. In this role, you will ensure seamless Operations & Maintenance (O&M), manage incidents and emergencies, and provide advanced technical troubleshooting.
What you will do:
- Deliver O&M support, ensuring availability and performance of core and cloud systems.
- Lead incident and emergency handling, providing timely resolution and RCA for critical events.
- Support project execution including new node acceptance tests and technology rollouts.
- Drive automation and AI initiatives for predictive maintenance, proactive fault detection, and operational efficiency.
- Monitor and review TT, CR, and AT performance, ensuring adherence to MSTOP guidelines.
- Ensure MIR release and user access controls in line with Ericsson standards.
- Interface with regional and global support teams for escalated issues and knowledge sharing.
The skills you bring:
- 2-5 years in Telecom O&M, Service Delivery, or Customer Support.
- Hands-on experience with Ericsson Charging System preferred.
- Exposure to AI/ML-driven operations or automation frameworks is an advantage.
- Familiarity with incident, problem, and change management processes.
- Intelligent Networks (IN), CAMEL, INAP.
- Voice Call & Signaling Routing, Network Architecture & Protocols.
- End-to-End Performance Audit & Optimization.
- Knowledge of AI-based monitoring and data analytics tools.
- ITIL, Oracle, CCNA, Red Hat.
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.

You ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Description:
Its fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
Were committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.
About Fractal
Fractal is one of the most prominent providers of Artificial Intelligence to Fortune 500 companies.Fractals vision is to power every human decision in the enterprise, and bring AI, engineering, and design to help the worlds most admired companies.Fractal currently has 4000+ employees across 16 global locations, including the United States, UK, Ukraine, India, Singapore, and Australia.
Fractals businesses include Crux Intelligence (AI driven business intelligence), Eugenie.ai (AI for sustainability), Asper.ai (AI for revenue growth management) and Senseforth.ai (conversational AI for sales and customer service). Fractal incubated Qure.ai, a leading player in healthcare AI for detecting Tuberculosis and Lung cancer.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Azure Lead Architect to join our consulting practice. In this leadership role, you will work with enterprise clients to design, build, and modernize cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure. You will be responsible for leading architecture engagements, defining cloud strategies, and guiding cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of Azure-based solutions for complex enterprise applications.
Define cloud architecture and roadmap in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
Assess client s current environment and make architecture recommendations for cloud adoption, migration, and optimization.
Own end-to-end solution architecture and act as a trusted advisor to client leadership.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, Data, and Application teams to align cloud solutions with enterprise strategy.
Mentor and guide development teams on best practices in cloud architecture.
Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and cost-benefit analysis.
Support pre-sales and proposal development including effort estimation, technical solutions, and client presentations.
Stay updated with the latest Azure offerings and industry trends.
Required Skills Qualifications
12+ years of experience in IT, with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Azure architecture and implementation.
Strong expertise in Azure services such as Azure App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps, ARM/Bicep/Terraform templates.
Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert) preferred.
Bachelors or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Prior experience in a client-facing consulting role.
Knowledge of other cloud platforms like AWS or GCP is a plus.
Why Join Us
Opportunity to work with top-tier clients across industries.
Exposure to cutting-edge cloud projects and digital transformation programs.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Learning and development opportunities with access to cloud certifications and trainings.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

SAP BASIS Consultant

Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)

Experience:
JL4: 2-5 Years
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP BASIS Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for managing, administering, monitoring, and optimizing SAP landscapes across enterprise environments.

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP BASIS Administration, SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP HANA Database Administration, System Installation, Upgrades, Migrations, Kernel Upgrades, Performance Tuning, and Production Support. Experience in implementation, migration, upgrade, and support engagements is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Install, configure, administer, and monitor SAP systems across landscapes.
Perform SAP system installations, upgrades, refreshes, migrations, and patching activities.
Manage SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP NetWeaver, and SAP HANA environments.
Execute client copies, system copies, kernel upgrades, and transport management activities.
Monitor system performance and optimize SAP application and database performance.
Perform regular health checks and system monitoring activities.
Manage SAP user administration, authorizations, and security-related activities.
Handle SAP Backup, Recovery, High Availability (HA), and Disaster Recovery (DR) configurations.
Support incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis (RCA).
Troubleshoot SAP application, database, and operating system-related issues.
Coordinate with infrastructure, cloud, functional, and development teams.
Support implementation, rollout, upgrade, migration, and maintenance projects.
Manage SAP Transport Management System (TMS) across landscapes.
Prepare technical documentation and operational procedures.
Ensure system availability, reliability, compliance, and operational excellence.
Provide production support and resolve critical incidents within SLA timelines.

Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of SAP landscape architecture and administration.

Mandatory Skills
SAP BASIS Administration
SAP S/4HANA
SAP NetWeaver
SAP HANA Administration
SAP Installation
SAP Upgrades

Good to Have
SAP Solution Manager
SAP Landscape Management (LaMa)
SAP Cloud ALM
SAP BTP Administration
AWS / Azure / GCP Exposure
HANA Database Migration
Automation & Scripting
SAP Fiori Administration
SAP Router Administration
ITIL Process Knowledge

Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP BASIS Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP Administration experience

Title: Presales/Operations Professional | Online Payments (Payment Gateway)

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform through a wide range of payment use cases. Paytm offers services such as utility bill payments, money transfers, UPI, Wallet, FASTag, Postpaid, and Payment Gateway solutions. For merchants, Paytm provides comprehensive payment acceptance solutions, including QR, Soundbox, EDC, and Payment Gateway, while enabling business growth through commerce and financial services.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
Paytm Payments Services Limited (PPSL) is the RBI-regulated Payment Aggregator responsible for Paytm's Online Payment Gateway business. PPSL enables thousands of merchants, startups, and enterprises to offer seamless digital payment experiences through multiple payment modes, including UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI, and BNPL. Our mission is to help businesses accelerate growth through secure, reliable, and scalable payment solutions.

About the Role:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented professional to support the Payment Gateway Sales team across pre-sales activities, client solutioning and sales operations. The role will work closely with Sales, Product, Technology and Operations teams to ensure smooth coordination, effective client engagement and seamless business execution.

Expectations / Requirements:
Generate and qualify enterprise leads through cold calling, outbound prospecting and market research.
Understand prospect requirements, conduct initial discussions and build a strong pipeline for the Enterprise Sales/KAM team.
Maintain lead pipeline, follow-ups and accurate updates in CRM/internal systems.
Coordinate with Product, Technology, Integration, Risk and Operations teams for smooth merchant onboarding and integration.
Act as a SPOC for merchant queries, issues and grievances, ensuring timely resolution and closure.
Track merchant onboarding, integration and operational issues, identify bottlenecks and drive timely resolution.
Prepare MIS, reports and dashboards covering leads, onboarding, integrations and operational metrics.
Support Sales with operational activities, documentation, approvals and internal coordination.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve productivity, prospect research, reporting and operational efficiency.
Identify process gaps and drive improvements in TAT, operational efficiency and merchant experience.

Qualifications & Skills:
2+ years of experience in Pre-Sales, Inside Sales, Sales Support, Merchant Operations or similar roles.
Strong experience in B2B/Enterprise lead generation, cold calling and lead qualification.
Prior experience in Fintech, Payments, Banking or Technology preferred.
Exposure to merchant onboarding, payment integration or merchant support is an added advantage.
Strong communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with prospects, merchants and internal teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and execution skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM/reporting tools.
Hands-on experience with AI tools to improve prospecting, research, reporting, productivity and day-to-day execution is mandatory.
Strong ownership, customer focus and ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed:
Proven ability in cold calling, lead generation & lead qualification
Strong B2B/Enterprise sales orientation
Excellent stakeholder management & coordination
Customer-centric approach with strong problem-solving skills
Good analytical and reporting skills
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
Strong ownership, follow-through and execution mindset
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM tools

Location:
Noida | Mumbai | Bengaluru
Why Join Us:
At Paytm Payments Services, you'll work on one of India's largest digital payment platforms, solving complex business challenges for leading enterprises. You'll collaborate with high-performing teams, gain exposure to cutting-edge payment technologies, and play a key role in enabling India's digital commerce ecosystem.
Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With 500M+ registered users and 21M+ merchants, Paytm offers immense opportunities to build, innovate, and grow while contributing to India's largest digital payments ecosystem

Location: Gurgaon, Noida and Mumbai

Role Overview: We are seeking a proactive Manager Supply to strengthen relationships with our delivery partners and drive long-term loyalty towards the Delhivery platform.

Conduct regular engagement activities, recognition programs, and feedback sessions to enhance partner motivation and loyalty. 3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company

Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

About the Role
At Tecorb Technologies, we are building the future of intelligent systems by leveraging cutting-edge
AI/ML and Generative AI technologies.
We are looking for a driven and technically grounded developer with 1-2 years of hands-on experience
to join our AI/ML & Generative AI team. This role is suited for professionals who have moved beyond
entry-level exposure and are ready to take ownership of AI/ML pipelines, contribute to real-world
deployments, and grow into a senior AI engineer role. You will work on machine learning, deep
learning, large language models (LLMs), and generative AI systems including GPT models,
Transformers, diffusion models, and more.
If you connect dots, understand systems holistically, and are passionate about building intelligent
applications we want you.
Core AI/ML Knowledge Required
Machine Learning Fundamentals


Supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised learning paradigms
Classical ML algorithms: Linear/Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, SVMs,
Gradient Boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM)
¢
¢
¢
Model evaluation: cross-validation, bias-variance tradeoff, precision/recall, ROC-AUC
Feature engineering, data preprocessing pipelines, and handling imbalanced datasets
Hands-on experience with scikit-learn, NumPy, Pandas
Deep Learning & Neural Networks
¢
Solid understanding of feedforward networks, backpropagation, and optimization (Adam, SGD,
learning rate schedulers)
¢
¢
¢
¢
Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for image/vision tasks
Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), LSTMs, and GRUs for sequential data
Attention mechanisms and how they led to the Transformer architecture
Experience with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow/Keras for model training and fine-tuning
Transformers & Large Language Models
Transformers are the backbone of modern AI. Candidates must have strong knowledge of:



¢
¢
¢
¢
¢
Transformer Architecture Self-attention, multi-head attention, positional encoding,
encoder-decoder structure
BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) masked language
modeling, fine-tuning for classification, NER, QA
GPT Models (GPT-2, GPT-3, GPT-3.5, GPT-4) causal language modeling, prompt
engineering, in-context learning, and API integration
T5, FLAN-T5 encoder-decoder models for text-to-text tasks like summarization, translation,
and QA
LLaMA, Mistral, Falcon open-source LLM architectures, weight loading, and inference
optimization
¢
¢
¢
Hugging Face Transformers library model loading, tokenization, pipelines, and Trainer API
Tokenization strategies BPE, WordPiece, SentencePiece
Positional encodings absolute, relative (ALiBi, RoPE)
Generative AI Systems
¢
¢
¢
¢
¢
¢
Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) basics of generator-discriminator training
Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) latent space, reconstruction loss, KL divergence
Diffusion Models forward/reverse diffusion, DDPM, Stable Diffusion, ControlNet
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) vector retrieval, chunking strategies, reranking
Prompt engineering techniques zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, ReAct
Fine-tuning strategies full fine-tuning, LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF basics
NLP Fundamentals
¢
¢
¢
¢
Text preprocessing tokenization, lemmatization, stopword removal, vectorization (TF-IDF,
embeddings)
Core NLP tasks sentiment analysis, Named Entity Recognition (NER), text classification,
summarization, machine translation
Word embeddings Word2Vec, GloVe, FastText, and contextual embeddings from
Transformers
Semantic similarity, question answering, and dialogue systems
Key Responsibilities
¢
¢
¢
¢
Design, build, fine-tune, and deploy ML models and generative AI pipelines with minimal
supervision
Integrate pre-trained models (GPT-4, LLaMA, Mistral, Stable Diffusion) into production
applications via APIs or custom backends
Implement end-to-end NLP systems chatbots, content generators, summarizers, and RAG
pipelines
Perform data preprocessing, feature engineering, and dataset curation for training and
evaluation
¢
¢
Conduct model evaluation, benchmarking, error analysis, and iterative performance tuning
Explore and implement reinforcement learning techniques (RLHF, reward modeling) to improve
model interactions
¢
Build modular, scalable AI workflows using FastAPI, Docker, LangChain, and vector databases



¢
¢
Stay current with AI research (arXiv, Hugging Face, OpenAI blogs) and prototype new ideas
rapidly
Write clear documentation for experiments, code, models, pipelines, and datasets
Required Skills & Qualifications
¢
¢
¢
¢
¢
Bachelors, Masters, or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, or a related field
1-2 years of hands-on professional or project experience with ML/AI systems
Strong Python proficiency with ML libraries: scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch
Solid understanding of Transformer architecture and attention mechanisms
Practical experience working with GPT models via API (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Groq) or
open-source equivalents
¢
¢
¢
¢
¢
Working knowledge of Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, Datasets, PEFT)
Familiarity with LLM fine-tuning techniques: LoRA, QLoRA, or full fine-tuning
Understanding of vector databases and embedding workflows (FAISS, ChromaDB, Pinecone)
Knowledge of APIs, JSON, and RESTful application design
Proficiency with Git, Jupyter Notebooks, and Linux command-line tools
Nice to Have (Not Mandatory)
¢
¢
Familiarity with MLOps tools: Weights & Biases, MLflow, DVC, or TensorBoard
Basic knowledge of reinforcement learning
What Youll Get
¢
¢
¢
¢
Hands-on experience on real AI/ML projects and production-ready systems from day one
Mentorship and career development from senior AI/ML engineers and researchers
Access to state-of-the-art tools, compute infrastructure, and paid API credits
Opportunity to contribute to high-impact solutions in AI automation, GenAI workflows, and
enterprise applications
¢
¢
A learning-driven, inclusive, and collaborative work environment
Fast growth track with exposure to client-facing work, research, and system design
We are looking for an Engineer who understands systems and connects the dots not just a developer.

Description:
The SR DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER will be a key member of the Campaign Analytics team, responsible for transforming marketing intelligence through AI, automation, advanced analytics, and performance insights. This role will drive data-driven decision-making by proactively monitoring business performance, identifying trends, uncovering risks and opportunities, and delivering actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, hands-on experience in AI-enabled analytics, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. Acting as a performance intelligence hub for Marketing, this role will help leadership make faster, smarter, and more informed decisions.
Experience: 812 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Shift: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
The Main Responsibilities
AI & Analytics Transformation
Drive the adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance the speed, scale, and quality of marketing insights.
Design and deploy AI-powered solutions, intelligent agents, and automated workflows to streamline analysis, reporting, and opportunity identification.
Identify and automate recurring analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Partner with Marketing Operations and Technology teams to enhance analytical capabilities and optimize workflows.
Establish best practices and governance for AI-assisted analytics and insight generation.
Strategic Business Insights
Analyze end-to-end marketing and revenue performance across campaigns, funnels, pipeline creation, sales, and revenue outcomes.
Conduct in-depth analysis to identify trends, growth opportunities, performance challenges, and key business drivers.
Perform root-cause analysis to explain performance fluctuations and support strategic decision-making.
Develop forecasting models, scenario planning frameworks, and business performance analyses to guide investment and planning decisions.
Deliver data-backed recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and overall business performance.
Performance Intelligence & Forecasting
Continuously monitor key marketing KPIs, including lead generation, MQL volume, conversion rates, funnel health, pipeline creation, campaign performance, and revenue attainment.
Provide proactive visibility into performance against goals, forecasts, and business targets.
Develop pacing, forecasting, and scenario models to identify potential performance gaps and enable early intervention.
Track week-over-week performance trends and communicate key business insights to stakeholders.
Automated Monitoring & Anomaly Detection
Build and maintain automated monitoring systems and alerting frameworks to identify significant changes in marketing performance metrics.
Detect emerging risks, unusual activity, and performance anomalies across campaigns, channels, website traffic, conversion rates, pipeline creation, and spend effectiveness.
Assess business impact and distinguish between genuine performance issues, growth opportunities, and measurement discrepancies.
Lead diagnostic and root-cause investigations to identify the primary factors influencing performance outcomes.
Optimization & Executive Decision Support
Translate analytical findings into prioritized recommendations that drive measurable business impact.
Identify opportunities to optimize campaign investments, resource allocation, channel strategies, and marketing execution.
Proactively surface risks that may impact target achievement and highlight emerging opportunities for growth.
Provide executive-ready performance insights, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to support leadership decision-making.
What We Look For in a Candidate
8–12 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Analytics, Campaign Performance, or related analytical functions.
Strong expertise in data analysis, performance measurement, forecasting, and statistical modeling.
Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and automation technologies within analytics environments.
Proficiency with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
Advanced SQL and data manipulation skills; experience with Python or other analytical programming tools is highly desirable.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
Experience supporting B2B marketing, demand generation, funnel analytics, and revenue performance initiatives is preferred.

Job Description
Overview
AtkinsR alis is one of the world s leading consultancies operating in the built and natural environment. You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. We are proud to say it is thanks to our peoples diversity of thought, expertise, and knowledge. We offer unparalleled opportunities for talented individuals in search of a rewarding career both in India and around the world. Our teams are proud to deliver on some of the most prestigious projects across the world. Its thanks to our talented people and their diverse thinking, expertise and knowledge. Join us and youll be part of our genuinely collaborative environment, where everyone is supported to make the most of their talents and expertise.
We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic self-starter to join our team as an Assistant Ecology Consultant. This role will be based at our AtkinsR alis office in Bangalore, IN.
Your role
Authoring technical ecological reports.
Analysing bat sound data.
As a proficient user of GIS, supporting with desk studies, scoping sites, records of protected species and biodiversity net gain assessments.
Working to tight timescales and following an approved methodology will be key feature of the role.
Being a team player and delivering responsibilities by meeting deadlines.
Developing your technical skills through Continuing Professional Development.
Managing your own time and workload in collaboration with other team members.
Liaising with the UK team on a daily basis and building a good working relationship.
Managing work enquiries and preparing bids under the guidance of more senior staff.
Carrying out additional ad hoc activities as required by process leads.
About you
A degree in ecology/environmental sciences/environmental engineering.
2-4 years of experience working on ecology projects with experience in the UK region preferred.
Experience in Anabat Insight/ Kaleidoscope.
Proficient GIS skills (QGIS/ArcGIS).
Working knowledge of UKHab classification and the Defra Metric will be preferred.
Proficient ability to interpret, review and analyse data to produce reports.
Understanding of UK and EU Wildlife Legislation, planning policies, and licensing requirements.
Previous experience of working in international projects.
Project management experience including technical, financial and quality assurance aspects.
Membership of the Chartered Institute of Ecology and Environmental Management (CIEEM).
Highly motivated and proactive, focused on achieving and delivering technical excellence.
Excellent collaboration and interpersonal skills with effective communication abilities.
Strong in report writing, verbal communication, and presentation.
Quick to learn and adapt on the job.
Effective at prioritizing and managing multiple tasks concurrently.
Capable of working independently or as part of a multidisciplinary team.
Logical and organized in project delivery, following senior team members instructions and guidance.
Aware of how delivery time affects financial performance and proactively manages time, resources, and budget.
Able to identify and communicate project or team concerns to the immediate Line Manager.
Open to discussing career goals and aspirations.
Willing to share information and knowledge with team members.
Demonstrates initiative and basic leadership skills to direct a small work group.
Compliant with Health and Safety Policies and Procedures.
Reward benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsR alis
Were AtkinsR alis , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the worlds infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. Were committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Description:
The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, hands-on experience in AI-enabled analytics, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. Acting as a performance intelligence hub for Marketing, this role will help leadership make faster, smarter, and more informed decisions.
Experience: 8–12 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Shift: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
Role- Individual Contributor
The Main Responsibilities
AI & Analytics Transformation
Drive the adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance the speed, scale, and quality of marketing insights.
Design and deploy AI-powered solutions, intelligent agents, and automated workflows to streamline analysis, reporting, and opportunity identification.
Identify and automate recurring analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Partner with Marketing Operations and Technology teams to enhance analytical capabilities and optimize workflows.
Establish best practices and governance for AI-assisted analytics and insight generation.
Strategic Business Insights
Analyze end-to-end marketing and revenue performance across campaigns, funnels, pipeline creation, sales, and revenue outcomes.
Conduct in-depth analysis to identify trends, growth opportunities, performance challenges, and key business drivers.
Perform root-cause analysis to explain performance fluctuations and support strategic decision-making.
Develop forecasting models, scenario planning frameworks, and business performance analyses to guide investment and planning decisions.
Deliver data-backed recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and overall business performance.
Performance Intelligence & Forecasting
Continuously monitor key marketing KPIs, including lead generation, MQL volume, conversion rates, funnel health, pipeline creation, campaign performance, and revenue attainment.
Provide proactive visibility into performance against goals, forecasts, and business targets.
Develop pacing, forecasting, and scenario models to identify potential performance gaps and enable early intervention.
Track week-over-week performance trends and communicate key business insights to stakeholders.
Automated Monitoring & Anomaly Detection
Build and maintain automated monitoring systems and alerting frameworks to identify significant changes in marketing performance metrics.
Detect emerging risks, unusual activity, and performance anomalies across campaigns, channels, website traffic, conversion rates, pipeline creation, and spend effectiveness.
Assess business impact and distinguish between genuine performance issues, growth opportunities, and measurement discrepancies.
Lead diagnostic and root-cause investigations to identify the primary factors influencing performance outcomes.
Optimization & Executive Decision Support
Translate analytical findings into prioritized recommendations that drive measurable business impact.
Identify opportunities to optimize campaign investments, resource allocation, channel strategies, and marketing execution.
Proactively surface risks that may impact target achievement and highlight emerging opportunities for growth.
Provide executive-ready performance insights, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to support leadership decision-making.
What We Look For in a Candidate
8–12 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Analytics, Campaign Performance, or related analytical functions.
Strong expertise in data analysis, performance measurement, forecasting, and statistical modeling.
Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and automation technologies within analytics environments.
Proficiency with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
Advanced SQL and data manipulation skills; experience with Python or other analytical programming tools is highly desirable.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
Experience supporting B2B marketing, demand generation, funnel analytics, and revenue performance initiatives is preferred.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
Our team within the Canada Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.
We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecycle from concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.
Atkins Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking a Civil 3D Designer to join our Water BIM team. This role will be based at our Bangalore Gurugram office, contributing to world-class projects by creating detailed 3D models, coordinating multidisciplinary designs, and ensuring compliance with international standards.
Your role
Key Responsibilities:
Excellent in 3D Modelling of Pipe networks, Grading, Corridors, Cut and Fill using Civil 3D.
Excellent in Multidisciplinary 3D model coordination using Navisworks
Check model for Stage Completeness, Dimensional accuracy against modelling standards.
Ensure Level of Quality control for Completeness and adherence to company standards of all Drawings produced.
Stay informed the best practices methodologies in BIM implementation.
Able to perform and coordinate on multi-disciplinary projects and effective implementation of BEP and BIM workflows.
Ability to determine appropriate record/As-built, test pit, drawings and point cloud data.
Identify and solve drawing/ modelling problems and troubleshooting Civil 3D issues.
Identify new logical ideas for automation to improve efficiency.
In depth knowledge of engineering drawings and specifications. Ability to work using engineers calculations and design in producing drawings / 3D modelling.
Ensures accuracy and adapts a detail-conscious approach; carefully checks details at each stage to avoid errors.
Ensure timely planning and delivery by proactively managing assumptions, dependencies, and risk.
Follow GTC BMS processes to projects
Use of Vehicle tracking
Software Skills
Autodesk Civil 3D
AutoCAD
Microstation (add on)
BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud
Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)
Required Skills Competencies
Strong understanding of: Civil engineering drawings and construction methods
Ability to work with Survey data, point clouds
Good communication and coordination skills
Attention to detail and quality-focused approach
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
About you
Qualification
Graduate Engineers (Bachelor's degree) with up to 3 years or Diploma in Engineering with up to 7 years of relevant experience in the BIM domain or duly qualified having exceptional work experience track record
Desirable Experience
Canada infrastructure or consultancy project experience
Experience working within ISO 19650 BIM environment
Awareness of Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows

Description:
Job Summary
Position: Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment
Location: Shimla, Himachal Pardesh
Reporting To: National Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment
Based at: State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM) State Programme Management Unit (SPMU) office
Project Duration: 3 Years (annual contract, renewable based on performance and availability of funds)
Background
HelpAge India, in partnership with DAY-NRLM and participating SRLMs, is implementing a multi-state pilot to integrate elderly care, active ageing, and community-based caregiving within the Food, Nutrition, Health, and Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (FNHW) framework. The initiative aims to build scalable, community-led elderly inclusion systems through SHG-VO-CLF platforms, strengthen government convergence, and develop caregiving cadres and care economy approaches. To support state-level implementation, a Project Manager- Elderly Inclusion Empowerment will be positioned within the respective SRLM SPMU.
Purpose
The State Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment will provide state-level technical, operational, and coordination support for implementing the Operational Framework under the MoU between HelpAge India and the respective SRLM. The role includes integrating elderly-focused interventions within SRLM systems, strengthening implementation across pilot districts and blocks, facilitating government convergence, and supporting institutionalisation within DAY-NRLM, while guiding district/block teams, community institutions, and caregiving cadres to deliver agreed programme outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
Programme Coordination and Implementation: Lead coordination and implementation of the Operational Framework across pilot districts and blocks, ensuring alignment with state plans and the HelpAge India-SRLM MoU.
Coordination Engagement: Act as the key liaison between HelpAge India and SRLM, coordinating across state, district, and block levels, and driving convergence with relevant departments.
Technical Support Capacity Building: Develop and deliver guidelines, tools, and trainings; strengthen elderly inclusion, caregiving systems, and integration of ESHGs within NRLM platforms.
Monitoring Reporting: Track progress, conduct field visits, and lead reporting, evaluations, and documentation of programme outcomes.
Community Systems Convergence: Strengthen Elders Self Help Groups (ESHGs), community caregiving systems and enable elderly access to entitlements, health, social protection, and livelihoods through stakeholder convergence.
Disclaimer: The Job Description above is not an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, and responsibilities associated with the position.
Requirements
Desired Qualifications, Competencies Experience
Masters degree in Social Work, Rural Development, Development Studies, Public Health or related disciplines.
Minimum 4 - 6 years of relevant experience in rural livelihoods, SHG promotion, social inclusion, public health or community development programmes.
Prior experience of working with SRLMs, NRLM institutional platforms or large-scale government programmes will be preferred.
Experience in programme coordination, capacity building and stakeholder engagement.
Understanding of elderly inclusion, social protection, community caregiving or FNHW-related programmes will be an added advantage.
Strong communication, coordination and documentation skills.
Willingness to travel extensively within the state.
Strong programme coordination and facilitation skills.
Ability to work with government systems and community institutions.
Good training and mentoring abilities.
Strong analytical, reporting and documentation skills.
Good interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multi-stakeholder implementation processes.

Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International
Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
You assist in planning, developing and execution of capital projects, technical development, feasibility perspectives of engineering-related activities in the supply chain and capital-expense project execution to support growth, world-class manufacturing and productivity with the highest level of quality, safety and environmental requirements. You help ensure sure that Mondel z business and innovation processes in project management and Mondel z standards in execution are followed.
How you will contribute
The role supports capital project execution, and you will be accountable for the quality of the results and execution of capital projects using Mondel z standards, and business and innovation processes in project management. You will help define and deliver the capital and technical agenda during the development phase of capital investments with stakeholders so that accurate budgets, plans and fit-for-purpose technical solutions are provided and develop the capital budget according to the contract and forecast cash flow. You will also help ensure that applicable engineering developments and standards are properly implemented, and support the development and implementation of state-of-the-art processes and equipment strategies to optimize resources, harmonize assets and rollout best practices.
What you will bring
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
Engineering or operations
Working effectively and under pressure to meet deadlines
Analysis
Project management
More about this role
Lead the electrical and automation engineering project a the site, ensuring reliable, safe, and efficient execution of all electrical systems and automation system for new capacity expansion.

What you need to know about this position:
Experience
5-6 years of progressive experience in electrical and automation engineering within a manufacturing environment (FMCG/food beverage preferred).
PLC / SCADA
Strong knowledge of PLC programming (Rockwell / Siemens), SCADA/HMI design, industrial networking (Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus TCPIP), and instrumentation. Shall have sound knowledge of batch processes and Pack-ML Standards.
Electrical
Solid understanding of power distribution, motor control, and electrical protection systems. MCC panels and Drives.
Instrumentation
Good knowledge of instruments, selection, and Calibration processes, including legal meteorology.
Digital and Cybersecurity
Digital mindset, familiar with Digital applications for factory operations.
OT infrastructure - Networks, Network management, Server, Virtual Environment, Cybersecurity tools and Secure Remote access tools.
Process and Equipment Safety.
Hands-on knowledge of Process Safety and Equipment Safety Standards (SIL and PL). To design and validate the safety of the equipment and processes.
Leadership
Proven ability to lead and develop technical teams in a fast-paced operational setting.
Project Mgmt
Experience managing capital projects (>$500K electrical/automation scope).
Communication
Ability to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders; strong written and verbal English.

Education / Certifications:
Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.

Job specific requirements:
Electrical Systems
Own the design, BOQ preparation, installation, commissioning, all electrical systems across for new capacity expansion Plant projects.
Ensure compliance with local electrical codes, MDLZ engineering standards, and relevant safety regulations (e.g., NFPA 70E, IEC, local statutory requirements).
Automation for plant projects
Design and implementation of automation and control systems, including PLCs (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, etc.), SCADA/HMI, VFDs, servo drives, instrumentation, and industrial networks for new capacity expansion.
Support in plant digital manufacturing roadmaps.
Project Delivery
Lead electrical and automation scope for capital projects - from concept and design through FAT/SAT, installation, commissioning, and handover.
Manage external contractors, system integrators, and OEMs to deliver projects on time, on budget, and to specification.
Prepare and manage project budgets, schedules, and risk registers for the EA scope.
People Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop a team of electrical and automation technicians/engineers.
Build technical capability through structured training, mentoring, and skills-gap assessments.
Foster a culture of safety, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
Coordinate with Site Automation team, SSAL and the Electrical Maintenance team for project shutdown and integration planning.
Safety Compliance
Champion electrical safety practices, including lockout/tagout (LOTO), arc-flash risk assessments, and safe work permits.
Ensure all electrical and automation work complies with MDLZ Global Engineering Standards, local regulations, and insurance requirements.
Maintain up-to-date electrical single-line diagrams, panel schedules, and automation documentation.

Business Unit Summary
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 - the fourth time we ve received this award.

Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.

Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers

He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot  issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Job Description Senior Manager (Civil)

Business Unit: Auro Textiles Fabric Division
Grade: Senior Manager, M3
Reporting To: Unit Head
Place of Posting: Baddi, Himachal Pradesh

1. Primary Role

To oversee civil maintenance and infrastructure management across all Fabric Division units, including factory buildings, residential colonies, utilities, and other civil structures. The role also involves planning and execution of Greenfield and Brownfield projects, ensuring timely completion, cost control, quality standards, structural integrity, and compliance with safety procedures.

2. Roles and Responsibilities

1. Oversee repair and maintenance of factory buildings, residential facilities, roads, drainage systems, water supply lines, sewerage systems, and other civil infrastructure.
2. Conduct periodic inspections of civil structures, roofs, flooring, plaster, ceilings, and other building components to ensure structural stability and timely maintenance.
3. Assess the feasibility of new buildings, machine foundations, and modifications to existing structures, including preparation of drawings, proposals, cost estimates, and BOQs.
4. Prepare annual revenue and capital budgets, monitor expenditure, control costs, and ensure effective utilisation of resources.
5. Review material requirements, verify quantities, and approve purchase indents as per organisational procedures.
6. Monitor construction projects for progress, budget, quality, and adherence to approved specifications and timelines.
7. Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, contractors, and internal departments to resolve technical and site-related issues.
8. Verify job approvals, contractor bills, work measurements, and supporting documents in accordance with organisational SOPs.
9. Ensure compliance with safety standards and prescribed procedures during civil maintenance and construction activities.
10. Maintain records of drawings, estimates, BOQs, approvals, completed jobs, and associated costs.
11. Lead and guide civil officers, supervisors, and supporting staff, while addressing team grievances and ensuring effective service delivery.
12. Provide land, building, and infrastructure-related information to internal departments, CPPD, and the Estate Office as required.

3. Essential Qualifications and Experience

- Relevant qualification in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
- Proven experience in industrial infrastructure, including Greenfield and Brownfield projects and civil maintenance.
- Hands-on experience in project execution, budgeting, BOQ preparation, cost estimation, and contractor management.
- Knowledge of construction quality standards, safety practices, and infrastructure maintenance.

Job Description
Head Maintenance & Utility - Baddi Plant

Internally, the role is designated as Site Maintenance and Utilities Lead responsible for driving plant maintenance excellence, equipment reliability, preventive and predictive maintenance, utilities management, and the Progressive Maintenance (PM) pillar under our IL6S framework.

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

ROLE PURPOSE
As a member of the Plant Leadership Team (PLT), the Progressive Maintenance & Utilities Lead will lead the Progressive Maintenance (PM) Pillar within the Integrated Lean Six Sigma (IL6S) framework and drive the plants journey towards a Zero Breakdown Culture.

This role is responsible for building maintenance capability, improving equipment reliability, strengthening utilities performance, driving energy efficiency, and embedding world-class maintenance practices across the plant .

The role is focused on coaching, capability building, and technical leadership rather than day-to-day maintenance execution.

Your goal will be to ensure that the site manufacturing & support activities, without interruption, without any facilities shortages and/or any issues thereof. You will achieve 100% compliance to Local legal regulations, Quality, Health Safety & Environment management systems and standards. You are responsible for the management and maintenance of site facilities, buildings and equipment(s) (hardware & software).

How you will contribute

You will:
Works cross functionally to develop and implement a strategic Facilities road-map and annual operating plan which is a competitive advantage to Mondel z. Partner with internal & external stakeholders and service providers to define and meet Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Sustainability, Engagement goals. Establish a strong governance to review & control Operational performance and continuous Improvement plan to deliver against best in class both internally and externally.
Lead and be accountable that Building Maintenance program, Facilities maintenance program capabilities, including maintenance repairs & overall operations are in place. Accountable to insure adherence to business continuity plan, manufacturing standards government regulations are understood by all employees/services providers at the site, regularly reviewed and monitored for effective implementation.
Provide leadership, coaching to Facilities team towards implementation of IL6S-Integrated Lean 6 sigma ways of working: delivering zero breakdowns via preventive/predictive maintenance strategies and technical mastery of maintenance and operation teams; PM (Progressive Maintenance) Pillar, and CBM (condition based monitoring), Visual controls & tools Mgmt., Lubrication mgmt. & Calibration of equipment(s) etc.
Role model Values and principles through effective coaching, mentoring and builds skills capability across the Plant technical/engineering team to engage with latest modern practices. Have a clear people succession and resource plan, for the asset & technology population , identifying and implementing critical levers to attract, retain and develop critical talent
Interface with key stakeholders internally and externally to develop and maintain effective relationships, align priorities in order to deliver the company objectives, and goals.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

Strong operational & manufacturing leadership experience in CPG industry with experience in TPM-Total productive maintenance, 5s, LEAN, 6 sigma tools and concepts, Safety & GMP standards
An Engineer with a strong financial & business acumen, project management skills and Knowledge of industrial maintenance and manufacturing equipment, PM (Progressive Maintenance) expertise, Spare parts management, SAP PM module end user knowledge, Technology & Engineering automation basics.
Excellent communication (verbal & written), coaching, and leadership skills in a team-based environment. Demonstrated abilities in Analytics, problem solving and team building


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Progressive Maintenance Leadership
Lead the Progressive Maintenance Pillar and drive equipment reliability across the plant.
Establish and sustain preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance practices.
Drive breakdown elimination and continuous improvement initiatives.

Capability Building
Develop maintenance capability across engineering and operations teams.
Coach technical leaders and strengthen organizational expertise in reliability and maintenance excellence.
Support capability transfer through Autonomous Maintenance initiatives.

Reliability & Operational Excellence
Improve equipment availability, maintenance effectiveness, and operational performance.
Lead root cause analysis and drive sustainable corrective actions.
Improve key reliability metrics including OEE, MTBF, and MTTR.

Plant Leadership
Own maintenance and infrastructure budgets.
Support capital projects, plant expansions, and equipment investments.
Provide technical expertise to improve future plant design and asset reliability

Technical & Utilities Governance
Provide leadership across maintenance, utilities, electrical, instrumentation, and automation functions.
Ensure reliable and efficient operation of critical plant infrastructure and utility systems.
Support modernization, automation, and reliability improvement initiatives.

Safety, Compliance & Sustainability
Ensure compliance with safety, statutory, and environmental requirements.
Drive energy optimization and sustainability initiatives across the site.
Champion safe maintenance practices and technical governance

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Reduced equipment breakdowns and downtime.
Improved reliability, maintenance effectiveness, and plant performance.
Strong PM Pillar maturity within the IL6S framework.
Improved utility reliability and energy efficiency.
Enhanced technical capability across the organization.
Best-in-class safety and compliance performance
IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE
Bachelors Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Electronics, or Industrial Engineering.
10+ years of experience in Maintenance, Reliability, Engineering, or Plant Technical Operations.
Strong hands-on maintenance foundation with progression into maintenance leadership roles.
Experience working within Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), Integrated Lean Six Sigma (IL6S), or similar operational excellence frameworks.
Proven track record of driving reliability improvements, capability building, and maintenance excellence in highly automated manufacturing environments. Strong leadership, coaching, stakeholder management, and systems-thinking capabilities.

WHY JOIN
This is a high-impact Plant Leadership Team role offering the opportunity to shape maintenance strategy , influence plant-wide performance, build technical capability , and drive world-class reliability and operational excellence

Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. Store Visit

In Store Duty

Audit

Team Leader

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours

Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record

Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training

Description:
Head Plant Maintenance
Internally, the role is designated as Progressive Maintenance & Utilities Lead, responsible for driving plant maintenance excellence, equipment reliability, preventive and predictive maintenance, utilities management, and the Progressive Maintenance (PM) pillar under our IL6S framework.
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelz International?
Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
ROLE PURPOSE
As a member of the Plant Leadership Team (PLT), the Progressive Maintenance & Utilities Lead will lead the Progressive Maintenance (PM) Pillar within the Integrated Lean Six Sigma (IL6S) framework and drive the plant's journey towards a Zero Breakdown Culture.

This role is responsible for building maintenance capability, improving equipment reliability, strengthening utilities performance, driving energy efficiency, and embedding world-class maintenance practices across the plant.
The role is focused on coaching, capability building, and technical leadership rather than day-to-day maintenance execution.
Your goal will be to ensure that the site manufacturing & support activities, without interruption, without any facilities shortages and/or any issues thereof. You will achieve 100% compliance to Local legal regulations, Quality, Health Safety & Environment management systems and standards. You are responsible for the management and maintenance of site facilities, buildings and equipment(s) (hardware & software).
How you will contribute
You will:
Works cross functionally to develop and implement a strategic Facilities road-map and annual operating plan which is a competitive advantage to Mondelz. Partner with internal & external stakeholders and service providers to define and meet Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Sustainability, Engagement goals. Establish a strong governance to review & control Operational performance and continuous Improvement plan to deliver against best in class both internally and externally.
Lead and be accountable that Building Maintenance program, Facilities maintenance program capabilities, including maintenance repairs & overall operations are in place. Accountable to insure adherence to business continuity plan, manufacturing standards government regulations are understood by all employees/services providers at the site, regularly reviewed and monitored for effective implementation.
Provide leadership, coaching to Facilities team towards implementation of IL6S-Integrated Lean 6 sigma ways of working: delivering zero breakdowns via preventive/predictive maintenance strategies and technical mastery of maintenance and operation teams; PM (Progressive Maintenance) Pillar, and CBM (condition based monitoring), Visual controls & tools Mgmt., Lubrication mgmt. & Calibration of equipment(s) etc.
Role model Values and principles through effective coaching, mentoring and builds skills capability across the Plant technical/engineering team to engage with latest modern practices. Have a clear people succession and resource plan, for the asset & technology population , identifying and implementing critical levers to attract, retain and develop critical talent
Interface with key stakeholders internally and externally to develop and maintain effective relationships, align priorities in order to deliver the company objectives, and goals.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

Strong operational & manufacturing leadership experience in CPG industry with experience in TPM-Total productive maintenance, 5s, LEAN, 6 sigma tools and concepts, Safety & GMP standards
An Engineer with a strong financial & business acumen, project management skills and Knowledge of industrial maintenance and manufacturing equipment, PM (Progressive Maintenance) expertise, Spare parts management, SAP PM module end user knowledge, Technology & Engineering automation basics.
Excellent communication (verbal & written), coaching, and leadership skills in a team-based environment. Demonstrated abilities in Analytics, problem solving and team building
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Progressive Maintenance Leadership
Lead the Progressive Maintenance Pillar and drive equipment reliability across the plant.
Establish and sustain preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance practices.
Drive breakdown elimination and continuous improvement initiatives.
Capability Building
Develop maintenance capability across engineering and operations teams.
Coach technical leaders and strengthen organizational expertise in reliability and maintenance excellence.
Support capability transfer through Autonomous Maintenance initiatives.
Reliability & Operational Excellence
Improve equipment availability, maintenance effectiveness, and operational performance.
Lead root cause analysis and drive sustainable corrective actions.
Improve key reliability metrics including OEE, MTBF, and MTTR.
Plant Leadership
Own maintenance and infrastructure budgets.
Support capital projects, plant expansions, and equipment investments.
Provide technical expertise to improve future plant design and asset reliability
Technical & Utilities Governance
Provide leadership across maintenance, utilities, electrical, instrumentation, and automation functions.
Ensure reliable and efficient operation of critical plant infrastructure and utility systems.
Support modernization, automation, and reliability improvement initiatives.
Safety, Compliance & Sustainability
Ensure compliance with safety, statutory, and environmental requirements.
Drive energy optimization and sustainability initiatives across the site.
Champion safe maintenance practices and technical governance
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Reduced equipment breakdowns and downtime.
Improved reliability, maintenance effectiveness, and plant performance.
Strong PM Pillar maturity within the IL6S framework.
Improved utility reliability and energy efficiency.
Enhanced technical capability across the organization.
Best-in-class safety and compliance performance
IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE
Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Electronics, or Industrial Engineering.
10+ years of experience in Maintenance, Reliability, Engineering, or Plant Technical Operations.
Strong hands-on maintenance foundation with progression into maintenance leadership roles.
Experience working within Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), Integrated Lean Six Sigma (IL6S), or similar operational excellence frameworks.
Proven track record of driving reliability improvements, capability building, and maintenance excellence in highly automated manufacturing environments. Strong leadership, coaching, stakeholder management, and systems-thinking capabilities.

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc .

Description:
Direct Reportees: Store Managers
Interactions: Internal and External Stakeholders.
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organisational leadership:
- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
Direct Reportees: Store Managers
Interactions: Internal and External Stakeholders.
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organisational leadership:
- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.
